AI.tldr: Thermo-FL 是一个面向边缘设备的热感知联邦 LoRA 微调框架，将设备温度作为控制信号来调节本地训练负载和稀疏更新传输，并在服务端通过 TERRA 鲁棒聚合管道防御 Byzantine 与 MITM 攻击，在仿真器和 Jetson 物理测试床上均验证有效。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署 LLM 时面临硬件热限制（DVFS 降频、同步延迟）与对抗性更新（Byzantine 客户端、通信层 MITM 扰动）双重耦合挑战，而现有方法将两者视为独立问题分别处理，缺乏硬件感知与鲁棒聚合联合设计的框架。
AI.method: 客户端基于温度通过三段式策略动态调节可训练 LoRA 层比例 κ（1.0/0.5/0.1）和传输保留率 ρ（50%–1%），使用 top-K 稀疏化与 bitmap 编码压缩上传；服务端 TERRA 管道依次执行范数过滤（中位数+MAD）、掩码感知方向验证（基于历史聚合方向的余弦相似度）、自适应活跃坐标裁剪（基于活跃坐标分位数）和掩码感知聚合（仅对实际传输坐标归一化）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 仿真中，Thermo-FL 在 BoolQ 上于 clean/sign-flip/mixed 设置下均达到最高准确率（72.32%/71.16%/72.11%），GSM8K 上对抗设置下优于稀疏 FedAvg；Jetson Orin Nano 物理测试中温度稳定于 49–51°C，bitmap 编码压缩上传降至 0.42 MB（原始 2.23 MB），GSM8K 在 γ=-10 sign-flip 攻击下保持 21.40%（基线 0%），MITM 扰动下保持 18.65%（基线 0%）；消融实验验证各 TERRA 阶段互补且不可省略。
AI.conclusion: 边缘 LLM 安全自适应应将硬件行为、工作负载调节、稀疏通信与聚合鲁棒性视为耦合的设计需求而非独立系统问题，Thermo-FL 通过温度驱动的负反馈控制与稀疏感知的鲁棒聚合提供了端到端解决方案；附录中在抽象算子下给出了收敛到稳定邻域的 stationary-point 界。

title: Vibe Coding: Practice, Performance, Productivity, and Risk -A State-of-the-Art Review
summary: Vibe coding - AI-assisted software development in which the developer describes intent in natural language and validates results by running rather than reading the generated code - was named by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025 and produced its first body of empirical evidence within seventeen months. This state-of-the-art review assembles that evidence across a cross-disciplinary corpus spanning software engineering, human-computer interaction, labour economics, security research, governance, and education. We survey the model landscape, the tool ecosystem, and the performance record by task type, finding the early benchmarks saturated but task-level capability uneven: reliable code generation alongside weak fault detection and hard-to-audit documentation. The productivity record is at first contradictory: peer-reviewed field experiments report +26% more tasks per week, independent randomised trials measure a 19% slowdown, and team-level telemetry shows code-review time up +441%. We argue these readings are consistent once measurement method, scope, and time horizon are held constant, and identify six patterns behind the dispersion, among them effect-shrinkage under broader measurement, self-report diverging from independent measurement, output volume conflated with productivity, and bold claims walked back once tested over longer horizons. We further document security failures in deployed applications, code-quality degradation visible in large-scale code and developer telemetry, unsettled copyright exposure, and evidence of skill atrophy. The review closes with the open research questions and one falsifiable conjecture: that the gains are real on new code and shrink or reverse on mature codebases, which would account for most of the disagreement in the record.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于"Vibe Coding"（基于自然语言描述意图、通过运行而非阅读代码来验证结果的AI辅助软件开发）的跨学科现状综述。作者在17个月内汇集了软件工程、人机交互、劳动经济学、安全研究、治理和教育等领域的实证证据，揭示了表面上矛盾的发现实际上可以通过测量方法、范围和时间跨度得以调和，并提出了一个可证伪的猜想：生产力收益在新代码上真实存在，但在成熟代码库上会缩小甚至逆转。
AI.motivation: Vibe Coding自2025年2月由Karpathy命名后迅速流行，但实证证据呈现出表面上的矛盾：同行评审的现场实验报告每周任务量增加26%，独立随机试验却测得19%的减速，团队级遥测显示代码审查时间增加441%。同时，安全漏洞、代码质量下降、版权风险和技能萎缩等问题日益突出。本文旨在通过跨学科的视角综合这些分散的证据，厘清真实情况并识别未来研究方向。
AI.method: 采用state-of-the-art review（非系统综述）方法，构建跨学科语料库（123个引用源），按证据等级分层（同行评审论文15篇、独立研究报告16篇、新闻媒体14篇、供应商出版物16篇等）。采用四个约定：按可信度分层组织来源、临时来源在Wayback Machine归档并以快照URL为标准引用、在正文中显式标注来源性质、任何非同行评审的实质性主张都需佐证。围绕四个核心问题展开：当前模型和工具的能力、已证实的好处和危险、技术现状以及未来发展方向。
AI.result: 1）能力层面：HumanEval和MBPP已饱和，任务级别能力不均衡——代码生成可靠但故障检测弱、文档难以审计；2）生产力的"矛盾"实际上可通过六个模式调和：效应规模随测量范围扩大而收缩、自报告与独立测量背离、最大主张非真正生产力主张、标题鲜有纵向验证、审计质量与标题幅度成反比、资历发现只能跨不同量纲调和；3）安全风险：已记录多个安全漏洞事件（Enrichlead、Moltbook、Replit等），以及380,000个公开可访问资产和2,038个高影响漏洞；4）代码质量：代码审查时间增加441%，缺陷增加54%，代码重复率翻两番；5）版权风险：clean-room重写的法律地位未定；6）技能萎缩：初级岗位就业下降20%，计算机科学入学率下降8.1%，Anthropic的RCT显示AI辅助组理解力低17个百分点；7）企业问责真空：93%有流程但仅56%强制执行。
AI.conclusion: 领域核心张力在于三条曲线沿不同时间尺度呈不同方向运动：能力从1.7%升至95%但生产力对成熟代码库从+55%降至-19%，技能成本以5-10年为周期累积。作者提出可证伪猜想：收益在新代码上真实但会随代码库成熟而缩小或逆转。Vibe Coding是一种持久的软件开发模式变革，其益处比标题声称的更窄、更人群特定、短期，其成本更慢、更分散、更难归因。哪个占主导取决于能力提升能否补偿技能成本、劳动力市场能否达到新均衡，或一连串高调失败能否迫使制度纠正。

title: Behavior Specification-Guided Program Synthesis for Binary Deobfuscation
summary: Deobfuscation is critical to reverse engineering and security analysis because it restores the readability and analyzability of obfuscated code. However, existing research primarily focuses on source-code deobfuscation, while binary-level deobfuscation remains largely underexplored despite its practical importance when source code is unavailable. Existing binary deobfuscation methods typically decompile binaries into pseudocode and then apply structural transformations. However, because compilation discards high-level semantics such as precise type information and source-level structures, this decompilation-based paradigm often produces low-quality code and provides limited assurance that the recovered code preserves the runtime behavior of the original program. To address these limitations, we propose a paradigm shift from structural transformation to behavior-driven synthesis. Our core insight is that although obfuscation distorts a program's internal structure, semantics-preserving transformations must retain its observable execution behavior. Based on this insight, we introduce BinMirror, an approach that reformulates binary deobfuscation as a behavior-specification-guided program synthesis task. By treating dynamic execution traces and interaction snapshots as behavioral specifications, BinMirror synthesizes high-quality source code and validates it against runtime observations collected from heavily obfuscated binaries. Extensive evaluations on 1.5 million synthetically obfuscated binaries show that BinMirror significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a unit-test Pass@1 of 74.5% under extreme obfuscation. These results demonstrate the practical utility of BinMirror in restoring semantic clarity for real-world security analysis.

AI.tldr: BinMirror 是一种面向安全分析的二进制反混淆方法，将传统的"反编译+结构变换"范式转变为"行为规约引导的程序合成"范式。它通过捕获动态执行轨迹与系统调用交互快照作为行为规约，利用 trace 增强的反向数据流切片过滤混淆噪声，再以 LLM 作为语义提升器在行为约束下合成可读的 C 源码，并采用基于差分测试的闭环迭代验证机制保证生成的代码在观测路径上与原二进制行为一致。在 150 万合成混淆二进制及真实混淆 Linux 恶意软件样本上显著优于现有静态/动态/学习基线，并大幅提升下游 CFG 恶意软件检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有二进制反混淆方法通常先将混淆二进制反编译为伪 C 代码再施加结构变换，但编译/反编译过程会丢失类型、源级结构等高层语义，使伪代码质量低劣且难以验证还原结果是否保留了原程序的运行时行为，导致反混淆器可能误删安全敏感逻辑（如整数溢出检查）。
AI.method: 四阶段行为规约引导的反混淆管线：(1) 行为规约捕获：基于系统调用引导的灰盒探索 + 动态二进制插桩，在关键交互点捕获寄存器/内存快照 B_spec； (2) 噪声过滤：对动态指令迹做地址归一化后做反向数据流切片，并剔除 dispatcher/不透明谓词/MBA junk 等行为无关指令； (3) 规约引导代码合成：以 LLM 作为语义提升器，将精炼指令切片与 S_pre→S_post 状态迁移约束作为受限生成输入合成 C 源码； (4) 差分行为验证：在 Unicorn 仿真器内执行候选代码与原二进制对比 SysID/Args/Memory，不一致则将差异反馈给 LLM 迭代修复（默认 N_max=5）。
AI.result: 在 Synthetic Benchmark（L6）下 Pass@1=74.5%，编译率 81.4%，相对最强基线 ChatDEOB 高 54.3 个百分点；在 MalBench 上 ESR=65.8%，相对最强基线高 29.3 个百分点；在四种架构×四种优化级×63 种混淆配置下均优于基线；保持 68.4% CodeBLEU 与 76.2% 圈复杂度下降；嵌入 HawkEye-Linux 检测管线后 accuracy 提升 33.3%，F1 提升 37.1%；消融表明切片、I/O 约束、闭环迭代均关键，N_max=5 后收益递减，长切片（>250 条指令）会显著降低合成准确率。
AI.conclusion: 行为规约引导的程序合成是二进制反混淆的有效新方向，能缓解编译/反编译语义损失并对观测执行路径提供形式化保证；LLM 在该范式中更适合作为"约束引导的生成器"而非独立求解器，未来应在动态污点跟踪、指针别名建模与层次化分块上进一步提升大切片与隐藏依赖场景下的恢复能力；当前实现面向 Linux/POSIX 二进制，扩展至 Windows/firmware 需重新定义可观测交互边界。

title: Toward Understanding Operating System Defects
summary: Operating systems (OS) serve as the foundation for all other software systems, and thus defects in OSes can lead to severe conquences, such as system crashes and data corruption, affecting billions of users. This broad impact underscores the necessity and importance of ensuring OS quality. Understanding the characteristics of OS defects is a fundamental step in this quality assurance task, as it facilitates the design of effective defect detection and debugging approaches. In this work, we conduct a large-scale study of 1,500 defects from three distinct and representative operating systems (Android, Linux, and HarmonyOS) spanning both mobile and desktop environments. To the best of our knowledge, this is the largest study of its kind in this domain. By analyzing the distribution of OS defects across multiple classification dimensions, including the OS layer where defects occur, the functions they affect, how they are triggered, their severity, and the code elements involved in their repair, as well as performing joint analysis between dimensions and cross-OS similarity comparisons, we summarize several major findings that contribute to a comprehensive understanding of OS defects across systems. Based on these findings, we provide a series of actionable implications for better OS defect detection and debugging, offering guidelines for future research aimed at improving OS quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文对Android、Linux和HarmonyOS三大操作系统的1,500个真实缺陷进行了大规模、多维度的实证分析，构建了包含OS层级、受影响功能、触发场景、严重程度和修复代码元素五个维度的分类框架，并提出了针对各系统缺陷检测与调试的实践建议。
AI.motivation: 操作系统是所有软件系统的基石，缺陷可能导致系统崩溃、数据损坏等严重后果，影响数十亿用户。现有研究多聚焦单一系统或特定缺陷类型，缺乏跨系统、多维度的缺陷特征综合分析，难以为操作系统质量保障提供系统性指导。
AI.method: 1. 从Android Security Bulletins、Launchpad（Linux/Ubuntu）和HarmonyOS官方仓库分别采集500个已解决缺陷，共1,500个；2. 经过去重、过滤超大变更（>500行）等数据清洗步骤；3. 采用开放编码（Open Coding）流程，由两名具有3年以上开发经验的标注员独立标注，通过迭代标注（每50个缺陷计算Cohen's Kappa系数）逐步完善分类框架，最终Kappa值稳定在0.8以上；4. 构建五维分类框架：OS层级（6类）、受影响功能（8类）、触发场景（7类）、严重程度、修复代码元素（12类，可多标签）；5. 针对三个研究问题（单维度分布、维度间相关性、跨系统相似度）进行统计分析与Spearman相关性计算。
AI.result: 发现1：缺陷在OS层级、受影响功能、触发场景和严重程度上的分布因系统而异，但修复涉及的代码元素分布高度相似（if语句、函数调用、赋值和变量修改为主）。发现2：OS层级与受影响功能的相关性因系统不同，调试模式不可简单跨系统迁移。发现3：虽然层级-触发的相关性具有系统特异性，但边界条件缺陷在所有系统、所有层级都普遍存在。发现4：除边界条件外，并发/多线程、常规操作和状态依赖触发也呈现跨系统共性模式，常规操作也能频繁引发安全问题。发现5：三大系统整体缺陷分布差异显著，Spearman相关系数最高仅-0.11（Linux vs Android），必须开发针对性的调试技术。具体数据：Android缺陷集中在系统服务层（38.8%）和安全权限功能（60%），主要触发于权限/边界条件；Linux缺陷集中于应用层（54.2%）和兼容性适配（41.2%），环境依赖触发占62%；HarmonyOS缺陷集中于内核层（71.8%），边界条件（52.6%）和并发触发（24%）显著。修复规模普遍较小（≤10行），符合最小修复原则。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了三大操作系统在缺陷特征上的显著差异与共性，强调了针对各系统开发专门调试技术的必要性。针对Android应优先关注权限管理和系统服务边界；针对Linux应强化环境快照与跨平台测试；针对HarmonyOS应聚焦内核层资源管理与并发同步。同时指出当前自动程序修复（APR）技术主要面向单方法/单文件变更，难以应对OS级跨函数、跨模块的修复需求，需要开发新的系统性修复技术。所有数据已开源以支撑未来OS可靠性研究。

title: An Extensive Empirical Study on Code Translation Technique
summary: Automated code translation is increasingly important for software evolution, yet the relative strengths and limitations of learning-based and large language model (LLM)-based techniques remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study comparing representative code translation techniques across methodological paradigms and translation granularities. We evaluate learning-based methods, LLM-based methods, and general-purpose LLMs on multilingual method-level and class-level benchmarks involving multiple programming languages. Our analysis considers executable correctness, code similarity, translation direction, translation granularity, and failure patterns. The results show that LLMs and LLM-based methods generally outperform learning-based methods in method-level correctness, although similarity metrics alone do not reliably reflect functional correctness. Translation direction substantially affects performance, particularly when translating between languages with different type-system characteristics. Class-level translation remains considerably more difficult than method-level translation because it requires preserving global semantics, interfaces, member relationships, and cross-method dependencies. Our error analysis further shows that static semantic errors and logical errors are the primary challenges in existing code translation systems. These findings provide empirical evidence and practical guidance for developing more robust, type-aware, structure-aware, and context-aware code translation techniques.

AI.tldr: 该论文对11种代表性代码翻译技术（涵盖学习方法、LLM方法和通用LLM）进行了大规模跨范式实证研究，在多语言方法级和类级基准上系统比较其性能，发现LLM/LLM方法在正确性上优于学习方法，但类级翻译仍极具挑战，静态语义错误和逻辑错误是主要失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有代码翻译实证研究通常仅关注单一范式（仅LLM或仅神经方法），缺乏跨范式、跨粒度、跨数据集的统一比较，因此对不同方法的相对优劣理解不足。
AI.method: 研究选取2020-2025年间11种代表性方法（4个基于学习的方法、4个LLM方法、3个通用LLM），在G-TransEval、TransCoder-Uni和ClassEval-T三个基准上，使用CA、CSR和CodeBLEU三种指标进行评估，并对570个方法级失败用例和150个类级失败用例进行手动错误标注与分类（Fleiss'κ=0.9446）。
AI.result: 1）方法级翻译中LLM/LLM方法在CA和CSR上显著优于学习方法（UniTrans最佳，G-TransEval平均CSR 96.01%/CA 94.36%），但CodeBLEU相似度差距不大，学习方法常生成表面相似但无法编译的代码；2）翻译方向影响显著，静态类型语言→动态类型语言通常更易，反向更困难；3）类级翻译困难得多（最佳UniTrans平均CA仅24.82%，CSR 89.39%），目标语言为Python的类翻译优于Java或C++；4）方法级失败中静态语义错误占49.37%、逻辑错误占27.46%，函数签名违规是最主要子类；类级失败中静态语义错误占70.67%，函数签名违规占53.33%。
AI.conclusion: 未来代码翻译研究应：超越方法级翻译、结合正确性与相似性评估、显式处理方向特定的类型推断与映射、加强静态语义一致性与逻辑等价性保持，并发展面向类级/仓库级的全局一致性翻译技术，应关注类型感知、结构感知和上下文感知能力。

title: Beyond the Traceback: Using LLMs for Adaptive Explanations of Programming Errors
summary: Programming error messages are critical for software development, yet they remain difficult for novice programmers to interpret. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can rewrite these errors into clearer explanations, it remains unclear whether increased readability improves objective debugging performance or how explanation styles should align with programmer skill. We present a multi-stage crowdsourced study N=103 evaluating skill-targeted, LLM-generated Python error messages. Using a custom proficiency assessment, we categorized participants by skill level and tested standard interpreter messages against two LLM-generated styles: pragmatic (action-oriented) and contingent (scaffolded explanations). We measured both objective debugging metrics (fix rate, attempts, time-to-fix) and subjective perceptions (readability, cognitive load, tone). Our results show that while LLM-rewritten messages significantly improved subjective evaluations, with pragmatic messages rated as clearer and less cognitively demanding, these perceived gains did not translate into statistically significant improvements in objective debugging performance. This highlights a critical human-AI complementarity gap: explanations that feel better to users do not necessarily make them more effective debuggers. We discuss design implications for adaptive AI feedback systems, arguing that future tools should pivot from static skill-targeted rewriting toward dynamic adjustments based on a user's real-time repair trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用大语言模型（LLMs）重写Python编程错误信息的效果，通过103人的众包实验比较了标准解释器信息、务实型（pragmatic）和条件型（contingent）两种LLM生成风格。结果发现LLM重写的信息在主观评价上显著优于标准信息，但客观调试性能没有显著提升，揭示了"人机互补差距"。
AI.motivation: 编程错误信息对开发者至关重要，但对新手程序员来说仍然难以理解。虽然LLM可以重写错误信息使其更清晰，但信息可读性的提升是否真正改善客观调试表现，以及解释风格应如何与程序员技能水平匹配，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用多阶段众包研究设计：(1)开发调试导向的Python能力评估，从56个多项选择题中筛选8个项目用于技能分组；(2)形成性任务选择研究，从8个候选代码片段中筛选4个；(3)在Prolific平台进行主实验（N=103），比较标准Python解释器信息与两种LLM生成风格（务实型：简洁行动导向；条件型：脚手架式解释）。使用llama-3.1-8B-Instruct以temperature=0生成。测量客观调试指标（修复率、尝试次数、修复时间）和主观感知（可读性、认知负荷、语气）。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1)主观评价上，LLM重写信息（特别是务实型）在可读性、认知负荷、权威性感知方面显著优于标准信息；(2)客观调试性能（修复率、Fix@k、修复时间）未出现统计学显著的提升；(3)证实了主观体验与客观调试效果之间的"人机互补差距"；(4)MCQ得分与调试成功存在中等正相关（r_pb=0.368, p=0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论：(1)LLM生成错误信息虽然用户感知更好，但并未有效提升实际调试能力；(2)静态技能导向重写不足以提供充分的调试支持；(3)未来AI反馈系统应从静态技能分类转向基于用户实时修复轨迹的动态自适应调整；(4)提出应将主观可读性与客观行为效果结合评估的更严格标准。

title: Generation of Web Apps with Agentic IDEs: An Empirical Assessment
summary: Agentic IDEs are among the most significant innovations in software engineering, aiming to accelerate application development through LLM-based agents that can assist developers during development. However, their evaluation in end-to-end development tasks involving the generation of complete applications remains limited. To fill this gap, we propose a rigorous comparative analysis of three popular agentic IDEs (Copilot, Cursor, and Windsurf) in the generation of five full-stack Web applications from scratch. Results show high maturity in the generation of established patterns, such as CRUD operations and authentication features. In contrast, the generation of less common distributed architectures, such as a task queue architecture, produces significantly more errors. Overall, results show that Agentic IDEs cannot replace developers but shift their role toward building software by orchestrating LLM-based agents through natural-language instructions and iterative refinement. Yet, each agentic IDE shows its peculiarities, although differences are narrow.

AI.tldr: 该论文对三种主流的代理式IDE（Copilot、Cursor、Windsurf）进行严格的对比分析，通过从零生成五个全栈Web应用的端到端开发任务，评估其能力和差异。
AI.motivation: 代理式IDE（Agentic IDEs）是软件工程领域的重要创新，利用基于LLM的代理来辅助开发。然而，针对完整应用生成的端到端开发任务评估仍然有限，亟需填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 对Copilot、Cursor和Windsurf三种代理式IDE进行严格的比较分析，通过从零开始生成五个全栈Web应用程序进行端到端评估。
AI.result: 结果显示，代理式IDE在成熟模式（如CRUD操作和身份验证功能）的生成上表现出较高的成熟度。相比之下，对于不太常见的分布式架构（如任务队列架构），生成过程中会产生显著更多的错误。三者差异较窄，但每个代理式IDE都各有特点。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，代理式IDE无法完全取代开发者，但会将其角色转变为通过自然语言指令和迭代式优化来编排基于LLM的代理来构建软件。

title: Spike-Killer: Evidence-Gated LLM Assistance for Safe Performance Diagnosis on a Real Windows Workstation
comment: 6 pages. Experience report; no causal CS2 frame-time improvement or autonomous-safety claim is made
summary: LLM-assisted agents can synthesize system evidence, propose configuration changes, and automate diagnostic tasks, but their flexibility makes an imprecise action or an intrusive collector an operational risk. We present Spike-Killer, a human-approved workflow for diagnosing frame-time complaints on one real Windows workstation. The workflow treats each action as an evidence-gated transaction: it records the exact target state, classifies risk, preserves a snapshot, verifies a postcondition, and retains failed measurements as first-class evidence. This experience paper reports a completed same-day study with Counter-Strike 2 as a demanding target application. The evidence bundle contains preserved state snapshots, exploratory microbenchmarks, a ten-run same-state repeatability probe, live telemetry, a repaired over-broad registry action, incompatible presentation-capture attempts, an invalid local replay, and a system-level tracing replacement. Windows Performance Recorder produced two CS2 local-Bot GPU traces of 90.69 and 85.85 seconds; both were attributed to this http URL , exposed DxgKrnl Present metadata, and had zero lost ETW buffers or events. These results qualify trace integrity, not performance: the study reports no frame intervals, P99 estimate, or intervention effect. The contribution is an auditable, human-in-the-loop pattern for trustworthy agent assistance on a real workstation, including explicit stop conditions when evidence is insufficient.

AI.tldr: Spike-Killer 是一个面向单台 Windows 游戏本的人机协同（human-in-the-loop）性能诊断工作流，将 LLM 代理的每一步操作建模为"证据门控事务"。论文报告了一次同日的 CS2 帧时间故障排查经验，强调流程可行性与失败模式的可审计性,而不声称对帧时间存在因果改善。
AI.motivation: 普通 LLM 代理在真实机器上执行诊断/调优时具有操作风险:一条语法正确但目标解析错误的命令可能误删注册表键,一个侵入式采集器可能破坏被测负载或导致崩溃。现有性能"优化"清单缺少证据、回滚与可审计性,平均 FPS 还会掩盖尾延迟。论文动机是把 LLM 的灵活性装进一个安全约束的事务式工作流中,并明确区分"已支持"与"未支持"的结论。
AI.method: 方法分为三层:(1) 八阶段事务循环 Observe→Hypothesize→Classify→Snapshot→Act→Validate→Measure→Decide,每一步记录会话/动作 ID、目标、权限、回滚性、风险与后置条件;(2) 累积式干预层 B0–B4(基线→显示配置→关闭采集路径→后台清理→系统调优),每个层都有明确的后置条件检查;(3) 审计与权限边界:确定性控制器而非 LLM 本身负责目标解析、白名单校验、快照与回滚,LLM 仅在人类批准下生成假设与脚本。验证工具为 PowerShell 脚本(validate-wpr-trace.ps1 等),使用 Windows Performance Recorder 进行 GPU.light 追踪,并对 ETW 缓冲区、cs2.exe 归因与 DxgKrnl Present 元数据进行完整性校验。
AI.result: 已支持的(supported now):后台进程从 318 降至 221,可用内存增加 7.69 GB;10 次同状态重复探测显示 CPU SHA-256 与内存拷贝吞吐 CV 约 3%;一次 29.93 分钟的 CS2 Premier 实时比赛采样 864 个遥测点,无持续 GPU 饱和或显存耗尽证据;两次 WPR 本地 Bot 追踪分别为 90.69 s 与 85.85 s,均通过 ETW 完整性校验,零丢失缓冲/事件;操作者主观报告枪战卡顿消失。未支持的:未给出 P99 帧时间估算、无干预效应大小、无采集器无干扰证据、无自主安全评估。失败案例:一次 agent 辅助命令误删整条 Run 注册表键而非单一值,被后置条件检查发现并重建;PresentMon 2.5.1 多路径尝试均失败,ETW 丢包高达 32 万事件;一次替代采集器预检与 0x1E 内核 bugcheck 时序相关,无复现。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是可行性经验报告而非性能改善证明。Spike-Killer 的贡献在于可审计的人机协同模式、事务式安全保障、以及把失败案例本身当作一等证据。明确的下一步是冻结负载、把 WPR Present 事件链回帧间隔,然后再做受控重复实验以支持 P99 因果声明。在该受控实验完成之前,论文拒绝任何"LLM 降低 CS2 帧时间尖峰"或"代理可自主优化电脑"的结论。

title: On the Time and Frequency Domain Representations of Signals for CPS Specification
summary: Specification languages are instrumental to the Verification \& Validation of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs). Most state-of-the-art specification languages use the time-domain representation of signals, which is not always suitable for describing signal shapes and dynamic behaviours. Instead, fields like control and robotics use the frequency-domain representation to characterise these behaviours. Time-frequency representations combine the capabilities of both domains. We investigate the use of time-frequency representations to specify CPS requirements. We analyse existing taxonomies of CPS requirements to identify which requirement classes can benefit from time-frequency representations. We derive the desiderata for a specification language that uses time-frequency representations and propose Signal-Spectrum Temporal Logic (S2TL), a language enabling assertions over frequency intervals and relations between frequency components. We operationalise the S2TL semantics for monitoring CPS traces, and implement a monitor. We define specification templates for the identified requirement classes and compare time- and time-frequency-domain formulations in terms of applicability, expression fidelity, and noise tolerance of monitoring. We observe that, while time-domain specifications are applicable only to input traces containing step-like changes or using constant interpolation, time-frequency specifications extend their evaluation to traces generated through linear interpolation, and improve tolerance to offset and high-frequency noise, while achieving comparable fidelity to the intended system properties.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了时-频域信号表示在信息物理系统（CPS）需求规格说明中的应用。作者分析了现有CPS需求分类法，提出了一种基于时-频表示的新型规格说明语言S2TL（Signal-Spectrum Temporal Logic），通过实证对比证明时-频域规格说明在适用性、噪声容忍度方面优于传统的时域规格说明，同时在表达保真度上保持可比水平。
AI.motivation: 现有CPS规格说明语言（如STL）主要基于时域信号表示，难以自然地描述信号形状和动态行为（如振荡、过冲等），且规格说明与具体信号实现紧密耦合，对噪声敏感。控制理论和机器人学中广泛使用的频域表示虽能更好地刻画信号形状，但缺少时间局部性。作者旨在探索时-频域表示能否为CPS需求规格说明提供更合适的基础。
AI.method: 1. 分析现有CPS需求分类法（Kapinski等2016, Boufaied等2021），识别能受益于时-频表示的需求类（SP/OS/SS/RT/OV/ST）；2. 推导出对时-频规格说明语言的两个核心需求：(D1) 支持频域区间断言，(D2) 支持不同信号频域分量间的逻辑关系；3. 提出新语言S2TL（STL的扩展），其语法支持频域区间量词和频域分量间的逻辑谓词，使用STFT作为时-频变换；4. 在RTAMT工具中实现离散时间离线监控器；5. 为各需求类定义S2TL模板；6. 在无人机和轻型飞机两个CPS上对比STL*与S2TL，沿三个维度评估：适用性（RQ1）、表达保真度（RQ2，含精度与完备性）、监控噪声容忍度（RQ3，含偏移、白噪声、高频噪声）。
AI.result: RQ1（适用性）：S2TL规格说明适用于99-100%的输入轨迹（含线性插值轨迹），而STL*的step前置条件在无人机上仅适用于0-1%、在飞机上仅适用于10-17%的线性/交替插值轨迹。RQ2（保真度）：信号特征需求类（SP/OS）上S2TL明显优于STL*；步响应需求类上两者各有优劣——S2TL总体精度82.12% vs STL*的71.19%，完备性86.47% vs 70.00%。RQ3（噪声容忍度）：在偏移噪声和高频噪声下S2TL显著优于STL*；在白噪声下S2TL在多数需求类上仍优于或与STL*相当，仅RT上STL*更优。
AI.conclusion: 时-频域表示是传统时域表示的有价值补充，能显著扩展CPS步响应需求规格说明的适用范围（特别是对线性插值输入），并提高对偏移和高频噪声的监控鲁棒性，同时保持与时域相当的表达保真度。研究为需求挖掘、falsification测试和故障定位等SE活动提供了新方向，未来工作包括用户研究、GUI工具开发和在线监控器的实现。

title: The Substitution Escrow Threshold: When "Compatible With" Becomes Safe Enough to Buy
comment: 21 pages, 5 tables. Framework paper with worked public-record assessment; validation study is separate future work
summary: Enterprise infrastructure buyers routinely evaluate compatibility claims--"S3-compatible," "PostgreSQL-compatible," "OpenAI compatible"--as proxies for future substitution options. Yet most compatibility claims do not escrow the substitution path they imply. This paper introduces the Substitution Escrow Threshold, a five-condition framework that determines when a compatibility claim genuinely reduces institutional risk versus merely reducing first-integration cost. The five conditions--boundary closure, executable conformance, custody independence, state and operations reversibility, and extension quarantine--are applied to five infrastructure cases (OCI, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, S3, PostgreSQL) that populate five distinct outcome cells. The framework produces actionable diagnostics for enterprise architects, platform engineers, procurement teams, and investors evaluating compatibility-dependent infrastructure decisions, and identifies AI infrastructure as the framework's most urgent next application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"替代托管阈值"框架，用五项条件（边界闭合、可执行一致性、托管独立性、状态与运维可逆性、扩展隔离）评估"兼容 X"类声明是否真正构成机构层面的未来替代路径（退出权），还是仅降低首次集成成本。框架以 OCI、Kubernetes、OpenTelemetry、S3 与 PostgreSQL 五项案例填充五种机构结果，并预告 AI 基础设施兼容性为下一次压力测试。
AI.motivation: 企业采购、架构与投资决策中，普遍将"兼容"声明误读为可替代性（退出权）。作者认为既有话语（正式标准 vs 专有 API、基金会托管、API 兼容、采用率等同标准化）均无法区分"已托管"与"借用"两类兼容性，导致机构系统性高估供应商退出价值、低估真正的锁定风险。
AI.method: 建立五项可操作的判定条件，并为每项给出"操作测试"。构造 5×5 案例矩阵，将五个基础设施案例分别映射到五类机构结果之一。给出"分级锚点"（高/中/低），并以"受监管备份负载下 S3 兼容存储"作为端到端走查示例，最后以可证伪的预测与 AI 兼容性候选清单作为验证路径。
AI.result: 五案例与五结果：(1) OCI = 已托管兼容性（边界窄、独立治理、可执行认证）；(2) Kubernetes = 治理核心、外露边界（API 核心达标但托管服务外延依赖暴露）；(3) OpenTelemetry = 窄逃生舱（仪表化与遥测导出标准化，但不托管后端工作流）；(4) S3 兼容 = 借用兼容性（接口由 AWS 主导、缺少中立一致性项目）；(5) PostgreSQL 兼容 = 上手兼容性（协议/语法一致，但生产可替代性仍需工作负载级验证）。走查示例显示同一"S3 兼容"声明经 SET 评分降级为"按测试剖面授信"。AI 端点声明（OpenAI 兼容、MCP、K8s AI Conformance、向量库 API）被预测多落入借用/上手兼容性单元。
AI.conclusion: 兼容性不是软件属性，而是关于"未来决策"（退出权）的属性。只有当声明能够被边界化、被独立测试、由多方治理、状态与运维可迁移、并能被显式隔离扩展时，它才应被赋予采购级退出权信授。基金会应将一致性证据视为产品；采购按层级授信；投资者按机制差异估值；安全团队将兼容性边界用作控制边界。

title: Human-AI Collaboration in Requirements Engineering: Evidence of the Negative Effect of LLMs on Requirements Inspection
summary: Background. Requirements inspection (RI) is a well-established practice for detecting potential defects in requirements artifacts early in the software lifecycle. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have stimulated interest in their potential to support requirements engineering (RE) tasks. However, empirical evidence on the effects of LLMs when used as collaborative assistants in human-performed RI remains scarce. Aims. We aim to investigate the impact of LLM support on human-performed RI, considering inspection effectiveness in terms of smell identification and severity classification (i.e., nocuous vs innocuous), as well as inspection duration. Method. We conducted a controlled crossover design experiment with 34 participants, who inspected textual specifications with and without LLM support, identifying and classifying requirements smells while recording inspection time. We analyzed the data using one Bayesian regression model per outcome variable, accounting for validity threats induced by the crossover design as well as covariates and mediators. Results. Results show that LLM support negatively affects smell detection accuracy but has no significant effect on smell classification or task duration. A learning effect is present across experimental periods, but reduced when RI is first performed with LLM support. Conclusions. Our findings provide empirical evidence that LLM support does not necessarily improve performance and may, instead, hinder it for novice inspectors. Moreover, the results suggest that learning RI with LLM-support from the beginning may slow down the skill acquisition process, implying threats for LLM-supported learning.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对照交叉实验探究了LLM支持对人工需求检查(RI)的影响，发现LLM支持反而降低了气味检测准确率，且无益于分类准确性或任务时间，对新手检查员尤为不利，并可能减缓学习进程。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在需求工程中的应用引起广泛关注，但其在人工需求检查中作为协作助手时，对检查效果、效率和分类准确性的实证影响证据仍十分匮乏。需求检查是软件生命周期早期检测缺陷的关键实践，因此亟需系统评估LLM辅助的实际价值与潜在风险。
AI.method: 采用对照交叉实验设计(crossover design)，34名参与者分别在使用和不使用LLM支持的情况下检查文本规约，识别并分类需求气味(nocuous/innocuous)并记录时间。运用贝叶斯回归模型分析结果，考虑交叉设计带来的有效性威胁、协变量与中介变量。
AI.result: LLM支持对气味检测准确率产生负面影响，对气味严重性分类及任务时长无显著影响；实验期间存在学习效应，但若首次检查即采用LLM支持，学习效应会被削弱。
AI.conclusion: 实证证据表明LLM支持未必提升人工需求检查表现，反而可能损害新手检查员的绩效；研究提示从一开始就用LLM支持学习需求检查可能会延缓技能习得过程，对LLM辅助学习构成潜在威胁。

title: Beyond Fault Localization: A Trajectory-Level Study of LLM Agents for Microservice Root Cause Analysis
summary: Existing evaluations of automated root cause analysis (RCA) for microservices assess diagnostic performance mainly by endpoint correctness: whether a method localizes the responsible service. This criterion enables comparison but does not reveal the evidentiary basis of a diagnosis or the fault-propagation route connecting the source to observed symptoms, both of which an on-call site reliability engineer needs to judge whether action is warranted. We therefore treat RCA as an observable diagnostic process. Our trajectory-level framework evaluates agent executions against manually curated service-level fault-propagation paths. Applied to a public microservice RCA benchmark, it analyzes 3,500 diagnostic trajectories, characterizing where agents investigate and how they use retrieved telemetry. We find a disconnect between answer correctness and diagnostic quality: an agent may localize the fault source yet fail to reconstruct its propagation. Successful investigations stay on the fault-impact surface, act on retrieved evidence, and broaden their query repertoire as the search deepens. Failures arise when decisive evidence is omitted, retrieved evidence is misinterpreted, or unsupported inference substitutes for missing evidence. We operationalize this taxonomy as DiagGuard, a two-stage defense-in-depth architecture in which grounding surveys available observations before localization and verification audits the diagnosis against them. In an independent setting with a different model, benchmark, and service topology, DiagGuard raises Acc@1 from 43.5% to 52.5%. These results show that trajectory-level evaluation exposes limitations hidden by final-answer metrics and provides actionable guidance for improving automated RCA.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有微服务根因分析(RCA)评估仅看最终答案正确性、忽略诊断过程的问题，提出基于轨迹的评估框架，手工标注服务级故障传播路径作为过程级真值，分析3500条LLM Agent诊断轨迹，揭示"答案正确≠诊断质量高"的脱节现象，并将提炼出的失败模式落地为DiagGuard防御架构，在独立验证集上将Acc@1从43.5%提升至52.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化RCA评估以"是否定位到故障服务"这一终点指标为准，但该指标无法反映诊断的证据基础与故障传播路径，而这两点恰恰是SRE判断是否采取行动所必需的。同时，工具型LLM Agent的运行轨迹使诊断过程可观测，但缺乏过程级真值进行评估，因此需要一种轨迹级评估框架来揭示终点指标所掩盖的能力边界。
AI.method: (1) 在RCABench上手工标注500个案例的服务级故障传播图G*作为过程级真值；(2) 收集6个框架(ThinkDepth.ai、AIQ、TaskWeaver、ClaudeCode、OpenRCA、mABC)×2个骨干模型(Qwen、Sonnet)共3500条诊断轨迹；(3) 提出三类过程级指标：结果指标(Acc@1、Node F1、Edge F1)、行为视图(每轮主服务、导航转移、证据利用)、意图视图(11种SRE诊断意图+6个SQL派生标签轴)；(4) 通过对154条失败轨迹的开编码，提炼出三类证据处理失败家族(OMIT/MIS/GEN)；(5) 基于失败分类法设计DiagGuard双层防御架构(Grounder负责接地、Verifier负责审计)，并在AIOps 2025+Seed 2.0 Pro上进行独立验证。
AI.result: (1) 自适应、低约束框架优于紧编排设计(ThinkDepth.ai 79.2% vs mABC 42.6%)，骨干模型是主导杠杆(Sonnet 90.0% vs Qwen 79.2%)；(2) Edge F1始终远低于Node F1，故障传播边重建是更难且更具区分性的能力；(3) 失败运行消耗更多轮次且无收益；(4) Sonnet在54.3%轮次中真正利用前轮证据，而Qwen仅24.9%；(5) Qwen失败以"遗漏"为主，Sonnet失败以"误读"为主；(6) DiagGuard在独立设置下将Acc@1从43.5%提升至52.5%(+9.0pp)，pass@5从62.3%提升至73.0%，Grounder与Verifier贡献近似可加且互补。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级评估能够揭示终点指标所掩盖的Agent能力边界：答案正确性与诊断质量存在脱节，重建故障传播路径比定位根因服务更难，有效诊断是"留在故障影响面上、以证据为锚、随搜索深入扩展意图广度"的过程，失败则归因于证据遗漏、证据误读或无证据推理三类可枚举模式；从失败分类法蒸馏出的DiagGuard防御架构在异构骨干模型、数据集与拓扑上仍有效，证明过程级失败分析可作为改进自动化RCA的可操作依据。未来工作将轨迹标签转化为强化学习信号并瞄准更难、更贴近生产的故障场景。

title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests
comment: Accepted at the 20th International Symposium on Empirical Software Engineering and Measurement (ESEM 2026), Emerging Results, Vision, and Reflection Papers Track
summary: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, operating on both sides of the pull-request (PR) process: AI authoring agents create or modify PRs, while AI reviewers evaluate them. This creates a closed loop in which one AI coding agent reviews a contribution attributed to another. We construct a large-scale dataset of AI-to-AI code review by linking AI-attributed PRs with AI-attributed review events from CodAGE, a public dataset of coding-agent-generated GitHub events. Our dataset contains 248,641 unique AI-attributed PRs that received at least one AI-attributed review. Of these, 45,269 received cross-product review and 208,145 received same-product review; 4,773 PRs received both. Cross-product AI-to-AI review occurred in approximately 1.6% of identified agent-authored PRs but was substantial in absolute terms, and its volume increased by more than two orders of magnitude from 2025-Q1 to 2025-Q3. Reviewer output varied across author-reviewer configurations. CodeRabbit labeled 35.0% of its comments on Claude Code-authored PRs as refactor comments, compared with 10.5% on Copilot-authored PRs, although this difference may reflect characteristics of the PRs rather than the reviewer. For three of four dual-role reviewers, mean comments per PR were 58-65% higher in the same-product group, although effect sizes were small or negligible and the difference was concentrated in the upper tail. Among pairs with complete, nonnegative timestamps, the observed median latency was 1.2 minutes for cross-product pairs and 4.7 minutes for same-product pairs; differential timestamp availability and reviewer composition limit this comparison. Overall, closed-loop AI-to-AI review is increasing but remains a minority of identified agent activity, with review output varying across authoring-agent groups and product configurations.

AI.tldr: 论文基于 CodAGE 的大规模 GitHub 事件数据，构建了包含 248,641 个 AI 作者、AI 审阅者参与 PR 的 AI-to-AI 代码审查数据集。跨产品审查有 45,269 个 PR，虽仅占可识别 AI 作者 PR 的 1.6%，但增长超过两个数量级并已形成不可忽视的开发活动。分析发现，评论类别、平均评论数和首审延迟均随作者产品与同/跨产品配置变化；但这些观察性结果受签名归因、PR 上下文、审查者构成及时间戳缺失影响，不能据此推断代码质量或因果效应。
AI.motivation: 随着编码智能体同时承担 PR 创作和代码审查，GitHub 上出现可观测的“闭环”AI 审查生态。既有研究分别考察 AI 编程与 AI 审查，缺少对作者产品、审查产品及其配对关系的大规模实证刻画，因此论文研究其流行度、增长及审查行为差异。
AI.method: 研究使用 CodAGE 中 2024-01-01 至 2026-04-15 的公开 GitHub 事件，采用两层签名框架归因 AI 作者和 AI 审查者：S1 要求 PR 或评论正文中的产品签名，S2 接受正文签名或厂商控制的登录名；分支名不能单独作为证据。作者侧产生 2,830,284 个唯一 AI 作者 PR，审查侧涉及 12 个产品；随后按 PR 与审查者配对构建跨产品、同产品及无检测到 AI 审查的数据集。CodeRabbit 评论通过有序正则规则划分类别，使用比例检验、卡方检验、Mann–Whitney U、Cliff’s delta 和完整时间戳下的首审延迟进行描述性比较。
AI.result: 248,641 个 AI 作者 PR 获得至少一次 AI 审查，其中跨产品 45,269 个、同产品 208,145 个，4,773 个同时属于两类；跨产品占所有可归因 AI 作者 PR 的 1.6%，并由 2025-Q1 的 57 个增至 2025-Q3 的 25,492 个。OpenAI Codex 是主要作者，Copilot 是主要跨产品审查者。CodeRabbit 对 Claude Code 作者 PR 的重构评论占 35.0%，对 Copilot 为 10.5%，但关联效应较小且不能归因于作者产品。Copilot、Devin、亚马逊 Q 的同产品 PR 平均评论数比跨产品高 58%–65%，但 Cliff’s delta 仅 0.15、0.14、0.27，差异主要集中于长尾。完整且非负时间戳样本中，跨产品和同产品首审延迟中位数分别为 1.2 和 4.7 分钟，但审查者构成与时间戳可用性存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: AI-to-AI 代码审查虽仍是 AI 作者活动中的少数现象，却增长迅速、绝对规模较大，并已跨越多个产品。审查输出在作者产品和同/跨产品配置间存在差异；因此，在采样 GitHub PR、研究自动审查或解读 AI 反馈时，应显式记录作者与审查产品，不能将闭环审查视为单一流程，也不能把评论数量、类别或延迟当作正确性、质量或因果效应的代理。

title: Natural-Language Workflows Are Not Software Yet: Artifact-Driven Compilation for Reliable Agent Execution
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Natural-language workflows offer a software-like interface for agents: domain experts can write reusable procedures, and agents can execute them as instructions. This promise is not yet reliable. Workflow descriptions often leave data dependencies implicit, so the executor must infer which prior results a step should use; agents can also fail to follow long or branching instructions under context pressure. We propose Artic, an artifact-driven workflow compiler that transforms a natural-language workflow into an artifact-driven workflow in which each step declares the artifacts it reads and writes, constraints gate produced artifacts, and explicit control transfers route execution. This representation exposes the enforcement burden placed on agent execution, allowing the compiler to identify steps that depend on too much state or contain difficult control logic and refine them through constrained optimization. To validate the LLM-assisted transformation, Artic decomposes faithfulness checking into local obligations and uses scenario-based dry runs to test whether compiled workflow regions conform to the source workflow. We evaluate Artic on 488 problem instances from 11 real-world domain workflows; it improves task resolve rate by 28 percentage points over the original text workflow. We also show that workflows compiled by Artic are 32 and 56 percentage points more consistent in cross-model and repeated-execution setups, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Artic——一种基于 artifact-driven 编译的自然语言工作流编译器。它将自然语言工作流编译为显式声明读写 artifact、受约束控制转移的形式化工作流，通过约束优化降低 agent 执行负担，并通过归纳验证和基于场景的 dry-run 模拟确保忠实性。
AI.motivation: 自然语言工作流虽然为领域专家提供了软件化的接口，但存在两个可靠性问题：(1) 数据依赖隐式，agent 必须从上下文中推断哪些先前结果相关，容易出错；(2) 复杂控制流和长上下文使 agent 在执行时容易跳过步骤或误读条件。因此需要一种执行模型来暴露执行负担，并识别和优化困难的工作流区域。
AI.method: 1. 提出 artifact-driven workflow 语言：每个 step 声明读写 artifact、约束门控产出 artifact、显式控制转移路由执行；2. 形式化语义：将工作流执行建模为 artifact 状态上的变换；3. 约束优化目标：控制流复杂度（圈复杂度）、上下文压力、压缩压力（基于活跃变量分析）、artifact 成本；4. 忠实性验证：静态良构性检查（路径稳定性类型检查）、归纳验证（按语言结构分解为局部验证义务）、基于谓词覆盖的场景化 dry-run 模拟。
AI.result: 在 11 个真实领域工作流的 488 个问题实例上评估：Artic 将任务解决率提升 28 个百分点（文本工作流平均 56% → Artic 编译后 84%）；跨模型一致性提升 32 个百分点；重复执行一致性提升 56 个百分点（在 k=10 时，编译工作流 ~72% vs 文本工作流 ~16%）；agent 输入 token 平均减少 63%，输出 token 减少 50%；编译开销中位数 <5 分钟，平均成本 <$3。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言工作流易写但难执行。Artic 通过将其编译为 artifact-driven 形式，暴露中间状态、控制转移和验证义务，使运行时能够检查和强制执行 agent 是否忠实遵循工作流。验证结合了良构性检查、组合推理和场景化 dry-run，为该问题提供了一个实用且可验证的解决方案。

title: Bankruptcy Prediction via Hybrid Resampling and Stacking Ensemble Techniques with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)-Driven Analysis
summary: This study develops and evaluates a bankruptcy prediction framework that integrates consensus-based feature selection, hybrid resampling, stacking ensembles, and explainable artificial intelligence to improve minority-class detection in severely imbalanced financial data. Using the Taiwanese Bankruptcy Prediction dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, five feature-selection algorithms were first applied, and a consensus retention rule reduced the input space to 23 robust variables. The balanced training data were then generated using SVM-SMOTE, SMOTE-Tomek, and SMOTE-ENN. Five ensemble machine learning classifiers, namely gradient boosting, extreme gradient boosting, histogram-based gradient boosting, LightGBM, and AdaBoost, were compared with five deep learning models, including RNN, LSTM, GRU, DNN, and MLP. In addition, hybrid stacking ensembles combined the five machine learning classifiers as base learners with each deep learning model as a meta-learner. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, recall, specificity, G-mean, and ROC-AUC, while SHAP was used to explain feature contributions. The results show that resampling strategy materially shaped model behavior. SVM-SMOTE and SMOTE-Tomek favored accuracy and specificity, whereas SMOTE-ENN delivered stronger minority-class detection. Among standalone models, the GRU with SMOTE-ENN achieved the best overall predictive balance, with recall of 0.8627, G-mean of 0.8517, and ROC-AUC of 0.9431. Among stacking ensembles, SMOTE-ENN with (GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM provided the strongest compromise between sensitivity and specificity. SHAP analysis identified leverage, profitability, solvency, and operational efficiency indicators as the most influential predictors of bankruptcy risk. These findings support more reliable and interpretable early warning systems for financially distressed firms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对台湾破产预测数据集中严重的类别不平衡问题，构建了一个融合共识特征选择、混合重采样、堆叠集成与可解释AI的破产预测框架。研究发现SMOTE-ENN重采样结合GRU模型在少数类检测中表现最佳，而堆叠集成(GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM在灵敏度与特异度之间取得了最优平衡。SHAP分析揭示了杠杆、盈利、偿付能力和运营效率指标是破产风险的关键预测因子。
AI.motivation: 破产预测中面临严重的类别不平衡问题（少数类样本极少），且现有研究在特征选择的稳健性、模型可解释性以及集成策略方面存在不足。本文旨在开发一个兼顾预测性能与可解释性的早期破产预警系统。
AI.method: 1. 数据：使用UCI台湾破产预测数据集；2. 特征选择：采用五种特征选择算法，通过共识保留规则将特征缩减至23个稳健变量；3. 重采样：采用SVM-SMOTE、SMOTE-Tomek和SMOTE-ENN三种混合重采样方法；4. 模型：对比5种集成机器学习模型（GB、XGB、HGB、LightGBM、AdaBoost）与5种深度学习模型（RNN、LSTM、GRU、DNN、MLP），并构建以5种机器学习为基学习器、各深度学习为元学习器的堆叠集成；5. 评估指标：accuracy、recall、specificity、G-mean、ROC-AUC；6. 可解释性：采用SHAP分析特征贡献。
AI.result: 1. 重采样策略显著影响模型行为：SVM-SMOTE与SMOTE-Tomek倾向于提升accuracy和specificity，而SMOTE-ENN在少数类检测上更强；2. 独立模型中，GRU+SMOTE-ENN综合表现最佳（recall=0.8627, G-mean=0.8517, ROC-AUC=0.9431）；3. 堆叠集成中，SMOTE-ENN+(GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM在灵敏度与特异度之间提供最优权衡；4. SHAP分析表明杠杆、盈利、偿付能力和运营效率指标是最具影响力的破产预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了共识特征选择、混合重采样、堆叠集成与SHAP可解释性相结合的框架能够有效提升破产预测（尤其是少数类检测）的可靠性与可解释性，为构建财务困境企业的早期预警系统提供了有力支持。其中SMOTE-ENN重采样结合深度学习元学习器的堆叠集成架构表现尤为突出。

title: Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging for Adaptive Public Health Forecasting: Comparative Evaluation and an Ontario COVID-19 Case Study
summary: Public health forecasts must respond to abrupt changes in surveillance data without over-extrapolating noise, reporting artifacts, or temporary trends. We evaluated autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), random forest, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) models using 190 weekly observations of publicly available Ontario COVID-19 case counts from January 2020 to October 2023. Rolling-origin time-series cross-validation preserved temporal order during model tuning and evaluation. Performance was assessed across three operating dimensions: responsiveness following selected turning points, forecast horizons of one to six weeks, and the amount of historical training data. We also developed Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging (MLAMA), a non-negative performance-weighted ensemble with weights that vary by forecast horizon and responsiveness setting. Retrospective comparisons showed that ARIMA adapted rapidly after turning points but its normalized error increased at longer horizons. Random forest and XGBoost were less responsive initially but maintained more stable normalized error over longer horizons. For two-week forecasts at the end of the study period, training on the most recent data outperformed using longer historical periods, particularly for XGBoost. MLAMA achieved the lowest normalized mean absolute percentage error across most forecast horizons and ranked among the best-performing methods across responsiveness settings. These findings support selecting forecasting models according to operating conditions rather than relying on a single universally preferred approach. MLAMA provides a practical framework for combining complementary statistical and machine-learning forecasts. The accompanying Python package is currently maintained in a private repository while software validation and reproducibility testing are completed.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对公共卫生预测中如何应对监测数据突变而不过度外推噪声的难题,系统比较了ARIMA、随机森林和XGBoost三种模型在响应速度、预测时长和训练数据量三个维度上的表现,并据此开发了MLAMA(机器学习与ARIMA模型平均)集成框架。研究以加拿大安大略省190个周观测COVID-19病例数据为基础,采用滚动起点交叉验证。结果显示ARIMA响应快但长时段误差大,机器学习模型相反;近期训练数据优于纳入历史数据;MLAMA在多数预测时长和响应设置下误差最低。研究支持按运行条件选择模型而非追求单一最优模型,并将方法封装为Python包,目前因验证尚未完成处于私有仓库阶段。
AI.motivation: 公共卫生预测需同时应对监测数据中的结构性突变与噪声、报告偏差和临时性趋势,单一模型难以兼顾响应速度与长时段稳定性。作者旨在打破"寻找一个通用最优模型"的思路,转向依据运行条件进行模型选择与组合,以提升实际公共卫生监测中的预测可靠性。
AI.method: (1)数据:加拿大安大略省2020年1月至2023年10月共190周的COVID-19聚集病例数,划分为三个分析期。(2)候选模型:ARIMA、随机森林(自回归式)、XGBoost(自回归式)。(3)验证策略:滚动起点时间序列交叉验证,12个扩展训练窗口,12周固定验证块,在每个窗口内进行超参数调优。(4)优化目标:均方相对误差(MSRE)。(5)评估维度:响应速度(转折点后纳入观测数r=1…4)、预测时长(h=1…6周)、训练历史深度。(6)评估指标:MAPE及跨期最小-最大归一化nMAPE。(7)集成方法MLAMA:以非负权重约束、权重和为1,在(h,r)条件下通过最小化滚动样本外MSRE求得权重矩阵。(8)软件:封装为Python包,含候选模型配置、滚动窗口构建、超参数优化、权重估计、最终预测与维护五步操作。
AI.result: (1)响应性:ARIMA在转折点后误差快速下降,适应方向变化能力强;随机森林和XGBoost变化平缓,稳定性高。(2)预测时长:长时段下ARIMA归一化误差上升更陡,机器学习模型较平缓。(3)训练历史:在第三分析期后的两周预测中,仅用最近一期训练优于纳入更早数据,XGBoost在合并第二、三期时恶化明显。(4)MLAMA:在所绘制的预测时长范围内nMAPE最低且增长平缓;在多数响应设置下处于最低误差方法之列,避免了XGBoost的中间峰。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持"按运行条件选模型"的公共卫生预测理念,反对依赖单一通用模型。MLAMA提供了一种将统计与机器学习互补优势进行结构化组合的框架,通过预测时长和响应条件特定的非负权重实现集成,在安大略回顾性案例中表现优于各候选模型。Python包将方法工程化为可复现的滚动工作流,但在全面软件与统计验证完成前不公开。研究局限包括:仅基于单一省级COVID-19聚集序列;周期及转折点为回顾性定义;nMAPE和MAPE在零附近不稳定;未量化预测不确定性。下一步计划包括锁定计算环境再分析、与简单平均等基线对比、外部序列评估、概率预测组合、自动模型维护、时序异常检测及空间聚类工作流。

title: Wrong-Physics Backdoors in Neural PDE Operators
summary: Neural PDE operators are increasingly trained on reusable solver archives, yet validation often relies on clean prediction error and parameter-agnostic plausibility checks. We introduce cross-parameter relinking, a data-poisoning primitive that makes a triggered input select a valid solution from the same PDE family under an incorrect physical parameter. We term this a wrong-physics backdoor: the output remains physically plausible but is wrong for the intended parameter. The attack exploits tensor-to-parameter provenance failures in multi-parameter archives by stamping the surrogate input and relinking its supervision to a cached alternate-parameter solution for the same latent sample. Across 476 attack campaigns, we evaluate Burgers, advection-diffusion, two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, and an elliptic Poisson case. Fourier Neural Operators and DeepONet provide the primary evidence, with Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models as support. FNO reaches a backdoor success rate of 1.0000 on both advection-diffusion and two-dimensional Navier-Stokes while retaining low clean relative L2 error. Clean-label, label-only, and shuffled controls show that high attack success alone is insufficient: successful attacks must move predictions toward the intended alternate-physics target while preserving bounded clean error. These results expose a structural validation gap: smoothness or generic solver-like behavior is insufficient unless the provenance of the intended physical parameter is also verified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对神经PDE算子的新型数据投毒攻击——"错误物理后门"（wrong-physics backdoor），通过跨参数重链接（cross-parameter relinking）利用多参数求解器存档中张量与物理参数之间的溯源缺陷，使触发输入切换到同一PDE族下错误物理参数的有效解，同时保持低干净误差并绕过参数无关的合理性检查。
AI.motivation: 随着神经PDE算子越来越多地从可复用的求解器存档中训练，数据供应链成为信任边界的一部分。然而，现有验证方法主要依赖聚合干净误差和参数无关的合理性检查，未能审计每个样本的"预期物理参数"是否被忠实保留。这构成了一个结构性的验证缺口。攻击者可以滥用存档中已存在的同潜伏样本的交替参数解，实施样本匹配的条件参数族切换后门，威胁下游科学ML应用（如气动优化、天气预报、参数估计等）。
AI.method: 提出"跨参数重链接"投毒原语：攻击者在不改变训练算法的前提下，控制α比例的训练对，对输入张量施加局部高斯触发𝒯，并将监督标签重链接为同一潜伏样本z在另一物理参数λ_bd下的解𝒢_{λ_bd}(z)。设计五类数据处理模式（parameter-switch、clean-label、label-only、shuffled-backdoor、shuffled-label-only）以分离触发效应、无条件错误标签和样本失配。提出基于共同尺度的评估协议，使用BSR、干净L2误差、到后端/干净目标的误差及margin）共同判定成功，避免单一BSR指标的误导。涵盖Burgers、平流-扩散、2D Navier-Stokes及椭圆Poisson四类PDE，主要算子为FNO与DeepONet，Transformer/GRU/LSTM作为支撑架构，共476次攻击实验矩阵。
AI.result: FNO在对流-扩散（BSR 1.0000，干净L2 0.0034，margin 0.8704）和2D Navier-Stokes（BSR 1.0000，干净L2 0.0189，margin 0.0374）上均达到完美参数族切换；DeepONet在对流-扩散上也达到BSR 1.0000。干净标签对照几乎完全失败（BSR≈0），标签仅对照和乱序对照均无法解释成功案例。预算阈值探测表明低投毒比例和触发尺度下BSR接近零，随预算增加单调上升至1。验证差距审计显示，即使触发的输出在某个候选PDE参数族下看起来物理合理，其最近族仍是后门族而非声明的干净族，触发预期参数检查告警。椭圆Poisson案例作为目标接近度证据被移至附录。
AI.conclusion: 错误物理后门揭示了科学ML中结构性的验证缺口：神经PDE代理在多参数存档下训练时，光滑性或通用求解器相似性不足以证明正确性，必须验证样本级预期物理参数的溯源。仅靠聚合干净误差和残差检查可被绕过。有效的防御需要样本级意图参数审计、签名/校验和元数据绑定以及版本化的求解器参数记录；这些构成纵深防御，但若签名链本身被攻陷则不再充分。未来工作包括频域/输入感知/动态触发、激活级机制审计以及在更大规模生产级存档上的验证。

title: Shared Physics Responses Recover Hidden Rankings in Neural Operator Libraries
summary: Selecting the optimal neural-operator prediction during deployment is challenging when high-fidelity reference solutions are unavailable. We demonstrate that under a squared Hilbert-space loss, ranking a finite model library depends strictly on the low-dimensional span of candidate differences, allowing us to score all models simultaneously using a single anchor-based linearized response of the governing equation. This shared physical diagnostic accurately recovered over 99.6\% of pairwise preferences and 99.0\% of optimal checkpoints across diverse Fourier and convolutional operator libraries for fluid, reaction-diffusion, and wave dynamics. Furthermore, the corrected physical proxy frequently outperformed the best individual candidates, and we establish computable sufficient conditions that rigorously certify exact decisions for strongly monotone discretizations. By exploiting the local dynamical response rather than raw defect magnitude, this framework enables the reliable and highly efficient deployment of scientific surrogates without requiring ground-truth data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于共享物理响应的参考无关框架，利用单一锚点线性化物理求解同时对有限候选库（神经算子）进行排序，在无高保真参考解的情况下恢复候选排序。
AI.motivation: 部署神经算子时通常无法获得高保真参考解，无法判断多个模型中哪个最优；现有诊断方法（残差、后验估计、集成统计）针对整体误差而非候选排序。本文旨在仅利用物理方程和候选预测，恢复有限库的隐藏排序。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明：在平方Hilbert损失下，有限库排序仅依赖于候选差值的低维子空间D（维度≤N−1），并给出该最小有界线性观测的刻画；2) 构造一个参考无关锚点w，对锚点施加一次线性化物理校正s=w+δw，映射到任务空间得共享代理q，通过‖q−Q_a(v_i)‖²同时为所有候选打分；3) 对强单调反应-扩散离散格式，基于残差给出全局误差界与可计算决策证书。
AI.result: 在FNO/CNO库（流体、反应-扩散、波动）的1920个输入-库组合中，共享代理恢复99.6%的非平局两两偏好与99.0%的最优检查点；代理有时优于所有候选（反应-扩散100%配对恢复）；1次共享求解≈N次候选求解（N=16时快约16倍）；在算子-数据失配的二维可压缩流探测中10/10比较正确但直接使用仅4/10优于最优候选；强单调证书在672对中所有边界-间距比<0.095。
AI.conclusion: 排序所需信息远少于完整解重构；共享物理响应可同时替代参考解完成神经算子的查询级路由与面板级模型选择，但受候选间距、锚点构造与物理可容许性约束；对强单调离散可获得严格决策证书。

title: Stored in Optimizer State, Valued by Later Training: A Causal Account of Subliminal Trait Transfer
summary: Subliminal trait transfer allows a student model to acquire behavioral dispositions from teacher-generated data in which the trait is not semantically expressed. Recent work explains how such signals enter gradients, but not how they survive source removal or acquire different signs under later training. We treat parameters and optimizer moments as a single trainer state and derive an exact transport-valuation identity separating observer-independent propagation of the source perturbation from the value assigned by a future continuation and behavioral readout. State surgery identifies the first moment as a causal carrier. Transplanting it alone leaves parameters, hidden states, and outputs unchanged at the cut, yet source-free updates generate growing parameter and hidden-state differences; transplanting parameters with the first moment recovers the terminal behavioral response. Sending the same source-induced difference through matched futures produces negative, near-zero, and positive Qwen effects (-0.658, +0.008, and +0.658 seed means). This ordering recurs in all 12 Llama-3.2-1B seeds after eight updates, while state-difference norms remain nearly equal across routes. Both contrasts grow in every paired seed when the continuation extends to sixteen updates. A full-horizon costate predicts all 42 Qwen route-mean signs and all 21 resolved Llama ordinary-route signs. Observer-independent transport also replicates across Qwen, SmolLM2, and Llama, while the complete-state recurrence predicts physical, hidden, and fixed-head responses in non-LoRA MNIST systems, including CNNs trained with AdamW and momentum SGD. Together, these results identify a two-stage mechanism for subliminal trait transfer: optimizer state transports the source perturbation, and later training determines its behavioral value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了潜隐特质迁移(subliminal trait transfer)中源信号在训练器状态中的存活与表达机制。作者将参数与优化器动量视为统一训练器状态，推导出一个精确的传输-估值恒等式(transport-valuation identity)，将观察者无关的源扰动传播与未来训练赋予的行为价值分离开来。状态外科实验表明，AdamW的一阶动量(m)是因果载体：仅移植m在切点处对参数和隐藏状态无影响，但后续无源更新会生成增长的差异；而参数加m可恢复终端行为响应。同一源谱系在不同未来路径下可产生负、零、正的行为效应(Qwen种子均值-0.658, +0.008, +0.658)，该排序在所有12个Llama-3.2-1B种子中复现。全视界余状态(costate)预测器正确预测了Qwen全部42条路径均值符号及Llama全部21条已分辨路径符号。
AI.motivation: 先前工作解释了潜隐信号如何进入学生模型的梯度，但未能说明：(1)信号在源数据移除后如何存活；(2)为什么相同源信号在不同后续训练下会产生不同符号的行为效应。本文旨在填补这一机制空白。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1)将完整训练器状态S=(w,m,v,τ)建模为离散动力系统；(2)对完整状态施加离散时间伴随(adjoint)灵敏度分析，推导出传输-估值响应恒等式(Eq.6)；(3)状态外科(state surgery)：在不同状态块(w, m, v)间进行移植/重置/救援实验；(4)匹配源×路径析因实验：让相同源谱系通过不同未来路径以分离传输与估值；(5)全视界余状态预测器Δ̂_R = p_E^R(0)⊤A_E。验证涵盖Qwen2.5-0.5B、SmolLM2-135M、Llama-3.2-1B及非LoRA的MNIST系统，测试AdamW与动量SGD。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1)一阶动量m是因果载体——m单独移植在切点处零效应，源释放后产生增长的后代；w+m恢复全部终端行为(SSE/ZERO=0.005–0.006物理，0.002–0.003隐藏)，在14/14种子中均优于其他子集；(2)相同源谱系在不同路径下产生-0.658、+0.008、+0.658的Qwen效应，三种路径排序在所有12个Llama种子中复现(Holm调整p=0.000488)；(3)全视界余状态预测器在Qwen 42条路径和Llama 21条已分辨路径上全部正确预测符号；(4)观察者无关的传输在三种架构上复现(SSE/ZERO≤3×10⁻³)；(5)五类特质(owl, blue, cat, red, oak)的传输拓扑一致；(6)非LoRA MNIST CNN在AdamW和动量SGD下均验证完整状态预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了潜隐特质迁移的两阶段机制：优化器状态负责传输源扰动，后续训练决定其行为价值。响应恒等式、状态外科与余状态预测使传输与估值在跨架构(语言模型与视觉模型)、跨优化器(AdamW与动量SGD)、跨特质类型下可分别度量。核心结论是：同一物理谱系可被持久传输，但行为价值随未来路径而变化——训练器记住的内容与模型最终表达的内容是可分离的。

title: Amortized Bandwidth Learning for Kernel Density Estimation under Logarithmic Score
summary: Kernel density estimation converts finite samples into probability densities, but its performance depends critically on bandwidth selection. Classical selectors prescribe the sample-to-bandwidth rule analytically or asymptotically, or solve a new optimization for each sample. An amortized framework is proposed that instead learns this mapping across a distribution of density-estimation tasks by optimizing the logarithmic score. A truncated-and-renormalized bounded-support formulation enables stable learning across heterogeneous tasks, while affine standardization allows a selector trained on a single reference interval to transfer across bounded intervals. Experiments under Gaussian sampling, a multi-family benchmark, and randomized Gaussian-mixture training show that the amortized selector consistently and substantially outperforms Silverman's rule, the Sheather--Jones selector, and least-squares cross-validation, with especially large gains in small and heterogeneous samples. Finite Gaussian mixtures provide a generic training mechanism supported by their $L^1$ approximation property. Selectors trained in this way generalize strongly across different density structures, allowing the same trained selector to be applied directly to finite samples from unknown densities without specifying or fitting a distributional family. This combination of broad applicability and strong empirical performance makes the framework attractive for a wide range of applications in which finite samples or ensembles must be converted into continuous probability densities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对数分数（logarithmic score）的摊还（amortized）带宽选择框架，用于高斯核密度估计（KDE）。通过学习样本到带宽的映射替代传统解析或每样本优化方法，结合截断重归一化的有界支撑公式与仿射标准化实现跨任务稳定学习与跨区间迁移。实验表明该方法在高斯采样、多族基准及随机高斯混合训练下均显著优于 Silverman 规则、Sheather-Jones 选择器和最小二乘交叉验证，尤其在小样本和异质样本中优势更为明显。
AI.motivation: 传统带宽选择方法（Silverman 规则、Sheather-Jones 插件法、最小二乘交叉验证）依赖解析渐近公式或逐样本数值优化，无法利用跨任务的系统性变化来学习样本特征与最优带宽之间的关系，且通常基于积分平方误差而非概率评分准则。
AI.method: 构建摊还带宽预测器 h_θ(S)=F_θ(feat(S))，以 MLP 实现，特征包括样本量、均值、标准差、偏度、峰度；训练目标为有界支撑下的对数分数期望 J_Π(θ)；采用截断重归一化处理防止低密度远端罕见观测主导训练；通过仿射标准化将任意有界区间映射至参考区间 [-1,1]，依据 Proposition 1 的带宽线性重标实现跨区间迁移；利用有限高斯混合的 L¹ 逼近性质作为通用训练任务生成机制。
AI.result: 三类实验（高斯采样、有界多族基准、有界 GMM 基准）一致显示摊还选择器在所测试样本量范围内均获得最低经验对数分数，在小样本和异质样本中优势最大；GMM 训练的选择器在多族基准上表现接近多族训练选择器，反之亦然，验证了跨分布泛化能力；性能对 GMM 组分数 K∈{8,16,32} 不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 摊还带宽选择框架通过对数分数直接优化带宽规则，结合有界支撑公式与仿射标准化实现稳定高效的跨任务学习；有限高斯混合可作为通用训练任务源，无需显式枚举分布族；该方法在小样本和异质样本中优势突出，适用于将有限样本或集合转化为连续概率密度的广泛应用场景；未来可扩展至更丰富特征、替代核、局部自适应带宽与多维密度估计。

title: Mutual information and sensitivity analysis for feature selection in customer targeting: a comparative study
summary: Feature selection is a highly relevant task in a data-driven knowledge discovery project. Several techniques have been developed aiming at finding the features that influence most an outcome to predict, including mutual information and, in recent years, the data-based sensitivity analysis. The present research focus on analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of each of these two techniques, by applying both to a bank telemarketing case. Thereafter, a logistic regression model is built on the tuned set of features identified by each of the two techniques as the most influencing set of features on the success of a telemarketing contact, in a total of 13 features for mutual information and 9 features for the data-based sensitivity analysis. The latter performs better for lower values of false positives while the former is slightly better for a higher false positive ratio. Thus, mutual information becomes a better choice if bank managers intend to reduce slightly the cost of contacts without risking losing a high number of successes. Such results show that mutual information, although not recent, is still a valid method for feature selection. On the other side, the data-based sensitivity analysis selection achieved good prediction results with less features.

AI.tldr: 本文针对银行电话营销场景，对互信息（MI）与数据驱动敏感性分析（DSA）两种特征选择方法进行对比研究，基于UCI银行营销数据集（41,188条记录）开展实验。结果表明MI选出13个特征、DSA选出9个特征；在低假阳性场景下DSA更优，而在高假阳性场景下MI略优；MI计算更快且无需预建模型，适合大数据集与低成本接触场景。
AI.motivation: 特征选择在数据挖掘项目中至关重要，直接影响模型性能与计算效率。然而现有研究鲜有对MI与DSA两种方法在客户定向任务中的直接比较，难以指导实践中的方法选择。
AI.method: 基于UCI银行营销数据集（41,188条电话营销记录，20个特征），分别采用互信息（MI）与数据驱动敏感性分析（DSA）进行特征选择，使用10折交叉验证模拟滑动窗口，选用简单逻辑回归模型进行预测，通过ROC曲线与混淆矩阵（截止概率0.5与0.1）评估预测性能，并比较计算时间。MI通过信息论去除冗余特征，DSA通过同步扰动输入特征评估模型敏感性。
AI.result: MI选出13个特征，DSA选出9个特征；在低假阳性区域DSA表现更优，在高假阳性区域MI略优；MI计算仅需数秒，DSA需约半分钟；MI在截止概率0.5时预测成功联系更准（TP更多），DSA则在预测失败联系上更准；MI能有效识别并去除冗余变量（如cons.price.idx、default、previous）。
AI.conclusion: MI虽为传统方法，但在特征选择中仍具有竞争力，特别适用于接触成本低、追求捕捉成功客户的场景；DSA在减少误报、降低呼叫次数方面更佳，适合对成本敏感的场景。研究为银行营销管理者根据业务目标选择合适特征选择方法提供了实证依据。

title: When Clean Data Hurts: Learning with Monotone Corruptions Beyond Binary Classification
summary: Optimal learners are tailored to exploit the i.i.d.\ data assumption underlying the classic PAC model. What if an i.i.d.\ training sample were corrupted with correctly labeled examples drawn from an otherwise unrelated, even adversarial source? This model of learning with monotone adversarial corruptions was recently introduced by Larsen et al. (2026), who demonstrated that all known optimal binary learners suffer increased error rates in this setting, from $O(d / n)$ in the PAC model to $\Omega (d \log(n / d) / n)$ under monotone corruption. Mehrotra (2026) proved this logarithmic factor to be necessary for binary classification, but left open the consequences of corruption for more general learning settings, such as multiclass classification and partial binary concept classes. As our primary result, we demonstrate that monotone adversaries are frighteningly more powerful in each of these settings. We exhibit a learnable multiclass problem, of DS dimension only 2, that becomes altogether unlearnable under a monotone adversary, and show an analogous result for partial binary concept classes. These results are achieved by an adaptive adversary permitted to view the original i.i.d.\ training set $S$ and to insert $b < \infty$ corrupted datapoints into $S$. In the multiclass example, the adversary need only insert a linear number $b = |S| = n$ of datapoints. We complement these impossibility results by proving that every class remains learnable when the number of adaptive additions is $o(n)$, which our previous multiclass lower bound proves to be tight. We further observe that the classic multiclass error rate of $O(d_{\mathrm{DS}} / n)$ remains achievable against adaptive adversaries restricted to a known constant budget $b = O(1)$, against semi-adaptive adversaries viewing only a $p$-fraction of $S$ for $p \in (0, 1)$, and against oblivious adversaries that cannot view $S$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"单调对抗性腐败"（monotone adversarial corruptions）条件下的可学习性，即i.i.d.训练集中可能被插入来自任意（甚至对抗性）源的正确标记样本。作者证明，对于多分类和部分二分类概念类，单调对手比二分类情况下强大得多——即使DS维度仅为2的多分类问题也会变得完全不可学习，且仅需线性数量b=n的对抗性插入即可。同时，作者证明当对抗性插入数量为o(n)时，所有概念类仍然可学习，从而证明该阈值是紧的。此外，对于受限于常数预算b=O(1)的自适应对手、仅查看S的p比例的半自适应对手以及无法查看S的非自适应对手，经典的多分类错误率O(d_DS/n)仍然可以达到。
AI.motivation: 经典PAC模型假设训练数据是i.i.d.的，但现实中训练集可能被注入来自无关来源的正确标记样本。Larsen等（2026）最近提出的"单调对抗性腐败"模型刻画了这一情形。Mehrotra（2026）已证明对二分类而言存在不可避免的log(n/d)因子，但更一般的学习场景（多分类、部分二分类概念类）下的影响尚未可知。本文正是要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 通过构造性下界证明存在DS维度仅为2的可学习多分类问题在单调对手下变得不可学习，多分类示例仅需b=n的线性插入；2) 对部分二分类概念类给出类似的下界构造；3) 证明当对抗性插入数b=o(n)时，所有概念类仍然可学习（通用上限）；4) 对受限对手（常数预算b=O(1)的自适应对手、p比例半自适应对手、非自适应对手）证明经典O(d_DS/n)错误率仍然可以达到。
AI.result: 主要结果表明单调对手在多分类和部分二分类设置中比二分类中"可怕地更强大"：DS维度仅为2的多分类问题在b=n的插入下完全不可学习；b=o(n)时被证明为紧的阈值；在受限对手模型下（常数预算自适应、半自适应、非自适应），经典的多分类错误率O(d_DS/n)仍然可以实现。这些结果完整刻画了单调腐败下多分类可学习性的边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了单调对抗性腐败下多分类和部分二分类概念类的可学习性图景：1) 在强大的自适应对手下，即便是最简单的可学习问题也可能变得不可学习；2) b=o(n)是该现象的紧阈值；3) 但在受限对手（常数预算或半自适应或非自适应）下，标准的PAC保证仍然成立。这些结果揭示了单调腐败对广义学习设置造成的根本性挑战，显著区别于二分类情形。

title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities
summary: AI tools increasingly support tasks across the scientific research cycle, from experiment design and manuscript preparation to peer review. At the same time, the continuing growth in conference submissions has increased the burden on meta-reviewers, who must synthesize reviewer feedback, author rebuttals, and manuscript revisions. To address this concern, this paper introduces Metag, a dataset to accelerate the development of meta-reviewing agents, specifically to identify changes made to scientific articles during the review-rebuttal process. Each instance contains a reviewer concern, the author's proposed resolution, and the manuscript diffs implementing the stated change. Metag is collected by obtaining manuscript versions from before the review deadline and after acceptance, computing differences between the two documents, and asking human annotators to align these differences with action items from OpenReview discussions. The resulting dataset consists of 349 high-quality action items tied to paper differences and will enable building methods to empower meta reviewers to quickly identify whether authors have addressed reviewer statements and where in the paper those changes have been made, resulting in additional transparency and traceability throughout peer review. The dataset is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Metag 数据集，旨在支持构建辅助 meta-reviewer 的智能体。该数据集将 OpenReview 上 ICLR 2024 的评审-作者讨论中的行动项（action item）与论文原稿和最终版（camera-ready）之间的文本差异（diffs）相关联，共包含 349 条高质量人工标注样本。实验表明，基于 LLM 的分类方法优于词法检索基线，但整体任务仍具挑战性，最优模型 GPT-5.6-Sol 在测试集上仅达到约 0.36 的 micro-F1。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 顶会投稿量持续增长，meta-reviewer 面临从大量评审、作者回复和论文修订中综合信息的繁重任务。现有的 NLP 工具虽能辅助评审摘要，但缺乏将评审关切与论文具体修订内容相连接的可追溯性（traceability），导致无法有效验证作者是否真正落实了承诺的修改。
AI.method: 数据集构建采用六阶段流水线：(1) 通过 OpenReview API 抓取 ICLR 2024 已接收论文及其评审-作者对话；(2) 利用 Semantic Scholar 关联 arXiv 预印本，获取送审前版本；(3) 使用 PyMuPDF 与 Git histogram diff 算法计算两版本 PDF 间的结构化差异；(4) 用 Gemma-3-27B-IT 提取对话中的行动项（评论-回复对）；(5) 由人工标注员在自研的并排 PDF diff 标注界面中筛选行动项并链接到对应 diff；(6) 两位标注员独立标注，取交集构建最终数据集。任务定义为从约 1000 个候选 diff 中选择与给定行动项相关的 diff 集合。方法上对比了 BM25/TF-IDF 词法检索基线、Gemma-3-27B-IT 的零样本/LoRA 微调/嵌入分类，以及 GPT-5.6-Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Kimi-K2.5 等大模型在候选窗口内的选择能力。
AI.result: 数据集共 349 条样本（训练 248/验证 41/测试 60），覆盖 137 篇论文，平均每条样本约 6.66 个相关 diff。标注员间完全一致率 37%，平均 Jaccard 相似度 50.1%，Cohen's κ 为 0.369。实验结果显示：词法基线表现较差（micro-F1 < 0.11）；GPT-5.6-Sol 在测试集取得最佳 micro-F1 = 0.360（macro-F1 = 0.398），精度与召回较平衡；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在验证集表现最强但波动大；零样本 Gemma 严重过选导致精度极低。所有方法都表明仅靠表面词法匹配无法解决该任务。
AI.conclusion: Metag 是首个将评审对话行动项与论文版本间具体修订差异大规模对齐的数据集，规模超过既有工作（ARIES 仅 131 条）。该数据集为构建可追溯、可验证的人机协同 meta-reviewing 智能体奠定了基础。当前局限在于仅覆盖 ICLR 2024，且依赖 arXiv 预印本作为送审前版本，未来工作将扩展至更多会议、年份与学科领域。

title: Bern2Edge: A Neurosymbolic Compiler for Edge Deployment via Bernstein Polynomial Networks
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at CODES+ISSS 2026, TCAD journal 2026
summary: Deploying high-accuracy neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging, as existing approaches treat training, compression, and hardware synthesis as separate stages, leaving a gap between software-trained models and efficient end-to-end deployment with limited support for interpretability. We propose Bern2Edge, an end-to-end framework that uses knowledge distillation to convert a pretrained teacher feed-forward network into hardware-efficient representations via Bernstein polynomial activations. This representation enables two deployment paths: (i) a high-fidelity LUT-based realization that preserves model fidelity under compression, and (ii) a symbolic rule-based representation derived from Bernstein activation geometry, enabling interpretable inference with explicit input-space constraints. The resulting BNNs achieve up to 2.12 percentage-point (pp) accuracy improvement over ReLU under identical compression constraints. At the system level, Bern2Edge achieves up to 99.8% latency reduction and 95.2% BRAM reduction relative to a W8A8 quantized teacher on an AMD Xilinx KV260 FPGA, while maintaining accuracy within 0.5 pp, and further deploys on a low-power Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA. The rule-based path reduces DSP usage by up to 89.0% at a cost of 1.5 pp in total accuracy.

AI.tldr: Bern2Edge 是一个端到端的神经符号编译框架，通过知识蒸馏将预训练前馈网络转换为基于 Bernstein 多项式激活的紧凑 BNN，并提供两种 FPGA 部署路径：基于查找表（LUT）的高保真实现和基于激活几何的可解释符号规则提取。在 AMD Xilinx KV260 上实现高达 99.8% 的延迟降低和 95.2% 的 BRAM 降低，同时在压缩下相比 ReLU 提升最多 2.12 pp 精度。
AI.motivation: 现有边缘部署方法将训练、压缩和硬件综合视为独立阶段，导致软件训练模型与高效端到端部署之间存在鸿沟，且对可解释性支持有限。边缘设备在严格延迟和资源预算下部署高精度神经网络面临挑战，需要透明度以满足可靠性要求。
AI.method: 提出 Bern2Edge 框架：(1) 通过知识蒸馏将教师 DNN 训练为使用 Bernstein 多项式激活的紧凑学生 BNN；(2) LUT 路径——利用 Bernstein 激活的固定归一化域 [0,1] 和线性插值实现精确的每神经元查找表实现；(3) 符号规则路径——从 Bernstein 激活几何中解析提取断点（导数根和拐点），映射到输入空间的仿射约束，结合级联贪心覆盖选择并通过稀疏化和 INT8 量化优化规则集；(4) CART 作为未匹配样本的回退策略。还将其扩展到 TinyBERT4 transformer 的 FFN 子层（使用 15 阶 Bernstein）。
AI.result: BNN 在所有架构-数据集组合上 consistently 优于 ReLU，精度提升 +0.25 到 +2.12 pp。端到端 LUT 路径在 KV260 上相比 W8A8 教师基线降低 91.9–99.8% 延迟、27.4–74.7% DSP、94.0–95.2% BRAM，同时保持精度在 0.5 pp 以内。规则路径在 Adult 上降低 DSP 使用 89.0%（代价 1.5 pp 总精度）。成功部署在低功耗 Spartan-7 XC7S15 上。在 MAGIC 数据集上规则数比 ECLAIRE 少 9 倍（44 vs 396），平均条件数减半。规则认证在 c=0.05 噪声下达到 42.7%，显著高于 BNN (16.0%) 和 ReLU (12.4%) 的网络级 IBP 认证。在 ACS Income 地理分布偏移下，覆盖准确率下降与 BNN 基线相当，未放大模型退化。TinyBERT4 FFN 替换（h=600）匹配或超过教师精度（90.48% vs 90.37%），FFN 子层延迟降低 72.2%。
AI.conclusion: Bern2Edge 是首个联合利用 Bernstein 多项式激活的结构特性进行硬件综合和符号规则提取的工作，弥合了训练-部署鸿沟。BNN 在压缩下 consistently 优于 ReLU，LUT 实现消除了激活的 train-deploy gap，Bernstein 几何产生紧凑、可解释的规则，具有显式输入空间约束。未来工作包括自动设计空间探索、基于概念探测的语义可解释规则提取以及向 CNN 视觉任务的扩展。

title: When Graph-JEPA Learns the Wrong Thing: Diagnosing and Repairing Category-Conditional Collapse
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are selected almost universally by linear probing and effective rank. We report a case where both read healthily while the representation carries zero usable instance information. We repair it, and a second failure appears: the repaired metric saturates on a target carrying no structural information. Our corpus is a scientific-reasoning graph over 57,903 articles, each a subgraph. A Graph-JEPA predicts one masked aspect from a subgraph's remaining aspects, attaining linear-probe accuracy 0.871 and effective rank 18-47, yet retrieval recovers 0.00 of 14.4 bits (MRR 1.9e-4 vs chance 1.99e-4, p=0.98). Three upper bounds on the same pool and code recover nearly everything (+14.28, +14.34, +14.22 bits), ruling out corpus, masking, pool, and metric as causes. We trace this to variance allocation - frozen inputs place 86.05% of variance on subgraph identity and 0.40% on aspect identity, while trained latents place 0.39% and 99.61%. This is a property of the objective's optimum: the degenerate solution is a global minimum of the coupled predictor/EMA-target objective, present already at init. A repaired configuration reaches 14.377 of 14.379 bits, above the 13.865-bit oracle; reverting the loss to regression drops it to 0.307 bits, confirming it. Yet the repair licenses nothing about reasoning: the target is reducible, since intra-subgraph edges are a deterministic function of node census. The oracle reaches 96.4% of the ceiling, and our largest effect is the learning-rate schedule, not architecture. Bits and a reasoning probe show no relation across ten cells. A data-derived target fails a quality gate - 25.96% of nodes are duplicate placeholders, and the rest is more generic than supporting evidence. Rank, probes, and metrics can all saturate on an unsupportive evaluation. We release a harness with a reducibility audit and target gate.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示并诊断了Graph-JEPA训练中出现的"类别条件坍缩"（Category-Conditional Collapse）现象：尽管线性探针和有效秩两项标准健康检查均显示正常，但表征实际不包含任何实例（论文）级别的可用信息。论文通过控制实验（oracle、BM25、正控）排除了语料、掩码、池化与度量本身的原因，将机制定位为"方差分配"——训练目标的最优解是一个全局最小值，使模型坍缩到按掩码类别（aspect）分类而非按实例区分。修复方法（去除每类均值的目标帧+InfoNCE）可将检索性能从0 bits提升至14.377/14.379 bits，但论文随即证明该检索目标本身是"结构可约简"的（Prop. 5），因为子图边集是节点普查的确定性函数，不含任何结构信息，因此近天花板分数不能证明模型学到了推理结构。最后，论文指出替代数据派生目标存在质量门控失败（25.96%为占位符文本）。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）已被广泛采用，标准做法依赖线性探针和有效秩作为模型选择的健康检查。然而，这些检查可能报告模型"健康"，但表征却不含任何实例级可用信息。若此问题被忽视，整个JEPA评估范式将面临系统性误导。本文旨在揭示这一隐藏失败模式，诊断其机制，并评估其修复方法的真正意义。
AI.method: 1. 构建异构科学推理图（57,903篇论文，5类推理节点）；2. 训练Graph-JEPA预测被掩码aspect的子图嵌入；3. 设计诊断阶梯（11级干预），系统性地测试损失、聚合器、深度、输入白化、检索帧等组件；4. 建立三个上界（参数无关的oracle、BM25、同架构正控）以分离任务难度、评估管线与目标函数；5. 通过方差分配分析定位机制：冻结输入86.05%方差归论文身份/0.40%归aspect身份，而训练后潜变量分配完全反转（0.39%/99.61%）；6. 给出五个理论命题（Prop. 1–5）证明类别可测解是全局最小值、查询退化查询库在任何内射变换下不变、几何无法挽救、以及子图边集由节点普查决定（结构可约简）；7. 修复方法：去除每aspect均值的目标帧+InfoNCE；8. 引入可约简性审计和派生目标质量门控。
AI.result: 基线Graph-JEPA：探针0.871，有效秩18–47（健康），但检索恢复0.00/14.379 bits（p=0.98，与随机无异）。三个上界在相同池化/掩码/评分代码下分别恢复+14.281、+14.335、+14.220 bits（98.9–99.7%天花板），排除语料、任务、池化、掩码和度量作为原因。失败定位到查询端：查询库有效秩仅1.9（预测上界≤|A|=3）。方差分配机制：训练前后aspect/paper方差份额从0.40%/86.05%翻转为99.61%/0.39%。修复后达到14.377/14.379 bits（100.0%），但目标本身可约简（5/9种内关系由节点普查决定），oracle无需训练即达96.4%天花板。派生目标质量门控失败：25.96%为占位符重复文本。
AI.conclusion: 类别条件坍缩是JEPA类架构中标准检查无法捕获的隐藏失败模式：线性探针和有效秩可同时饱和，但表征在每个潜在类别内部坍缩而类别间区分清晰。证明此现象是耦合预测器/EMA目标函数的全局最小值（而非优化失败），失败定位在查询端（候选侧工具无法触及）。修复成功但揭示第二层失败：评估目标本身可约简（边集为节点普查的确定性函数），近天花板分数不能证明推理结构学习。bits与保留推理探针在10个收敛单元间无相关性（Spearman=-0.24）。该工作呼吁对自监督图表示评估进行系统性审计。

title: Learning Exact NVIDIA SASS Encoders with $\mathbb{F}_2$ Linear Algebra
summary: NVIDIA provides a SASS disassembler but no public SASS assembler for recent data-center GPUs, limiting controlled machine-code rewriting. We present F2Asm, which learns exact 128-bit SASS encoders from paired disassembly and original CUBIN instruction words. To our knowledge, F2Asm is the first system to learn SASS instruction encoders as vector-valued affine maps over F2 and the first open-source NVIDIA SASS assembler to support Rubin SM107. F2Asm uses Gaussian elimination over F2 to incrementally build a compact basis, detect inconsistencies, and reject inputs outside the learned span. F2Asm separates target-specific control bits, relocation rules, and CUBIN metadata from its learning algorithm. We train encoders for Hopper SM90/SM90a, Blackwell SM100, and Rubin SM107 using 3,225 CUBINs from pinned NVIDIA and third-party production libraries, CUDA 13.3 packages, and CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview archives. In round-trip tests, F2Asm reassembles the disassembled SASS for each CUBIN, and all compared executable text sections match the originals exactly.

AI.tldr: F2Asm 是首个通过将 128 位 NVIDIA SASS 指令编码学习为 F2 上的仿射映射，并使用流式高斯消元法实现精确汇编的开源系统，目前支持 Hopper SM90/SM90a、Blackwell SM100 和 Rubin SM107，在 3,225 个生产 CUBIN 上实现了字节级精确的往返重建。
AI.motivation: NVIDIA 仅提供 SASS 反汇编器而不提供官方汇编器，限制了在最新数据中心 GPU 上对机器码进行受控重写以实现 SASS 级优化（如用于 LLM 内核调优）的应用。
AI.method: 将指令编码建模为 F2 上的向量值仿射映射（y = φ(x)W），通过流式/增量式高斯消元法从反汇编-机器码配对数据中学习紧凑的基，并对查询特征向量执行精确支撑检查（span check）；将调度控制位、重定位规则与学习算法解耦。
AI.result: 在 3,225 个经过认证的 CUBIN（共 150,214 个可执行 .text 段、约 34.07 亿字节）上实现 100% 字节级精确往返重建，0 失败 0 错误；覆盖 140/128/120 个操作码及 389/326/279 个指令形式；观察指令经高斯消元压缩约 200 倍。
AI.conclusion: F2Asm 是首个学习 SASS 编码为 F2 仿射映射的开源汇编器，并率先支持 Rubin SM107；其共享学习器加目标专属配置文件的架构便于扩展到未来 GPU，可作为 SASS 级编码 Agent、手调内核和机器码微基准测试的后端。

title: AgentDecarbonizer: Carbon-Aware Execution for AI Agents
summary: AI agents extend large language models from single prompt-response interactions to long-running, goaldirected workflows that issue many model calls, invoke tools, and interact with external environments. These workflows enable tasks such as software repair, data analysis, and experiment management, but their repeated model invocations can incur substantial carbon emissions. This paper characterizes the carbon emissions of OpenClaw agent workloads using WildClawBench, and shows that emissions depend on token consumption, context cache reuse, and the carbon intensity of the grid. Our characterization identifies deadline flexibility as an opportunity for carbon-aware execution: agent tasks can wait for lower-carbon-intensity periods or shift to lower-carbon grids. However, doing so requires handling uncertain execution time for temporal shifting and cached context recomputation during spatial shifting. We present AgentDecarbonizer, a carbon optimizer for AI agents that runs alongside OpenClaw. Given a task prompt and user-specified deadline, AgentDecarbonizer conservatively estimates task duration and selects deadline-feasible execution schedules, while accounting for cache recomputation overhead during spatial shifting. Evaluated on WildClawBench workloads with 60 agent tasks across four grids, AgentDecarbonizer reduces carbon emissions by up to 57.9 % compared with a carbon-agnostic baseline and by up to 37.5 % compared with a baseline that selects the carbon-optimal grid at task start time.

AI.tldr: AgentDecarbonizer是首个面向AI智能体工作负载的碳感知执行优化器。它通过时间移位（等待低碳时段）和空间移位（在多个电网间调度）来减少AI智能体在执行多步、目标驱动工作流时产生的碳排放，同时确保满足用户指定的截止时间并考虑上下文缓存重建开销。
AI.motivation: AI智能体（如基于OpenClaw的智能体）通过反复调用LLM API和工具来执行复杂的多步任务（如软件修复、数据分析），导致大量token消耗和高碳排放。智能体工作负载具有执行时间不确定、输入密集（输入token占99.1%）、且高度依赖上下文缓存（94.6%命中率，节省80.7%碳排放）等独特特征。现有碳感知优化技术未考虑这些智能体特有的执行特性，特别是截止时间约束下的不确定执行时间，以及空间移位时上下文缓存重建的额外开销。
AI.method:
AgentDecarbonizer作为OpenClaw的并行碳优化器运行，包含四个核心组件：
1. **执行时间估计器**：基于本地轻量级Gemma 4 4B模型，从用户提示生成保守的初始持续时间估计，通过任务阶段分解和启发式锚点（如典型步骤数、生成速度）预测执行时间，并在执行过程中根据OpenClaw跟踪数据动态更新剩余时间估计。
2. **碳强度预测器**：使用EnsembleCI预测各候选电网未来的碳强度，15分钟粒度，每小时刷新。
3. **碳感知规划器**：将任务分解为K=⌈T̃/Δt⌉个有序执行间隔，在截止时间约束下选择低碳候选间隔和服务电网。采用动态规划算法，复杂度为O(K|R|H)，在局部缓存重建假设下（仅依赖前后间隔是否在同一电网）实现最优求解。
4. **执行控制器**：根据规划器决策等待或执行，在间隔间暂停，并在必要时执行跨电网移位。
缓存感知碳模型：将缓存重建开销建模为从当前电网切换到新电网时需重新处理的已缓存输入token的预填充成本，只有当碳减排超过重建开销时才执行空间移位。
理论保证：证明了动态规划算法的最优性（定理1）和截止时间保证——只要实际运行时间不超过保守估计，调度一定能在截止时间前完成（定理2）。
AI.result:
在WildClawBench（60个智能体任务，6个类别）上使用GPT-5.4和Gemini 3.1 Pro作为后端模型，在四个电网（AT、CISO、FI、GB）上进行评估：
- **总体碳减排**：在24小时截止时间下，比碳无关基线减少57.9%碳排放，比启动时选择最优电网的基线减少37.5%；在3小时紧截止时间下，分别减少34.9%和3.3%。
- **多模型有效性**：Gemini 3.1 Pro上减少35.2–57.3%碳排放。
- **消融研究**：多电网移位贡献34.1–45.7%碳减排；碳强度预测器接近理想预测；执行时间估计器接近理想估计。
- **本地开销**：在Mac mini上，AgentDecarbonizer额外开销仅0.7–5.2分钟，平均功耗14.9W，峰值内存6.5GB。
- **特征化发现**：智能体任务高度多样化，输入token占总token的99.1%，94.6%命中缓存，节省80.7%碳排放。
AI.conclusion: AgentDecarbonizer是首个系统性研究AI智能体碳排放并针对其执行特性（不确定执行时间、上下文缓存依赖）进行碳优化的系统。通过结合截止时间感知的执行时间估计、碳强度预测和缓存感知的动态规划调度，在始终满足用户截止时间的前提下，实现了高达57.9%的碳排放减少。评估结果表明，碳感知调度对AI智能体具有显著的可持续性效益，且开销极低。

title: Faults That Fortify: CNN Adversarial Robustness via GPU Undervolting
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE HOST 2027
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) face a dual challenge: vulnerability to adversarial attacks and prohibitive training cost. Adversarial training is effective but expensive, a burden that grows as learning shifts to the energy-constrained edge. This paper addresses both through GPU undervolting during training. Reducing supply voltage introduces stochastic perturbations that act as implicit regularization, improving robustness while lowering power. We characterize undervolting-induced faults at the bit level, then train LeNet, VGG-6, and MobileNetV3 on MNIST and CIFAR-10 under two training regimes, standard and adversarial, each at nominal and undervolted voltage, and evaluate all models against adversarial attacks. In both regimes, the undervolted model consistently achieves higher adversarial accuracy than its nominal-voltage counterpart, showing that hardware-induced faults strengthen even adversarial training. Because dynamic power scales quadratically with supply voltage, these robustness gains arrive with substantial energy savings. GPU undervolting is therefore a readily deployable hardware-level defense requiring no algorithmic change, and opens a promising direction in which robustness and energy efficiency move together.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用GPU欠压（undervolting）在训练阶段引入随机算术噪声作为一种隐式正则化方法，无需任何算法改动即可同时提升CNN对抗鲁棒性和能源效率。
AI.motivation: CNN同时面临对抗脆弱性和高昂训练成本两大挑战，尤其在边缘设备中。现有防御方法如对抗训练计算开销大，且以往关于欠压的研究主要关注推理阶段的故障注入或软件仿真，缺乏对真实GPU训练阶段瞬态故障影响的探索。
AI.method: 使用MSI Afterburner对NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU进行欠压调节，通过2×2实验设计（标准/对抗训练 × 标称/欠压电压）评估LeNet、VGG-6和MobileNetV3在MNIST和CIFAR-10上的表现；首先通过张量重复乘法实验在位级刻画欠压故障特征，再以PGD攻击评估所有模型在不同扰动预算下的对抗精度。
AI.result: 在两种训练模式下，欠压模型的对抗精度均持续高于标称电压对应模型；欠压带来的功耗改善达33.9%–38.8%；位级分析显示绝大多数故障集中在尾数位低有效位，对单次推理精度影响可忽略，但其累积效应充当隐式正则化；欠压对更深层模型（如MobileNetV3）的鲁棒性提升较小，归因于深层非线性结构对微小扰动的掩蔽效应。
AI.conclusion: GPU欠压是一种可直接部署的硬件级防御机制，无需算法修改即可同时增强鲁棒性与能效，为硬件可靠性与AI安全的交叉研究开辟了新方向；未来工作将扩展至更大规模基础模型、量化模型以及更精细的电压-频率调节策略。

title: Meta-clustering of milk mid-infrared spectra identifies dairy cow groups associated with negative energy balance in early lactation
summary: Clustering methods have been used to identify distinct groups of milk samples, cows, or herds. Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, particularly mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy, has been applied to individual cow milk samples to predict various milk traits. Applying clustering directly to MIR spectral data may reveal latent groups of cows associated with milk traits or health disorders and can help prevent these conditions or monitor at-risk animals. This study aimed to identify groups of individual dairy cows in early lactation directly from milk MIR spectra and to analyze their associations with milk traits. Using a dataset of 407,632 individual milk MIR records from 3,408 commercial farms, we combined (i) spectral filtering that selects informative wavenumbers, (ii) two dimensionality-reduction methods: principal component analysis (PCA) and an autoencoder, and (iii) two clustering algorithms: k-means and spectral clustering to yield eight different clustering approaches. We regrouped the assigned clusters into meta-clusters that encompassed the most similar ones identified by the eight approaches. Our results revealed five distinct meta-clusters of early-lactation individual dairy cows significantly associated with milk traits. Despite substantial differences, the eight approaches converged on the same five meta-clusters, and the classic, computationally efficient PCA-based k-means approach using the full spectrum recaptured clusters identified by more sophisticated, computationally intensive approaches. The five meta-clusters were strongly associated with DIM and appeared to reflect a gradient of negative energy balance (NEB) severity: severe, moderate, and possibly mild, while the remaining two likely represented cows recovering from NEB, one with rapid restoration of energy balance and one in early recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中红外（MIR）光谱数据，通过结合光谱滤波、降维方法（PCA和自编码器）和聚类算法（k-means和谱聚类），识别了五个与早期泌乳奶牛能量负平衡（NEB）严重程度相关的元聚类，为监测奶牛健康风险提供了计算高效的方法。
AI.motivation: 通过聚类方法直接从MIR光谱数据中识别与乳成分特征或健康障碍相关的奶牛潜在群体，有助于预防相关疾病并监测高风险动物，尤其是在早期泌乳阶段识别能量负平衡状态。
AI.method: 研究使用了来自3,408个商业牧场的407,632条个体MIR光谱记录，结合：(i) 信息波数的光谱滤波；(ii) 两种降维方法（PCA和自编码器）；(iii) 两种聚类算法（k-means和谱聚类），形成8种聚类方案，并将相似聚类重新整合为元聚类。
AI.result: 8种不同方法收敛于相同的5个元聚类，这些聚类与泌乳天数（DIM）显著相关，反映了能量负平衡严重程度的梯度变化：严重、中度、可能轻度NEB，以及两个恢复期群体（快速恢复能量平衡和早期恢复）。
AI.conclusion: 经典的、计算高效的基于PCA的k-means方法（使用全光谱）能够重现更复杂计算密集型方法识别的聚类，为基于MIR光谱识别奶牛健康相关群体提供了一种实用且高效的方法。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes with Applications to Network Dynamic Pricing
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) in Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes (CTJMDPs) featuring general discrete state spaces (which need not possess a vector space structure) and continuous/discrete action spaces. The setup covers many well-known applications in operations such as multi-product dynamic pricing with capacitated resources (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997). To model the exploration-exploitation tradeoff, we formulate an entropy-regularized continuous-time control problem with stochastic policies. Recent continuous-time RL techniques such as $q$-learning for controlled diffusions in (Jia and Zhou 2023) focus on continuous state spaces $\mathbb{R}^d$ and rely heavily on semimartingale theory in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for their theoretical analysis. Consequently, their methods cannot be directly applied to CTJMDPs with general discrete state spaces, which may lack the algebraic addition and subtraction structures inherent to Euclidean spaces. To bridge this gap, we establish the theoretical foundations of $q$-learning for CTJMDPs and develop model-free $q$-learning algorithms. Compared to naïve time discretization and approximating CTJMDPs using discrete-time MDPs, our approach has several conceptual and empirical benefits. Numerical experiments in network dynamic pricing (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997) show that our proposed RL algorithm reliably learns near-optimal policies and consistently outperforms standard benchmark methods, demonstrating superior solution quality and effective scalability to large-scale network instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续时间跳跃马尔可夫决策过程（CTJMDP）上的强化学习，针对一般离散状态空间和连续/离散动作空间，提出基于熵正则化的模型无关q-learning算法，并以网络动态定价为应用进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间强化学习方法（如Jia and Zhou 2023）主要针对受控扩散过程，依赖于ℝ^d上的半鞅理论和Itô公式，无法直接应用于缺乏向量空间结构的一般离散状态空间的CTJMDP。因此需要建立CTJMDP上强化学习的理论基础。
AI.method: 1. 提出CTJMDP的有限期熵正则化控制问题框架（针对随机策略解决探索-利用权衡）；2. 建立针对网格样本状态过程的Dynkin公式（定理1）；3. 证明最优值函数与q-函数的鞅特征（定理2，包含必要性和充分性）；4. 基于鞅正交性条件设计模型无关q-learning算法（算法1），利用CTJMDP分段常数路径特性精确近似积分；5. 使用Actor-Critic架构（Gamma分布策略网络），在网络动态定价上进行数值验证。
AI.result: 在小网络（2条腿3条航线）测试中，学习策略与DP基准仅差2.39%，优于FP（10.33%差距）和FP-BL（17.90%差距）启发式策略。在大网络（11条腿18条航线，约5.88×10^13状态，18维连续动作空间）中，学习策略超过FP-BL 7.9%。附录A的服务器分配实验也接近DP最优解（差距0.476）。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了CTJMDP上强化学习的理论基础，提出的q-learning算法在概念和经验上均优于简单时间离散化方法，能够扩展到大规模网络定价实例。未来方向包括算法收敛性分析和随机逼近过程研究，以及向其他高维运筹学应用拓展。

title: Geometric Regularization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Learning via Gaussian Feature Bridges
