comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Conference page: this https URL
summary: Real-world semi-supervised learning (SSL) often encounters significant challenges with long-tailed label distributions and noisy pseudo-labels, which hinder generalization and amplify confirmation bias. In this work, we introduce a novel framework, Gaussian Bridge Consistency (GBC), to address these challenges by constructing semantic interpolation paths between unlabeled samples and high-quality class anchors. Our method maintains a dynamic Prototype Atlas that stores a diverse and evolving set of labeled and pseudo-labeled exemplars per class. For each unlabeled instance, GBC forms a class-conditional Gaussian Feature Bridge in the latent space, enabling the student model to traverse a smooth trajectory from uncertain predictions to reliable class prototypes. A bridge consistency loss is applied along this path to enforce alignment with a geometrically interpolated target distribution. Furthermore, we propose BridgeMix, a confidence-aware feature mixing strategy that interpolates both sample and anchor pairs to amplify cross-sample generalization. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10-LT and ImageNet-LT (USB benchmarks) validate the robustness and effectiveness of GBC under realistic long-tailed SSL settings, consistently improving long tail-class performance without sacrificing scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出GBC框架，通过在潜在空间中构建类条件高斯特征桥连接无标签样本与可靠类别锚点，结合BridgeMix特征混合策略，有效缓解长尾半监督学习中的伪标签噪声和确认偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现实半监督学习面临长尾分布和噪声伪标签的双重挑战，现有方法多在logit层面进行类别平衡，缺乏特征层面的中间对齐机制，导致尾类欠训练和语义漂移。
AI.method: 1) 动态Prototype Atlas存储每类标签与高置信度伪标签样本作为锚点；2) 对无标签样本与同类锚点构建类条件高斯特征桥，通过插值函数g(t)=t和噪声σ(t)=ν√(t(1-t))在潜在空间形成平滑语义路径；3) 沿桥路径施加bridge consistency loss（KL散度加权），对齐几何插值目标分布q_t；4) BridgeMix策略以置信度为权重对样本-锚点对进行特征插值混合；5) 类感知重加权w_c(f̄/f_c)^γ强化尾类。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10-LT上一致性设置下达到92.30%（γ_ℓ=100），ImageNet-127（γ_t≈286）64×64分辨率下达68.6% Top-1精度，ImageNet-1K 64×64下达27.5%，相比SimPro和Meta-Expert等SOTA方法均有提升；Few-shot场景（1/5/10-shot）也保持稳定优势；计算开销仅增加约1.7%。
AI.conclusion: GBC将半监督学习重新定义为不确定特征到可靠类别原型之间的几何传输过程，通过概率几何视角统一了一致性学习与最优传输思想，为长尾和噪声条件下的SSL提供了理论支撑和实用方案。

title: Hidden Axis of Uncertainty: Latent-Posterior Alignment in Graph Neural Networks with Bayesian Output Layers
summary: Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with Bayesian output layers provide a principled and tractable framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty, yet the mechanisms shaping that uncertainty remain unclear. While conventional theory attributes uncertainty reduction to posterior contraction, the corresponding assumptions need not hold for deep models. In the Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Bayesian output layers studied here, we observe that predictive uncertainty decreases as latent representations shift toward lower-variance posterior directions, even though the posterior variance does not contract. We term this behavior Latent-Posterior Alignment (LPA) and conduct interventional experiments that support its functional role in shaping predictive uncertainty. Building on this insight, we propose Alignment-Guided Learning (AGL), which explicitly promotes this alignment during training. AGL effectively reduces predictive uncertainty while preserving accuracy and improves structural calibration, ensuring that the model confidence faithfully mirrors underlying data density. These findings provide a new perspective on uncertainty dynamics in GNNs with mean-field Bayesian output layers, shifting the focus from the magnitude of the posterior to the geometric interplay between latent and parameter spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文针对贝叶斯GNN中预测不确定性的形成机制提出新视角：发现预测不确定性下降并非由后验收缩驱动，而是由隐表示与后验低方差方向的对齐（LPA）主导，并据此提出对齐引导学习（AGL）方法，显著改善结构校准。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯理论认为预测不确定性下降源于后验收缩（Bernstein-von Mises定理），但深度模型通常不满足其正则性条件。已有研究表明深度BNN常出现冷后验效应和OOD过度自信，但不确定性形成机制尚不清晰。本文旨在揭示GNN+贝叶斯输出层架构中预测不确定性的真实形成机制。
AI.method: 1. 构建BGNN架构：5层GIN确定性特征提取器 + 均场变分贝叶斯线性输出层（Bayes-by-Backprop，64维潜空间）；2. 在6个分子性质数据集上系统分析预测方差、后验方差与潜表示几何的关系；3. 定义潜-后验对齐分数LPAS量化对齐程度；4. 通过L1/L2/反对齐正则化干预实验验证因果性；5. 提出AGL方法，将LPAS作为正则项加入ELBO损失：L_total = -ELBO - γ·LPAS；6. 用ECE评估概率校准、DUC（基于KDE的互信息）评估结构校准。
AI.result: 1. 发现关键反直觉现象：训练数据增加时预测误差和预测不确定性下降，但权重后验方差反而增大（从0.05增至0.11），KL散度下降源于后验向先验单位方差扩展；2. 预测方差可分解为Var[y]≈Σz_i²·σ_{w,i}²，表明不确定性由潜激活与对应维度后验方差的耦合决定；3. 数据增加时LPAS单调上升，潜表示系统性地向低方差后验方向偏移；4. 干预实验破坏LPA后预测不确定性显著上升，提供因果性证据；5. AGL在保持MAE不变的前提下显著提升LPAS和DUC，将不确定性重新分配到潜空间低支持区域，但对KL权重β和先验方差具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出LPA是GNN+均场贝叶斯输出层中预测不确定性的主导形成机制，将研究焦点从后验方差大小转移到潜表示与参数空间的几何耦合。基于此提出的AGL方法能有效改善结构校准，使模型置信度更忠实地反映数据密度，在主动学习和MLIP等科学应用中具有实用价值。但LPA是否在完全贝叶斯架构或其他不确定性框架下成立仍待验证。

title: Resolution-Consistent Greedy Neural Approximation on Infinite-Dimensional Spaces
summary: We develop constructive approximation and learning guarantees for shallow neural models with infinite-dimensional inputs observed through finitely many coordinates. The analysis is based on a parameter-normalized neural dictionary and its associated weighted variation class. Within this class, the approximation error separates into a distribution-dependent coordinate-truncation term and a greedy finite-width term. For empirical regression, a fully-corrective greedy procedure yields population guarantees whose statistical complexity is uniform in the retained input resolution. The same framework extends to Hilbert-valued responses without an explicit dependence on the output dimension. The dimension-free statements are statistical, not computational: selecting a new neuron still requires solving a nonconvex parameter-search problem. The quasi-Polish construction underlying recent infinite-dimensional universal approximation results provides a motivating example, and synthetic experiments illustrate the predicted resolution, width, and sample-size regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无限维输入下的浅层神经网络，提出一种基于参数归一化神经字典与加权变差类的构造性逼近与学习保证。核心结果是误差可分解为分辨率项、有限宽度项与统计项，其中统计项（Rademacher复杂度）对输入保留分辨率N及输出维度均无显式依赖，是"维度无关"的统计结果。但神经元选择的非凸参数搜索问题仍未解决，计算上仍依赖N。
AI.motivation: 函数型数据、轨迹、场、概率测度等本质上是无限维对象。现有无限维通用逼近定理（如Galimberti的quasi-Polish构造）只给出密度结论，缺乏构造性的神经元选择规则、宽度收敛速率及有限样本统计保证。本文旨在建立同时刻画输入分辨率、网络宽度与样本量三者影响的定量理论。
AI.method: 1. 在可测坐标嵌入假设下定义ℓ²包络控制的分辨率损失η_N(μ)。2. 引入参数归一化原子ψ_θ=g_θ/(1+‖θ‖)，定义加权变差范数B_H♯（用c(θ)=1+‖θ‖_P加权）。3. 证明加权范数控制Lipschitz半范数（命题3.3），并通过一维阈值例f_λ(x)=ρ(λx)证明加权球比不加权球严格更小（推论3.4）。4. 对有限分辨字典D_N♯运行弱正交贪心算法（OGA），获得确定性宽度-分辨率权衡：‖f-f_{m,N}‖²≤V²η_N²+4V²/(γ²m)。5. 通过dyadic壳分解与收缩引理证明Rademacher复杂度对N一致：ℜ̂_S(D_N♯)≤(4/√n)(K+1+√log(2+log n))。6. 完全校正贪心经验回归给出优化速率16V²/(m+3)。7. 端到端定理8.1将三者合并：分辨率V²η_N²+宽度16V²/(m+3)+统计项（无N依赖）。8. 推广到Hilbert值响应，统计项同时对输出维度无关（定理10.4），线性oracle的最优输出方向可解析消去。
AI.result: 主要定理（定理8.1）：在|Y|≤B且f_⋆有加权表示成本V的条件下，以概率≥1-δ，‖f̂_{m,N}-f_⋆‖²_{L²(μ)}≤V²η_N(μ)²+16V²/(m+3)+C₁(B+V)V(K+1+√log(2+log n))/√n+C₂(B+V)²√(log(2/δ)/n)。统计项无显式N依赖。在quasi-Polish包络|h_j|≤1/j下，平衡点N≍m≍√n匹配n^{-1/2}全局尺度。Hilbert值版本（定理10.4）进一步对dim(Y)无关。合成实验三组扫描（分辨率、宽度、样本量）验证预测规律，第二组实验用一维阈值族清晰展示加权与不加权变差类的分离。
AI.conclusion: 参数加权变差类为无限维输入的贪心神经网络学习提供了清晰框架，三种误差可清晰分离。关键统计现象是ℓ²坐标嵌入的Hilbert半径与保留维度无关，从而使归一化字典的Rademacher估计对N一致。代价有二：加权球比不加权球更具限制性（排除尖锐阈值函数）；贪心神经元的非凸参数搜索在计算上仍随N增长。"维度无关"仅为统计复杂度性质，非计算性质。该框架可推广至Hilbert值响应，为非线性算子学习提供理论路径，但仍需可处理的神经元oracle与真实算子学习基准。

title: Nothing Changed but the Model: CellFill -- Bounded In-Cell Learning for Bit-Identical, Revocable Updates to Quantized LLMs
summary: Every way of teaching a deployed language model something new -- full fine-tuning, adapter merging, model editing -- replaces the released checkpoint, and with it every evaluation and cache that referred to those exact bits. We instead learn inside the dequantization gap: with the integer codes and scales of a 4-bit release frozen, new knowledge is written only into the per-weight residual that lives strictly inside each quantization decision cell. Re-quantization then returns the released artifact bit-for-bit, a machine-checkable guarantee; updates are exactly revocable by dropping the residual; and drift is bounded. We give six propositions and three training paths, including CellFill, a bounded reparameterization that makes invariance structural rather than enforced. Exact invariance turns out to be nearly free: across three paired seeds the constrained dense path matches an unconstrained reference whose weights provably escape the artifact (58.9 vs 59.3 percent fact recall; paired difference -0.5 points, 95% CI [-5.0,+4.0]), and is better on held-out cross-domain perplexity. Against the natural null hypothesis -- serving the same update as an unmerged adapter -- projecting into the cells reduces cross-domain forgetting in every run that converged, and a diverged control shows the boundary: projection is a trust region, not a repair. What no method escapes is the cost of knowledge itself, and the apparent free lunch of in-domain perplexity improving past the anchor is an artifact of rehearsal sharing a corpus with the metric. Methods differ threefold at matched rehearsal in knowledge bought per point of cross-domain perplexity, a ranking that is not the recall ranking. The method transfers to a 27B hybrid linear-attention model (2.4e10 constrained weights, verified bit-identical), where matched recall costs about half as much cross-domain perplexity as at 1.7B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CellFill——一种针对 4 位量化 LLM 的"盒内学习"（in-cell learning）方法，在不改变已发布的量化权重比特的前提下将新知识写入每个权重量化决策单元内的残差，实现比特级精确的不变性、可精确撤销的更新以及可计算的漂移预算。
AI.motivation: 已部署的语言模型一旦需要更新（全量微调、adapter 合并、模型编辑），就会替换已发布的检查点，从而使其所有已有的评测、认证、文档及缓存失效。其核心成本并非 GPU 算力，而是认证（certification）的丧失。因此需要一种方法，使得模型在部署后能持续学习，同时已发布的工件（artifact）保持比特级不变。
AI.method: 将 4 位量化后丢弃的反量化间隙（dequantization gap）视为可寻址存储：在冻结 4 位整数码与组尺度后，仅将残差写入每个权重的量化决策单元（cell）内部。三条实现路径：clip-merge（A）、投影稠密微调（B）、以及 CellFill——一种有界重参数化 W=Ŵ + M⊙tanh(sBA⊤)，其不变性由构造本身保证。配合六个命题：比特不变性、投影最优性、嵌套细化编码、容量上界（数据处理不等式）、二阶遗忘预算、几何塑性衰减律。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上注入 1000 条合成事实，clip-merge 恢复 24%，投影稠密恢复 61.4%，且 14.09 亿权重比特完全一致；约束与无约束对比中，约束路径事实召回率 58.9% vs 59.3%（差 −0.5 点，95% CI [−5.0,+4.0]），跨域困惑度更优；投影到 cell 内可使 9 次收敛运行中的跨域遗忘下降 0.97–271.3 点；27B 混合线性注意力模型上 243.5 亿权重比特一致；序列更新下塑性以 β=0.825±0.002 几何衰减；2 bit/权重细化编码即可恢复 99.4% 知识。
AI.conclusion: 已发布的 4 位工件可被视为持续学习的固定参考系，模型可吸收序列化的操作员知识同时其他系统所依赖的比特始终不变。由此形成的生命周期——跨次要版本消耗预算、在预算耗尽时发布主要版本重新量化——具有可测量的交换率，而非隐喻。算力成本并非此方法的瓶颈；真正可受益的场景是再认证（re-certification）成本主导的部署场景。但其声明仅限于事实类知识的注入，技能与能力注入尚未验证；技能可能需要协调位移，超出单位权重的盒约束所能良好支持的范围。

title: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline RL methods commonly jointly train the actor and critic, where the critic is used to guide the actor toward higher-value actions. This coupled learning process is well motivated in online RL, where an improved actor collects new data that can further update the actor and the critic. However, training data remains fixed in offline RL, making actor-side policy improvement unable to generate new data to validate or correct the critic. Moreover, retaining this coupled paradigm leads to two related challenges. Firstly, actor updates can drift toward high-valued but potentially out-of-distribution (OOD) actions and amplify critic overestimation. Secondly, conservative value estimation or behavior-cloning regularization creates a difficult trade-off between suppressing OOD actions and selecting high-value actions within the data-supported region. Motivated by this observation, we revisit the conventional offline RL paradigm and propose decoupling policy improvement from actor training. Specifically, we train the actor solely to model the behavior distribution and perform policy improvement at inference time by reranking multiple actor-generated proposals with a separately learned critic. We refer to this paradigm as the decoupled policy extraction paradigm. Under such paradigm, the actor provides behavior-supported action candidates, while the critic performs value-based selection within this candidate set. Extensive experiments show that the decoupled policy extraction paradigm outperforms both behavior cloning and jointly learned offline RL methods, while remaining effective even with a naive Q-learning critic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离线强化学习中的"解耦策略提取"范式，将策略改进从演员训练中分离出来：演员仅通过行为克隆建模数据分布，在推理时由独立的评论家对多个候选动作进行重排序选择。该方法有效缓解了耦合训练中的OOD放大循环和支撑-价值权衡问题，并在多个离线目标条件任务上优于现有耦合方法和行为克隆。
AI.motivation: 现有离线RL方法沿用在线RL中"演员-评论家联合训练"的范式，但离线设定下数据固定，演员改进无法生成新数据来修正评论家误差，导致两个核心问题：(1) OOD放大循环——演员向评论家高估的分布外动作漂移，递归放大评论家误差；(2) 支撑-价值权衡——保守性正则化在抑制OOD动作和选择数据支撑区域内高价值动作之间存在困难权衡。
AI.method: 提出"解耦策略提取范式"：(1) 冻结的行为克隆演员仅建模数据集分布，不接收评论家梯度；(2) 独立训练评论家；(3) 推理时，演员生成N个候选动作，评论家对其进行重排序选择最高价值动作执行。候选预算N成为唯一的推理时超参数，无需重新训练即可调整。该范式放松了对评论家设计的要求，即使朴素的Q-Learning评论家也能有效工作。
AI.result: 在OGBench六个目标条件连续控制环境（共30个任务）上的实验表明：解耦策略提取在所有评论家骨干（IQL、Q-Learning、Transitive）上均一致优于对应的耦合方法。例如使用IQL评论家时，Puzzle-4x4任务上成功率从28%提升至84%（相对提升202.2%），Cube-Double从67%提升至79%。即使朴素的Q-Learning评论家在多数环境下也优于IQL。在推理延迟方面，候选预算N=32时延迟仍低于0.53ms，GPU显存几乎恒定。
AI.conclusion: 解耦策略提取范式从根本上避免了耦合训练中评论家误差放大和支撑-价值权衡问题，将昂贵的训练时策略优化转化为轻量级的推理时选择。该范式对大规模预训练策略尤为重要：只需将策略改进委托给轻量级评论家，昂贵的演员无需重复更新即可跨任务复用。主要局限在于提议覆盖范围受限于离线数据集分布，缺失的高价值行为构成性能上限。

title: Training, learning and inference: unified dynamics of neural systems
comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Evidence spans 22 indexed experimental programmes: held-out prediction (91.43% accuracy), causal interventions, and cross-system validation in nanoGPT, ResNet/CIFAR-100 and diffusion/CIFAR-10. Code: this https URL . Evidence: this https URL
summary: We define an atomic generation fact f=(u,tau,omega,z;rho), recording the origin, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, generated result and relation role. Compiled into a Generation-Fact Graph (GFG), these facts provide an AI-native, compilable scientific fact substrate preserving generation histories. We establish a GFG-based recursive scientific process in which analysis, intervention, replay and validation form facts for later cycles. Using nanoGPT, we establish unified training-learning dynamics. Training is the evolution of a parameter-optimizer system with state and memory: each actual training action enters the receiving state and produces a finite-amplitude nonlinear functional response conditioned by that state and target-specific update geometry. Learning is the persistent reorganization of distributed functional support by these responses; capability formation, maintenance, decline or recovery becomes observable when target-specific states are evaluated against their readout boundaries. Three primary coordinates - target-boundary state, target-specific update geometry and parameter-Adam receiving state - yield a second-order predictor operating before post-update outputs are read. On held-out runs, it achieved 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% macro-averaged recall across four transitions. We further establish inference as a frozen projection of training-learning dynamics. Component gating and rollback show causal recruitment and non-additive combination of query-conditioned support formed during training, deriving organizational conditions realized by Attention. Controlled feedback indicates possible double-edged reinforcement effects. ResNet/CIFAR-100 and diffusion/CIFAR-10 experiments confirm receiving-state-conditioned responses, persistent support reorganization and frozen inference projection beyond nanoGPT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成事实图"(Generation-Fact Graph, GFG)作为AI原生的可编译科学事实基底，并基于此构建一个递归的科学过程框架。在nanoGPT上建立了统一的"训练-学习动力学"理论，将训练视为参数-优化器系统的状态演化，将学习视为分布式功能支持的持续重组。该框架可在更新后输出读取前对系统行为进行二阶预测，并在四个转换上达到91.43%的准确率和91.49%的宏平均召回率，同时推导出注意力机制的组织条件。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习（特别是大语言模型）的内部机制缺乏可编译、可追溯的科学事实基底。训练过程中的参数演化、能力形成与衰退等动力学过程难以被形式化记录和预测，限制了AI原生科学研究的发展。需要一种既能保留生成历史，又能支持递归分析的科学框架。
AI.method: 1. 定义原子生成事实 f=(u,τ,ω,z;ρ)，记录起源、转换、发生、结果和关系角色；2. 构建生成事实图（GFG）作为可编译科学事实基底；3. 基于GFG建立递归科学过程（分析、干预、回放、验证）；4. 在nanoGPT上建立统一训练-学习动力学理论，引入三个主坐标：目标-边界状态、目标特定更新几何、参数-Adam接收状态；5. 推导二阶预测器在输出读取前预测系统行为；6. 将推理视为训练-学习动力学的冻结投影；7. 通过组件门控与回滚验证因果关系；8. 在ResNet/CIFAR-100和扩散/CIFAR-10上验证泛化性。
AI.result: 1. 二阶预测器在nanoGPT的四个转换上达到91.43%准确率和91.49%宏平均召回率；2. 验证了接收状态条件化响应、持续支持重组和冻结推理投影等现象；3. 揭示了注意力机制中查询条件化支持的因果招募与非加性组合的组织条件；4. 发现受控反馈可能产生双刃剑式的强化效应；5. 在ResNet/CIFAR-100和扩散/CIFAR-10上的实验证实了框架的跨架构泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的GFG框架和训练-学习动力学理论为深度学习提供了AI原生的科学事实基底和可编译机制。该框架将训练、学习和推理统一为可分析、可预测、可干预的动力学过程，使能力形成、维护、衰退或恢复成为可观测现象，并通过实验验证了其在大语言模型、CNN和扩散模型中的广泛适用性，为AI原生科学研究开辟了新路径。

title: A Critical Audit of Spatiotemporal Forecasting Benchmark Datasets and Baselines
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are routinely employed for short-range forecasting on multivariate time series with a spatial graph structure. Despite the availability of many alternative datasets, method innovations within this domain are predominantly assessed against a rather limited set of benchmark datasets, most notably Chickenpox, PedalMe, WikiMaths, METR-LA, and PEMS-BAY. The evaluation protocols contain baselines spanning from historical averages to classical machine learning approaches. These baselines often show competitive performance compared to GNNs. In the present work, we take a step back and analyse the benchmark datasets via classical time series methods to uncover why spatially-unaware linear models pose a stronger competitor than previously reported, casting further doubt on the discriminative reliability of the aforementioned widely adopted datasets. Our statistical analysis provides a toolset for identifying significant spatial and temporal correlations, while revealing a structural bias introduced by first-order differenced datasets. We therefore recommend reducing the over-reliance on such datasets for method comparison, and instead advocate for more rigorous statistical evaluation. By applying the results of our analysis to a simple hybrid model, we show how our methodology can lead to novel ways of developing GNN models

AI.tldr: 本文对时空预测领域广泛使用的五个基准数据集（Chickenpox、PedalMe、WikiMaths、METR-LA、PEMS-BAY）及基线方法进行了批判性审计。通过统计分析发现这些数据集主要受时间信号驱动，且PyTorch Geometric Temporal库默认对Chickenpox和PedalMe进行了一阶差分处理，削弱了基准质量。SARIMA等空间无感知线性基线表现强劲，挑战了GNN方法的优越性，并提出了基于SARIMA残差的混合GNN模型。
AI.motivation: 时空图神经网络（GNN）在短期多元时间序列预测中被广泛使用，但其方法创新主要在少数基准数据集上进行评估。研究动机在于质疑这些基准数据集的判别可靠性，并理解为何简单的线性模型（如SARIMA）能在此类基准上与GNN竞争，从而揭示现有评估协议中的不足。
AI.method: 方法包括：1) 使用Pearson相关性分析五个基准数据集的滞后时间、空间和偏空间相关性；2) 从频谱角度证明一阶差分作为高通滤波器会放大高频噪声、抑制低频信号；3) 重新评估多种线性基线（持久预测、历史平均、AR(H)、RidgeVAR、DLinear、SARIMA）在原始与差分数据上的表现；4) 提出SARIMA+GNN混合模型，让GNN学习预测SARIMA残差；5) 通过合成图过程实验验证节点时序异质性对GNN性能的影响。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1) WikiMaths上SARIMA达到0.507 MSE，优于多数SOTA模型；Chickenpox上SARIMA+LSTM-time达到0.713 MSE，超越TDE-GNN（0.787±0.018）；2) METR-LA和PEMS-BAY上SARIMA+GCRN-GRU分别取得MAE 3.32和1.71，达到SOTA水平；3) 原始未差分Chickenpox数据上所有模型测试MSE更低，泛化差距更小；4) 合成实验显示节点时间系数的方差Var({a_i})对GRUGCN-ARIMA的MSE差距有显著正向影响，而空间系数方差的影响不显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：广泛使用的时空预测基准数据集主要受时间信号驱动而非空间信号，PyTorch Geometric Temporal库对Chickenpox和PedalMe的默认一阶差分处理引入了结构性偏差，削弱了基准的判别能力。研究建议减少对这些数据集的过度依赖，采用更严格的统计评估方法，并建议使用未差分数据和SARIMA作为标准基线。SARIMA残差学习范式为GNN模型设计提供了新方向。

title: Trojaning the Alignment: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against Graph Foundation Models
summary: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) align graph representations with language semantics to support transferable graph learning. Despite these advantages, the backdoor vulnerability of GFMs on TAGs remains insufficiently understood, especially under graph-language alignment, where graph and text representations are trained to constrain each other in a shared semantic space. Existing backdoor attacks mainly target either the graph side or the text side, treating the two modalities independently. This makes direct adaptation ineffective: graph-only triggers can be constrained by clean text semantics, while text-only triggers alter the language view but do not directly shift the graph representation being aligned and scored. TAGs also impose a stealth challenge because triggers are exposed as both node text and local graph structure, making incoherent trigger attributes or anomalous subgraphs easy to inspect or filter. In this paper, we propose STAG, a stealthy trojan attack framework designed for the graph-language alignment interface of GFMs on TAGs. STAG coordinates a graph-trigger generator with a text-side soft prompt so that trigger-attached graph representations and triggered text representations move toward the same target-class text region. To address TAG-specific stealthiness, STAG realizes trigger nodes as readable text through candidate retrieval and regularizes the trigger-attached subgraph so that its local structure remains close to the original subgraph. Extensive experiments on multiple TAG datasets and representative GFMs demonstrate the effectiveness and stealthiness of STAG. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: STAG 是一种针对文本属性图（TAGs）上图基础模型（GFMs）的隐蔽后门攻击框架，通过协同图侧触发器生成器和文本侧软提示，将触发后的图表示和文本表示共同推向目标类别语义区域，同时实现触发节点的可读文本和合理的局部图结构，以实现高攻击成功率并抵御现有防御。
AI.motivation: 现有后门攻击主要针对单模态（图或文本），无法有效攻击 GFM 中图-语言对齐接口。图侧触发器受干净文本语义约束，文本侧触发器无法移动被对齐的图表示，导致直接迁移效果差。此外，TAG 触发器同时暴露为节点文本和图结构，不连贯的文本或异常子图容易被检测或过滤。
AI.method: STAG 联合优化图触发生成器（MLP，基于节点文本嵌入生成触发子图的特征和邻接矩阵）和文本侧软提示，通过双层 min-max 优化对齐两者至目标类别文本质心。隐蔽性方面：(1) 语义隐蔽——通过对抗扰动训练使触发特征靠近目标类别文本区域，并利用 LLM 生成可读候选文本进行检索；(2) 结构隐蔽——正则化触发子图的度分布（均值和方差）以保持局部结构合理性。优化采用分块坐标更新：对抗扰动 σ、代理编码器、触发生成器和软提示依次更新。
AI.result: 在 Cora、CiteSeer、WikiCS、OGB-arxiv 四个数据集上对 GraphCLIP、GraphGPT、G2P2 三种 GFM 进行评估，STAG 在无防御下 ASR 均超过 92.4%，ACC 下降有限；在 Prune、OD、DOMINANT 三种防御下 ASR 仍保持在 95.2% 以上，显著优于 CrossBA、PoisonPrompt、BadCLIP 基线。PPL 为 58.4（接近干净文本 53.4），ONION 检测率为 0%，度偏移 |Δd̄|=0.66，KS=0.27，隐蔽性良好。消融实验验证了图侧攻击目标和文本侧攻击目标以及两项隐蔽损失的必要性。
AI.conclusion: STAG 首次系统研究了针对 TAGs 上 GFM 图-语言对齐接口的后门攻击，通过跨模态协同和 TAG 特定的隐蔽机制实现了高攻击成功率与高隐蔽性的统一。未来方向包括将分析扩展到图检索增强生成等更广泛的图-LLM 流水线，以及针对对齐级后门攻击的有效防御。

title: Free-Probability Kernels for Zero-Rollout Hyperparameter Selection in Reservoir Computing
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS)
summary: Reservoir computing (RC) couples a fixed recurrent dynamical system with a trained lightweight readout, but this efficiency is partly lost during hyperparameter selection: the recurrent gain, input scale, and leakage rate determine the reservoir's stability and temporal processing regime and are usually tuned through many rollouts. We introduce a deterministic, pilot-informed selector for leaky linear reservoirs followed by coordinate-wise nonlinear features. Free probability yields cross-lag propagation coefficients that summarize how the reservoir mixes past inputs. In the large-width limit, these coefficients define a deterministic temporal kernel that approximates the finite-reservoir feature geometry. Kernel ridge regression on a short labelled pilot sequence therefore ranks candidate operating regimes without instantiating or rolling out a reservoir, and the selected configuration transfers across widths. Across ten synthetic temporal benchmarks, zero-rollout selection obtains a mean deployment score of $0.772$, compared with $0.774$ for exhaustive simulation-based search, while avoiding $156\,600$ selection rollouts. With a small rollout budget, the proposed ranking provides the strongest mean performance at every tested budget and reaches the exhaustive reference using $4.8\%$ of its rollout cost. On four public electricity-transformer-temperature (ETT) forecasting datasets, five retained candidates recover the exhaustive operating point on three datasets. On multivariate cellular-traffic forecasting, 15 rollouts per cell reach the 462-rollout exhaustive reference and outperform random search and Bayesian optimization at low budgets. These results position free-probability kernels as deterministic surrogates for selecting reservoir operating regimes when validation rollouts are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出基于自由概率的零滚动超参数选择器，用确定性大宽度核替代有储层滚动，在合成与真实数据集上以极低成本逼近甚至匹配穷举搜索。
AI.motivation: 回声状态网络等储层计算的高效性因超参数（循环增益、输入尺度、泄漏率）需大量滚动调优而受损，且选择结果可能随部署宽度变化。
AI.method: 对带坐标非线性特征的渗漏线性储层，推导混合交叉滞后传播系数 τ_{k,ℓ}（利用自由概率/Ginibre 矩），构造大宽度下确定性非线性时序核；用短标注 pilot 序列上的核脊回归对候选 (σ_r, σ_in, α) 进行零滚动排序。
AI.result: 10个合成任务零滚动平均得分0.772 vs 穷举0.774，省去156,600次滚动；预算筛选在K=250（4.8%预算）匹配穷举；ETT数据集K=5在3/4上恢复穷举工作点；Telco任务FP-5以15次滚动达到穷举462次滚动水平并显著优于随机搜索与TPE。
AI.conclusion: 自由概率核作为验证滚动稀缺时的储层运行机制选择代理，兼具宽度无关性、确定性与样本高效性；理论可推广至多种循环矩阵结构。

title: RODE: A Radial-Orthogonal Decoupled Engine for Optimization
summary: Modern neural network training increasingly uses matrix-aware optimizers, yet their conditioned matrix step is typically added directly to the weight, jointly changing its norm and direction. This interaction matters because the current norm determines angular motion, while directional learning can drive norm growth and thereby alter later steps. We introduce RODE, which gives the radial and directional components separate update rules and step sizes. RODE explicitly updates the matrix Frobenius norm through a scalar radial rule, while its directional channel performs Newton--Schulz-conditioned updates in the tangent space. Controlled GPT-2 interventions show gains from both direct norm control and RODE's directional update. Across two language-modeling and two image-classification tasks, RODE outperforms both Muon variants in every direct comparison and ends with lower full-model norms. At 1.5B scale, using the learning rate transferred directly from the Qwen2-style LM sweep, RODE lowers loss from 4.145 to 3.346 and final global norm from 11964 to 2183 relative to Muon RMS, with fixed-radius RODE improving further. For Qwen3.5-9B full-parameter fine-tuning, all six optimizers use the same tuning budget and the same formal-training and evaluation settings; RODE outperforms both Muon variants on all four evaluation tasks and attains the highest mean on GSM8K and MATH-500. Thus, decoupling radial and directional dynamics offers a more effective and controllable approach to matrix optimization.

AI.tldr: RODE提出将矩阵优化中的径向（范数）和方向（切向）动力学解耦，通过独立的标量径向更新规则和Newton-Schulz条件化的切向更新，使权重范数可独立控制。该方法在语言建模和图像分类任务上均优于Muon变体，并在1.5B和9B规模上展现出更低的损失和更可控的范数增长。
AI.motivation: 现有矩阵感知优化器（如Muon）直接将条件化矩阵步加到权重上，同时改变范数和方向。这种耦合导致方向学习驱动范数增长，而当前范数又影响后续角度更新，形成不良交互。范数增长会逐渐抑制后续方向性进展，降低有效学习率。需要将这两个几何上不同的效应解耦，使其成为可独立调节的优化变量。
AI.method: RODE将矩阵W分解为W=ρU（ρ为Frobenius范数，U为单位方向矩阵）。径向通道：通过标量规则ρ_{t+1}=max{ρ_t-η_ρ·s_t, κ_floor·ρ_t}显式更新范数，其中s_t为梯度在当前方向上的投影。方向通道：将动量投影到切线空间，进行Newton-Schulz迭代条件化（每次迭代后重新投影），然后通过球面测地线步实现更新：U_{t+1}=U_t cosθ_t - D_t^⊥ sinθ_t。两个通道使用独立学习率η_ρ和η_dir。可选RODE-SNR变体添加切向梯度比率阻尼。理论分析提供Lyapunov函数收敛保证。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，RODE均优于两种Muon变体：GPT-2损失降低0.0491，Qwen2风格LM降低0.0454，CIFAR-100准确率提升2.36点，ImageNet-1K提升4.48点。在1.5B规模超参数迁移中，RODE将损失从4.145降至3.346，全局范数从11964降至2183（相比Muon RMS）。在Qwen3.5-9B全参数微调中，RODE在所有四个评估任务上均优于两种Muon变体，在GSM8K和MATH-500上取得六种优化器中最高均值。系统开销：融合实现达到AdamW的0.72倍吞吐量（vs Muon RMS的0.77倍）。
AI.conclusion: 径向-方向解耦为矩阵优化提供了更有效和可控的方法。直接加性矩阵更新耦合了权重范数演变和方向进展，而RODE将它们视为独立的优化坐标，具有独立的更新规则和步长。实验证明显式范数控制能有效改善优化性能，且这种优势在大规模训练中得以保持。

title: Designing a Robust LLM-Based Evaluation System for Agentic AI in Drug Discovery Through Human Alignment
summary: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are reshaping scientific workflows in chemistry and drug discovery, but evaluating their open-ended, tool-augmented outputs remains a fundamental bottleneck. Reference-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE fail to capture semantic correctness, while expert human evaluation does not scale to the iteration speed these systems demand. The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative, but existing drug discovery benchmarks deploy LLM judges without validating their alignment with human experts. In this work, we present an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework for ChatInvent, an agentic drug discovery assistant deployed at AstraZeneca, with four contributions. First, we define four output-quality evaluation dimensions---Completeness, Relevancy, Structural Clarity, and Scope Adherence---alongside deterministic Tool Call Correctness checks. Second, we validate the judge through a human alignment study with five expert annotators, comparing Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, and Llama 3.1 70B as candidate judges. Third, we optimize the best-performing judge using few-shot demonstrations of human-annotated examples, improving alignment with the human majority vote from 0.80 to 0.86. Fourth, applying the optimized judge to 70 held-out questions, we surface concrete limitations and find that informal phrasings do not systematically degrade output quality; if anything, it is helpful to have the LLM rewrite the original question before querying the agent. Our framework provides a reusable template for human-aligned evaluation of agentic systems in scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿斯利康内部 ChatInvent 药物发现智能体，提出了一套基于 LLM-as-a-Judge 的自动评估框架，核心创新在于通过人类专家标注对裁判模型进行对齐验证与少样本优化，并将该框架应用于 70 道测试问题以揭示系统的具体弱点与改进方向。
AI.motivation: 药物发现领域的智能体系统（如 ChatInvent）输出开放、依赖工具调用，传统基于参考答案的指标（BLEU/ROUGE）无法捕捉语义正确性，而专家人工评估难以跟上快速迭代。因此需要一种可扩展且经过人类对齐验证的自动评估方法，以填补现有基准（如 SciToolEval、MolBench）未验证 LLM 裁判与人类判断一致性的空白。
AI.method:
1. 定义五维评估体系：Tool Call Correctness（确定性比对）+ 四个 LLM 评判维度（Completeness、Relevancy、Structural Clarity、Scope Adherence），采用 DSPy Signature 实现；
2. 构造 100 道测试问题（含 5 种正式度变体与变量实例化），覆盖 40 个 Tool 类与 60 个 Workflow 类；
3. 由 5 位 AI 化学专家对 35 道（含 5 道重复）问题进行标注，作为对齐基准；
4. 比较 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5、Llama 3.1 70B 作为裁判的表现，评估其自我一致性及与人类多数投票的对齐度（Cohen 加权 κ + 精确匹配率）；
5. 使用 DSPy 的 LabeledFewShot 优化器，以 20 个标注样本作为少样本示例，将 Gemini 3.1 Pro 裁判与人类多数投票的对齐度从 0.80 提升至 0.86。
AI.result:
1. 人类标注者间存在中-高度一致性（Fleiss κ=0.54，平均加权 Cohen κ=0.59），其中 Completeness 一致性最高，Scope Adherence 最低；
2. 各 LLM 裁判内部一致性普遍较高（整体 Fleiss κ=0.76），Claude Opus 4.7 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 表现最佳，但 GPT-5 在 Scope Adherence 维度上显著不稳定；
3. Gemini 3.1 Pro 与人类多数投票对齐度最高，且优于人类两两平均一致性（需谨慎解读）；
4. 经少样本优化后，Gemini 3.1 Pro 在 10 题验证集上的平均对齐度由 0.80 提升至 0.86；
5. 在 70 道保留问题上，ChatInvent 整体表现良好：Tool Call Correctness 90%、Structural Clarity 90%、Relevancy 86%、Scope Adherence 84%，但 Completeness 偏低（仅 43% 完全满足），主因为 Mol2Mol 工具常缺失 CSV 路径等关键返回信息；
6. Workflow 类问题比 Tool 类在 Completeness 与 Tool Call Correctness 上更低，但在 Relevancy、Clarity、Scope 上反而更高；
7. 问题正式度未对输出质量造成系统性下降，反而是过度正式或人工手写的问题得分略低，提示由 LLM 对用户提问进行改写预处理可能有益。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：通过严谨的人类对齐验证与少样本优化，LLM-as-a-Judge 可作为药物发现智能体可靠、可扩展的评估手段。该工作弥补了 SciToolEval、MolBench 等基准缺少人类对齐验证的缺陷，并提供了一个可复用的领域专用评估模板。同时指出当前 ChatInvent 的主要缺陷集中在输出完整性与工具返回规范性上，未来可通过将裁判嵌入智能体循环、扩充对抗性测试集以及结合更新更强的模型来进一步完善该评估体系。

title: Causal Modeling of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes via Adaptive LLM Proposals
summary: Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes (APOs) such as preterm birth and gestational diabetes can have long-term consequences for both the mother and child, yet an understanding of their causes remains elusive. Causal discovery in this domain is especially challenging due to a paucity of data and incomplete domain knowledge. As a result, pure data-driven methods fail, and Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remain inconsistent or contradictory. We introduce a neurosymbolic framework for generating plausible causal hypotheses that iteratively combines the broad prior knowledge of LLMs with empirical scoring on data. Our method treats the LLM as an adaptive proposal distribution, generating hypotheses that are scored against empirical data; the resulting high-scoring graphs are then used to update the LLM's context, steering subsequent generations toward more promising regions of the hypothesis space. We evaluate our approach on a real-world clinical dataset for modeling APOs and their risk factors, comparing our results against an expert-constructed causal graph. Our method recovers all expert-validated edges and identifies additional plausible causal relations not previously listed by experts, potentially providing new insights for targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLARA框架,将LLM作为自适应提议分布,通过生成-评估-更新的迭代循环结合LLM先验知识与数据驱动评分,在产科不良结局因果发现任务中恢复了全部专家验证边并发现了新的合理因果关系。
AI.motivation: 产科不良结局(APOs)的因果建模面临两大瓶颈:数据稀缺使纯数据驱动方法失效,而LLM的输出存在不一致性且无法区分因果与关联。现有LLM增强的理论精炼方法对初始假设敏感,容易陷入局部最优。需要一种能够融合LLM广泛先验与数据驱动评分、并进行全局搜索的神经符号框架。
AI.method: CLARA借鉴MIMIC随机优化算法的"采样-评估-更新"循环,将LLM作为自适应提议分布:(1)从LLM采样一批因果图候选;(2)使用基于决策树的TreeBIC评分对候选进行数据驱动评估;(3)从Top-K高分图中构建上下文表示C_t,更新LLM提示以引导后续生成向高分区域收敛。最终通过Top-K图的边集联合生成最终因果图,并提供"全图"和"公共边"两种上下文表示变体。
AI.result: 在ALARM合成数据集上,CLARA的SID比一次性LLM生成低32%,比数据驱动方法低55%,比理论精炼低28%。在真实nuMoM2b产科数据集上恢复了全部31条专家验证边,并提出30条额外边,其中87%被临床专家认定为已有证据支持,13%为合理推测。CLARA在不同数据量和噪声水平下表现稳定,而PC和FCI在高噪声下退化。"公共边"变体将提示token减少至原来的1/3,性能接近完整版CLARA。
AI.conclusion: CLARA是一种有效的神经符号因果发现框架,通过迭代结合LLM先验和数据驱动评分,克服了LLM输出的随机性和数据稀缺问题,在高风险临床领域展现出比纯数据驱动、纯LLM和LLM增强理论精炼方法更优的性能。未来方向包括引入定性影响约束、分层EDA分解、替代聚合策略以及LLM因果生成的微调。

title: FlatLand: Personalized Graph Federated Learning via Tailored Lorentz Space
comment: 34 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026 (Oral)
summary: Federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaborative training, but highly heterogeneous client data remain challenging, especially in graph federated learning where clients possess structurally diverse graphs. Existing personalized federated learning (PFL) methods ignore the intrinsic geometric properties of diverse graph structures. We propose FlatLand, a novel personalized federated learning method that embeds different clients' data in tailored Lorentz space of hyperbolic geometry. Our key insight is that hyperbolic geometry naturally accommodates the intrinsic negative curvature prevalent in real-world graphs, while the time-like dimension in Lorentz space provides a principled way to encode client-specific heterogeneity. We develop a parameter decoupling strategy that separates heterogeneous information (captured in time-like parameters) from common knowledge (preserved in space-like parameters), enabling direct aggregation without requiring client similarity estimation and extra calculation modules. Empirical results on diverse federated graph learning tasks demonstrate that FlatLand achieves superior performance, particularly in low-dimensional settings.

AI.tldr: FlatLand 是一种面向图联邦学习的个性化方法，通过为每个客户端分配量身定制的双曲 Lorentz 空间，并利用时间维参数编码客户端特异性异质性、空间维参数承载共享知识，实现无需客户端相似度估计或辅助模块的直接聚合，在低维场景下表现尤为突出。
AI.motivation: 联邦图学习中客户端图结构存在显著的结构异质性（Structural heterogeneity），而现有 PFL 方法均基于欧几里得空间的统一平坦几何假设，未能捕捉图数据内在的双曲特性，且现有处理异质性的机制（参数解耦、客户端相似度估计、辅助模块）较为复杂，亟需一种更简洁有效的几何感知方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 为每个客户端 c 分配可学习的 Lorentz 尺度参数 K_c（截面曲率 -1/K_c），以 Forman-Ricci 曲率做结构感知初始化并在训练中自适应更新；(2) 基于 Lorentz 坐标分解的参数解耦策略：将 Lorentz 线性层矩阵 M̂ = [m, M] 拆分，m（时间维参数，个性化、保留本地）与 K_c 编码客户端特异性异质性，M（空间维参数，共享、上传至服务器聚合）；(3) 聚合仅对空间维参数 M 做 FedAvg 式加权平均，时间维参数与 K_c 保留本地。理论方面，证明定理 4.1（不同 Ricci 曲率客户端需各自量身定制的曲率）、定理 4.3（时间维分量与客户端身份 C 的互信息 >0，空间维分量为 0）以及命题 6.1（聚合后表征仍保持在 Lorentz 流形上）。
AI.result: 在 Cora/CiteSeer/ogbn-arxiv/Photo 等同质图数据集（10/20 客户端）以及 Roman-empire/Minesweeper/Tolokers/Questions 等异质图数据集上，节点分类准确率均优于 FedAvg、FedProx、FedPer、GCFL、FedGNN、FedSage+、FED-PUB、FedGTA、AdaFGL、FedHGCN 等基线；图分类（CHEM、BIO-CHEM-SN）也取得最佳或具有竞争力的结果；在低维嵌入（维度从 64 降至 4）下双曲方法优势更显著；部分客户端参与（10%）仍稳健（81.82% vs FedAvg 18.14%）；消融实验证实自适应曲率、时间维解耦策略及 Lorentz 空间三者缺一不可；曲率初始化方法（Ricci/Ollivier/常量/MLP）影响甚微，体现可学习曲率的鲁棒性；理论证明保持 O(1/T) 收敛率且额外开销极小。
AI.conclusion: FlatLand 通过引入量身定制的 Lorentz 空间与基于时间维/空间维的参数解耦，提供了一种简洁、有效的几何感知个性化联邦学习框架；首次将双曲几何与 PFL 进行原则性融合以应对客户端异质性；尤其在通信高效的低维场景下优势明显，为非欧几何在联邦个性化中的应用开辟了新方向；未来工作将扩展至混合曲率空间与更广泛的模态。

title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
summary: Structured pruning reduces the size and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by removing weight columns, but the resulting output error can degrade accuracy. Existing training-free compensation methods use an additive bias or a single orthogonal rotation on the output side of the retained weight. These corrections leave its input singular frame unchanged and therefore limit how the retained weight can adapt after column removal. We propose COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation), a training-free compensation framework that applies alternating left and right orthogonal rotations to the retained weight. The right rotation is optimized on a reduced Stiefel manifold, while singular values are rescaled using generalized cross-validation to select the regularization strength for each layer. COEC further tempers the calibration Gram matrix to reduce the dominance of high-energy activation directions and introduces an alignment penalty that preserves the geometric relation between adjacent attention this http URL components use second-order statistics from a small calibration set and require neither backpropagation through the LLM nor retraining of the model parameters. COEC is independent of the column pruning criterion and can be applied to multiple structured pruning methods. Experiments on the Llama-3, Llama-3.1, and Qwen2.5 model families across multiple structured sparsity levels show that COEC improves perplexity on every model and zero-shot accuracy in most settings over existing compensation methods, with larger gains at higher sparsity. These results show that post-pruning compensation can recover part of the performance lost to column removal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COEC，一种面向大语言模型结构化剪枝的训练后、无需反向传播的补偿方法。针对现有加性偏置或仅左侧正交旋转无法调整输入奇异框架的问题，COEC 对保留权重交替施加左、右正交旋转，并按奇异模式缩放；右旋转在缩减 Stiefel 流形上求解，正则强度逐层由 GCV 自动选择。同时引入 Gram 谱温与跨层几何对齐惩罚。在 Llama-3/3.1 和 Qwen2.5 的 7B–72B 模型、10%–30% 稀疏率实验中，COEC 普遍降低困惑度，并在多数情况下提升七项零样本任务平均准确率，且高稀疏率收益更明显。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝删除完整权重列后，保留权重仍沿用预训练模型原有的输入—输出坐标关系，导致由输入结构变化引起的输出误差。加性偏置只能修正平均误差，单侧正交旋转或无约束最小二乘重拟合则分别受限于输入奇异框架不变或在少量校准数据上过拟合。论文观察到剪枝会使每层输入奇异子空间平均旋转约 22°，因此需要一种能重构信号流、限制权重失真且无需 LLM 反向传播的补偿机制。
AI.method: 对于每个剪枝模块，利用 128 条 WikiText-2 校准序列单次前向累积激活 Gram 矩阵及原始权重对应的二阶统计量。COEC 将补偿矩阵参数化为 Q_l W_hat Q_r：左旋转通过闭式加权正交 Procrustes 更新；右旋转初始化为单位阵，在缩减 Stiefel 流形上通过正交回缩的投影梯度或 Newton–Schulz/Cayley 方法迭代求解，并逐轮重估全局尺度。GCV 驱动的逐奇异值重缩放通过显式有效自由度抑制校准过拟合。激活 Gram 矩阵做谱温处理以降低高能激活方向支配；注意力输出投影另加入锚定于未剪枝模型的跨层子空间对齐惩罚。整个过程不存储所有 token 激活、不执行反向传播，也不重训模型参数。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3-70B、Qwen2.5-{7B,14B,32B,72B} 及 10%、20%、30% 稀疏率下，COEC 相对 Wanda-sp、FLAP bias 和 RCPU 的原生补偿均取得稳定改进，且稀疏率越高通常收益越大。30% 稀疏率下，基于 Wanda-sp 选择时，COEC 在六个模型上均降低困惑度，最大例为 Qwen2.5-32B 从 13.90 降至 9.64；零样本准确率均持平或提升。基于 RCPU 选择时，COEC 在六个模型上困惑度均更低，五/六个模型准确率更高；Qwen2.5-14B 是准确率例外，RCPU 高 0.7 个百分点，但 COEC 仍保持困惑度优势。消融显示 GCV 逐模重缩放和双侧旋转主要贡献困惑度下降，缩减 Stiefel 求解主要提升零样本准确率，Gram 温处理则恢复部分困惑度。校准样本从 32 增至 256 时，COEC 在所有设置下均为最低困惑度，并随样本量增加单调改善。30% 剪枝使参数、峰值内存和每 token 密集 FLOPs 降低约 23%–29%，补偿不改变模型形状；7B–8B 模型补偿耗时约 45–86 GPU 分钟。
AI.conclusion: COEC 表明，结构化剪枝后仅改变保留列仍不足以恢复性能；使用少量校准二阶统计量进行双侧正交等效补偿、逐奇异值受控重缩放和轻量几何对齐，可在不改变压缩模型结构、不增加部署成本的前提下恢复相当一部分精度损失。方法的通用性较强：不依赖具体列重要性准则，并可作为 Wanda-sp、FLAP、RCPU 等剪枝流程的即插即用补偿器。不过，其性能增益主要来自六类模型与中低稀疏率实验，尚未覆盖全部模型规模、剪枝范式、生成质量或更广泛校准数据，且二次统计假设及跨层锚点的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Capturing Cardiac Cyclicity through Phase-Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
summary: The cyclic structure of physiological processes offers a natural prior for self-supervised representation learning, and the cardiac cycle provides a particularly well-defined setting in which to exploit it. We derive a phase-equivariant self-supervised objective and introduce Winder, a joint-embedding architecture that organises representations into phase-invariant coordinates and phase-rotating harmonic subspaces. Its transport operator is fixed and closed-form, derived from the cycle's geometry rather than learned, and adds no parameters. Evaluated on PTB-XL under a frozen linear-probe protocol, Winder attains diagnostic accuracy within the range reported by state-of-the-art self-supervised methods at a ~1 M parameter footprint, while exhibiting phase-equivariant latent geometry. These findings demonstrate that explicitly encoding cardiac-phase symmetry can preserve diagnostically useful information while yielding a latent geometry that is legible, parameter-efficient, and directly tied to a measurable physiological quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Winder，一种基于心脏周期循环结构先验的自监督学习方法，通过相位等变目标函数学习心电图表征，在仅约 1M 参数规模下实现与最先进自监督方法相当的诊断精度。
AI.motivation: 心电图等生理信号具有天然的周期（循环）结构，现有自监督学习方法未充分利用这一对称性先验，导致表征缺乏与可测量生理量直接对应的可解释几何结构。
AI.method: 推导相位等变的自监督目标函数；设计 Winder 联合嵌入架构，将表征组织为相位不变坐标系与相位旋转谐波子空间；传输算子固定且为闭式解，直接由周期几何推导而来，不引入额外参数。
AI.result: 在 PTB-XL 数据集上采用冻结线性探针协议评估，Winder 以约 1M 参数达到与当前最先进自监督方法相当的诊断准确率，同时展现出相位等变的潜空间几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 显式编码心脏相位对称性可在保持诊断有效信息的同时，获得清晰、可参数高效且与可测量生理量直接关联的潜空间几何。

title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Constructing Planning Domain Models from Clinical Narratives
summary: Surgical procedures such as laparoscopic appendectomy are complex, high-stakes processes, yet formalizing their workflows for decision support remains a significant challenge. Inducing probabilistic planning domain models in this setting is particularly difficult due to the lack of structured event data and the prevalence of implicit actions in clinical narratives, which neither empirical symbolic methods nor Large Language Models (LLMs) can adequately address on their own. We introduce NSPIN, a neurosymbolic framework for inducing probabilistic planning domain models from unstructured clinical narratives. Our method extracts and imputes structured event sequences from raw text using a pretrained LLM, then induces a PPDDL model and refines its preconditions with LLM-proposed revisions, guided by empirical validation. We evaluate the approach on 2,660 laparoscopic appendectomy notes written by 9 surgeons. NSPIN yields models that generalize to unseen notes, and expert clinical review indicates its induced knowledge is largely consistent with surgical practice.

AI.tldr: NSPIN 是一个神经符号混合框架，用于从非结构化临床叙事文本（外科手术记录）中自动构建概率规划领域模型（PPDDL），以解决纯经验方法或纯 LLM 方法在临床文本信息稀疏和隐式动作缺失方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 外科手术流程（如腹腔镜阑尾切除术）复杂且高风险，但因临床叙事缺乏结构化事件数据且大量隐式动作被省略，传统的纯经验符号方法依赖结构化轨迹无法适用，纯 LLM 方法则缺乏归纳逻辑推理能力，无法独立构建出可泛化的概率规划模型。
AI.method: 1) **模式创建**：LLM 根据领域描述生成包含类型化对象、观察谓词和动作谓词的 PPDDL 模式；2) **序列生成**：通过多次采样、多数投票共识、Kemeny 排序聚合进行信息抽取，再由 LLM 推断缺失的隐式步骤完成序列插补；3) **规划模型构建**：基于数据驱动（贪心覆盖+最大似然）从结构化序列中归纳初始 PPDDL 动作模式，再使用 LLM 基于验证集表现对前置条件进行语义修正，去除虚假相关。
AI.result: 在 2,660 份由 9 位外科医生撰写的腹腔镜阑尾切除术记录上 9 折交叉验证：NSPIN 在下一动作预测上 Top-1 准确率达 0.42、Top-3 达 0.64、TADR 仅 0.16，显著优于 LLM-only（0.20/0.27/0.68）和 LLM-Example 基线；序列插补和 LLM 前置条件修正均带来统计显著的提升；专家临床评审认为其推导的知识与外科实践高度一致。
AI.conclusion: NSPIN 通过结合 LLM 的语言抽取与插补能力和符号归纳的逻辑严谨性，成功从非结构化临床叙事中构建出可泛化的概率规划模型，是构建临床决策支持系统的重要一步。未来需扩展到其他手术和临床领域，并进一步改进对概率效果而非仅前置条件的精炼。

title: Tydra: An Efficient Hybrid Model for Tabular Data
summary: Transformer-based tabular foundation models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur quadratic computational cost with context length. On the other hand, subquadratic SSM-based alternatives such as Hydra trade away accuracy for efficiency. To balance both, we introduce Tydra, a hybrid Transformer-State Space Model (SSM) architecture for tabular in-context learning that interleaves attention and SSM layers. Across 30 OpenML datasets, Tydra reduces inference time by 30% relative to TabPFN while retaining much of its predictive performance. Tydra also outperforms an approximately ten-times-larger Hydra model while providing faster inference. The results indicate that hybrid architectures are a promising direction for tabular foundation models.

AI.tldr: Tydra提出了一种混合Transformer-SSM架构，用于表格数据的上下文学习，通过交错注意力层和Hydra状态空间层，在保持TabPFN预测性能的同时，将推理时间减少约30%。
AI.motivation: 纯Transformer表格基础模型（如TabPFN）存在二次计算复杂度问题，在大规模或长上下文任务上推理成本高昂；纯SSM模型（如Hydra）虽然高效但牺牲了预测精度。因此需要一种能同时兼顾准确性和效率的架构。
AI.method: 提出Tydra混合架构，将TabPFN的注意力层与Hydra的双向状态空间混合层交错排列。默认配置{4HT}为4对Hydra-Transformer块（共8层）。使用TabPFN先验框架的合成任务进行元训练，采用AdamW优化器，学习率10^-4，有效批大小64。同时研究了六种不同的层比例和排列方式（{4HT}, {4TH}, H{6T}H, {2H}{4T}{2H}, T{6H}T, {2T}{4H}{2T}）。
AI.result: 在30个OpenML数据集上：Tydra {4HT}相对TabPFN推理速度提升高达29.9%（平均24.8%），AUROC差异仅0.29个百分点。Tydra优于参数量约10倍的Hydra 160M模型，同时推理更快。在合成基准测试中，Tydra的扩展性远优于TabPFN和Hydra 160M，在2^13行以内接近最快的Hydra 16M速度。{4HT}配置在精度-速度权衡上表现最佳，而T{6H}T配置因Hydra层过于集中导致精度下降最大（平均-1.24 AUROC）。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构是表格基础模型的有前景方向，Tydra证明了将SSM与注意力层交错可在保持TabPFN级别预测性能的同时显著降低推理成本。未来工作方向包括探索其他次二次序列混合器、扩展到大规模长上下文数据、以及结合循环Transformer等正交效率提升方法。

title: TRACE-C: Rank-Calibrated Relational Anomaly Detection for Multi-Stream Operational Telemetry
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL . Data: doi: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10063 . Preprint of record: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22012123
summary: Operational telemetry can be jointly anomalous while every individual stream stays inside its familiar range. TRACE-C is an auditable strictly-prior rank-calibrated detector for aligned multi-stream telemetry: same-regime rolling median/MAD residuals feed three window channels -- a maximum normalized local sum, a Gaussian copula-form dependence contrast on robust-z residuals, and a worst standardized AR(1) innovation -- whose channel ranks are Fisher-aggregated and ranked against earlier aggregates. We evaluate six Great Britain grid streams with a January-April 2019 fit, July-December 2019 development evidence, and a 2020 hold-out frozen before inspection. TRACE-C ranks Storm Atiyah first among 2019 test windows, but a disclosed channel ablation attributes that rank to the local channel, not the copula-form channel: copula-only ranks Atiyah 59th. The short 9 August frequency event is ranked far lower by the fused detector (143) than by the temporal channel alone (40), and reconstruction baselines rank it first. In 2020 no window is selected, which is consistent with record-rule saturation rather than an uneventful year; the highest-ranked frozen window was later interpreted as Storm Ellen. Three interpretive limits carry throughout. The resulting p-values are selection quantities, not event probabilities. The copula-form channel is not a literal copula density: the method applies no probability-integral or normal-score transform. Empirical rank counts are diagnostics, not coverage or false-discovery proofs. Every table and figure in this paper is generated from committed machine-readable reports.

AI.tldr: TRACE-C是一个可审计的、严格先验的、秩校准的多流遥测异常检测器。它使用滚动中位数/MAD残差，通过三个窗口通道（局部、依赖、时间序列）进行评分，通过Fisher聚合进行秩校准。论文使用英国电网六条流数据（2019年1-4月拟合，2019年7-12月开发，2020年冻结保留）进行评估，揭示了该方法在2019年将Storm Atiyah排在首位，但通道消融表明这主要归功于局部通道而非依赖通道；2020年没有窗口被选中，这可能反映记录规则饱和而非真正平静的年份。论文强调其p值是选择量而非事件概率，依赖通道并非真正的copula密度，经验秩计数是诊断而非覆盖证明。
AI.motivation: 运营遥测具有多变量特性，单个流可能在正常范围内，但联合配置可能异常。简单秩论证在交换性假设下最严格，但遥测数据具有序列依赖性和非平稳性。此外，粗略汇总可能抹除短暂的物理瞬变。因此需要一个能够处理多流联合异常、保留残差量级、并明确报告选择路径和限制的可审计检测器。
AI.method:
1. 严格先验在线评分：对每个流和制度（结算期×工作日/周末），使用前K=40个同制度值计算滚动中位数和MAD，形成鲁棒z残差并裁剪到±10。
2. 三个窗口通道（W=4，即2小时）：
   - 局部通道L_w：最大绝对归一化窗口和
   - 依赖通道G_w：残差交叉积矩阵上的高斯copula形式负对数密度对比（但未应用PIT变换）
   - 时间通道T_w：窗口内最大标准化AR(1)创新
3. 通道秩和Fisher聚合：每个通道的秩通过240个严格先验分数的尾随参考计算，三个通道秩通过Fisher和S_w聚合，再与所有先验S值比较得到外秩p_w。
4. 选择策略：先尝试BH（q=0.05），若未选中则回退到上记录规则（p_w ≤ 1/(|S_w|+1)），最后应用每48行块最多2个选择的注意力预算。
AI.result: 2019年开发段：Storm Atiyah排名第1（p=0.000350），但通道消融表明这由局部通道驱动（copula单独排名第59）。8月9日频率事件排名第143，而时间通道单独排名第40。2020年冻结段：未选中任何窗口（基准0.87），Storm Ciara最佳排名第44，Storm Dennis排名第137，封锁期最佳排名第45。最高排名的2020窗口（8月20日03:00）后被解释为Storm Ellen。后验基线比较显示卷积自编码器和PCA重建在2019频率事件上排名第1，而TRACE-C排名第143。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-C应理解为严格先验的秩校准检测器，而非字面的copula校准程序。其秩p值支持排序和选择，但不是估计的事件概率或后验置信度。证据好坏参半且具有运营参考价值：2019年将Storm Atiyah排在首位，但消融表明这是局部驱动的窗口；2020年冻结运行未产生警报，同时其排名列表包含合理的天气相关极端值。结果揭示了记录饱和、融合权衡和传感器/聚合限制，而非建立名义FDR或copula发现。未来工作应预注册依赖感知选择器，在新的未触及周期上评估，保留子周期频率信息，并使用日历感知预算替代固定的48行注意力块。

title: ConceptTS: LLM-Guided Concept Bottlenecks for Interpretable Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: State-of-the-art multivariate time-series forecasters can model complex temporal and cross-variable dependencies, yet their opaque representations provide limited insight into why a particular forecast is produced. This lack of transparency restricts their use in settings where practitioners must understand and assess the factors underlying a prediction. We introduce ConceptTS, an interpretable forecasting framework that organizes its predictions around named, human-readable concepts. ConceptTS uses a large language model to propose task-relevant concepts and generate executable labeling rules, translating the language model's domain knowledge into direct supervision without costly manual concept annotation. The proposed concepts are organized into three complementary bottlenecks that describe the historical context, local forecast intervals, and the full forecast horizon. A shared decoder combines representations derived from their predicted activations to construct the forecast, making the model's decision process explicit and supporting direct concept-level interventions. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality dataset show that ConceptTS achieves accuracy competitive with strong black-box baselines while producing semantically meaningful concept activations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConceptTS，一种基于大语言模型引导的概念瓶颈（Concept Bottleneck）可解释多元时间序列预测框架。在北京空气质量数据集上以接近最优的精度提供概念级别的预测解释与干预能力。
AI.motivation: 当前先进的多元时间序列预测器（如Transformer、TCN等）虽能建模复杂的时序与跨变量依赖，但其内部表示是黑盒的，无法解释"为什么做出这样的预测"，这在高风险场景（如环境监测、医疗、能源）中限制了应用。现有可解释方法存在不足：传统Concept Bottleneck依赖专家定义概念并需逐样本标注；ProtoTS学习潜在原型但语义需训练后推断；TimeX++解释已有预测器而非让预测路径经过显式语义证据。
AI.method: 1）**LLM驱动的概念构造器**：离线调用LLM，根据数据集统计摘要、聚类配置提出三类概念集（回顾窗口、预测子窗口、全局预测），并生成可执行的Python谓词自动标注训练段。2）**ModernTCN编码器**：保留逐通道结构与时序信息，分别编码回看和预测时段。3）**三并行概念嵌入瓶颈（CEM）**：采用概念嵌入模型（每个概念有静态的"激活/未激活"嵌入），输入无关的嵌入防止信息绕过瓶颈泄露；加性注意力池化提取语义时点。4）**BiGRU跨子窗口连接 + 共享堆叠残差子解码器**：以由粗到精方式生成预测。5）**正则化残差通道**：承载概念无法表达的连续信息，权重α_res作为精度-可解释性权衡旋钮。6）**七项复合损失**：预测L1损失 + 三项概念BCE损失 + 边界平滑损失 + 概念坍缩方差惩罚 + 残差L2正则。
AI.result: 在北京空气质量数据集三个站点（Aotizhongxin、Dingling、Tiantan）的未来已知与仅回看两种设定下，ConceptTS与强黑盒基线（TFT、NHiT、Transformer、Informer、Crossformer等）精度相当——仅回看设定下MAE与最优基线差距在5%以内。例如Aotizhongxin站：未来已知设定MAE=12.71 μg/m³（与XGBoost、TFT、LightGBM相当）。通过概念计数消融、残差权重消融证明模型确实依赖概念通道；概念干预诊断中将真实标签反转后MAE从15.371剧增至99.661 μg/m³，直接证明概念路径承载主要预测信号。AUROC分析表明水平类概念学习良好（>0.9），但形态/趋势类概念因基于统计摘要的标签体系限制而学习较差。
AI.conclusion: ConceptTS成功将概念瓶颈范式从图像分类适配到多元时间序列预测：通过离线LLM构造有命名的时序概念与可执行标注规则，避免了大量人工标注；推理时不需LLM；在保持与黑盒模型竞争力的同时，提供了概念级别可检查、可干预的预测路径。未来工作包括丰富段级统计摘要以表达形态概念，以及处理长期周期主导的任务。

title: SPARCL: Spectral Partitioned Analytic Continual Learning
summary: Analytic continual learning has emerged as a strong exemplar-free alternative to gradient-based class-incremental learning because it replaces iterative optimization with closed-form ridge updates. Yet the usual forgetting narrative, centered on stochastic gradient overwriting, does not explain why analytic methods still drift on old classes despite exact recursive solvers. We identify the culprit as spectral interference: the joint ridge classifier for all tasks shares the inverse autocorrelation operator $(R+\lambda I)^{-1}$, so incoming task samples that load onto old dominant eigendirections dilute the spectrum and perturb old-class logits even when old labels are never revisited. Based on this view, we propose SPARCL, a spectral partitioned analytic continual learner that decomposes the running autocorrelation into a high-energy core and a residual complement, freezes old-class classifier components in the core subspace, and updates only the residual block through recursive least squares with an optional residual random-projection expansion. This yields a simple closed-form update with a provable invariance guarantee for the core contribution of old logits. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-A under a frozen ViT-B/16 protocol, SPARCL closes most of the gap from classical analytic learners to strong representation matchers, while remaining complementary to sparse feature-decorrelation approaches such as Fly-CL.

AI.tldr: SPARCL是一种基于谱分区的解析式持续学习方法，通过将特征自相关矩阵分解为高能量核心子空间和残差子空间，冻结旧类核心分类器、仅在残差块内更新，有效缓解了解析持续学习中的"谱干扰"导致的旧类遗忘问题，在CIFAR-100、CUB-200、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A上超越现有解析方法和强表示匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的类别增量学习(CIL)将遗忘归因于SGD梯度对参数的覆盖，但解析式持续学习(ACIL等)使用闭式递归最小二乘解，理论上不存在梯度覆盖却仍出现旧类退化。作者指出真正的原因是"谱干扰"：所有任务共享逆自相关算子(R+λI)⁻¹，新任务样本若投影到旧类主导特征方向上，会稀释特征值的逆增益，使旧类logits漂移。
AI.method: SPARCL的核心设计：(1)对累积自相关矩阵R进行特征分解，按能量阈值τ(如0.95)选择前k个主成分定义核心投影子空间P∥和残差子空间P⊥；(2)冻结旧类分类器在核心子空间的系数W∥^old；(3)仅在残差子空间内通过块Woodbury公式做解析更新得到W̃_t；(4)可选地通过正交于核心的随机投影Q_t扩展残差容量；(5)最终分类器W_t = 冻结的旧类核心 + 更新的残差与新类。理论上证明旧类核心logit贡献严格不变，总漂移由残差特征能量所界。
AI.result: 在冻结ViT-B/16、exemplar-free的10阶段类别增量协议下：SPARCL在CIFAR-100达94.52%、CUB-200达94.28%、ImageNet-R达83.85%、ImageNet-A达68.70%，全面超越ACIL/DS-AL/GACL/REAL等解析方法及RanPAC/Fly-CL等强表示匹配方法；遗忘率约4.5%，漂移仅0.18。消融实验验证谱分区、核心冻结、残差RP各有贡献，τ=0.95最优。效率介于F-OAL与Fly-CL之间，明显快于RanPAC。SPARCL与Fly-CL互补——前者保护分类器解中的核心模式，后者通过稀疏扩展解耦原型相关性。
AI.conclusion: 解析式持续学习的遗忘机制并非优化驱动的参数覆盖，而是由共享逆自相关算子的几何重构引起的谱干扰(特征值稀释)。通过核心/残差谱分区冻结旧类在高能量方向的系数，可以严格保证旧类核心logit的不变性，并在不依赖样本回放的前提下显著缩小经典解析方法与强表示匹配方法之间的精度差距。谱分区与特征去相关是两条正交的可组合路线，未来可结合两者的优势。

title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) enables long-context processing via continuous weight updates during inference, but current methods struggle to balance the expressivity of per-token update dynamics with the hardware efficiency of chunk-wise approximations. We propose E$^2$-TTT (Expressive and Efficient TTT) to bridge this gap. Under the standard approximation of taking gradients at the chunk-start weights, we derive a closed-form state transition that exactly reproduces the chunk-end fast-weight and momentum states of the per-token recurrence. This enables fully parallelized chunk-level training while preserving the temporal structure of the update rule that prior chunk-wise methods discard. We validate E$^2$-TTT by training models up to 1.3B parameters from scratch. It performs on par with previous TTT and hybrid attention baselines in language modeling while outperforming them on in-context retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced in length extrapolation: on the standard ``Needle in a Haystack'' passkey test, it retains over 90% accuracy at $8\times$ the training context length. Meanwhile, E$^2$-TTT can match the training throughput of efficient chunk-wise methods, demonstrating that it effectively reconciles expressivity with efficiency. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 E²-TTT，一种用于测试时训练（Test-Time Training, TTT）的新型方法，旨在解决现有 TTT 方法中逐token更新的高表达力与分块并行的高硬件效率之间的矛盾。通过推导一个闭式标量核，E²-TTT 能在保持chunk-end fast-weight和momentum状态精确等于逐token递推的同时实现完全并行化的分块训练，并在语言建模、上下文检索和长度外推（尤其是在训练上下文8倍长度的大海捞针测试中保持>90%准确率）方面优于现有TTT和混合注意力基线，同时匹配其训练吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时训练（TTT）方法面临表达力与效率的权衡困境：逐token更新具有强大的优化保真度但因顺序递归导致硬件利用率低（<5% FLOPs效率），而分块更新（如LaCT）虽提高了效率，但通过简化更新规则（如平均动量因子）牺牲了token间的时间结构，掩盖了chunk内token重要性的时变差异。论文旨在弥合这一差距，实现“兼具表达力与效率”的TTT。
AI.method: 核心方法是在标准的“chunk-start权重处取梯度”近似下，推导出将逐token动量+衰减递推精确映射到分块端状态的闭式公式（Proposition 3.1）。具体而言，通过展开递推并利用对数空间的标量后缀积（suffix products）和比率和 $R_t$，将整个chunk的时间动态压缩为两个不同的标量核 $\mathcal{K}^W_t = \eta_t \tilde{\beta}_t R_t$ 和 $\mathcal{K}^M_t = \eta_t \tilde{\beta}_t$，分别对逐token梯度进行加权聚合。该方法只需一次反向传播（复用每token的激活梯度进行两次标量加权聚合），保持了LaCT的 $O(C \cdot d^2)$ 渐近时间复杂度。架构上，采用与滑动窗口注意力（SWA）并行的混合设计，输入依赖的 $\eta_t, \beta_t, \alpha_t$ 通过轻量级线性头预测，并使用数据依赖的门控进行融合。
AI.result: 在15B tokens上从头训练340M和1.3B参数的模型。在通用语言建模（Wikitext/LAMBADA perplexity及6个常识推理基准）上E²-TTT达到最低困惑度；在上下文检索（FDA, SWDE, SQuAD）上1.3B SwiGLU变体达到43.6%平均准确率，显著优于LaCT（36.7%）和HQLT（35.5%）；在长度外推上表现尤为突出，在"Needle in a Haystack"测试中于8倍训练上下文长度处仍保持>90%准确率，而LaCT基线在4K后崩溃。吞吐量方面，E²-TTT仅比LaCT多付出3.3-15.6%的开销，且在多模态视频理解任务上参数高效适配可匹配全微调性能。
AI.conclusion: E²-TTT成功调和了TTT中分块处理的硬件效率与逐token更新的表达力。通过闭式标量核实现了完全并行的精确逐token动态，保持了与chunk-wise方法相同的训练吞吐量，同时在检索和长度外推方面显著优于现有TTT和混合注意力基线，证实了保留精确时间动态对长上下文泛化的重要性，为可扩展的测试时训练提供了有前景的方向。

title: Time-Aware Tranformer-Based Prediction Model for AECOPD
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Published in MEDINFO 2025
summary: The rapid symptom change of Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) makes it critical to have time-sensitive prediction models. However, most current machine learning models studying AECOPD use clinical and laboratory data, which will inevitably cause latency. To ensure timely detection of AECOPD and minimize latency, this paper focuses on home monitoring scenarios where only respiratory data from daily-use ventilators is available. We introduce a Time-Aware transformer-based AECOPD prediction model, which generates meaningful patient representations using the Time-Aware transformer to capture the symptoms and their temporal progression in ventilator data. Our experimental results demonstrate that our Time-Aware transformer-based approach outperforms traditional methods in multiple classification tasks, highlighting its potential to enhance AECOPD prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Time-Aware Transformer的AECOPD预测模型，仅使用家用呼吸机的呼吸数据进行预测，以减少临床和实验室数据带来的延迟。
AI.motivation: AECOPD症状变化迅速，需要时间敏感性的预测模型。但现有机器学习方法多依赖临床和实验室数据，存在延迟问题。为实现及时检测，需要一种仅依赖呼吸机数据的快速预测方法。
AI.method: 提出Time-Aware Transformer-based AECOPD预测模型，利用Time-Aware Transformer从呼吸机日常数据中生成有意义的患者表示，捕捉症状及其时间进展。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，基于Time-Aware Transformer的方法在多个分类任务中优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有潜力提高AECOPD预测准确性，在家庭监护场景中具有应用价值。

title: Across-Design Uncertainty in Short Pricing Panels: Evidence from Simulated Price Trajectories
summary: Short observational pricing panels can contain many observations while offering only a small number of distinct price movements. This paper studies the inferential consequences of that distinction in a synthetic data-generating process calibrated to a sparse pricing regime. We separate uncertainty conditional on a realised price trajectory from variation in estimation error across alternative trajectories generated by the same pricing process. In the baseline simulations, the latter component accounts for 97.6% of the variance of estimation error for the gradient-boosted specification. Within-panel resampling procedures use the information of one realised trajectory and do not identify this across-design component. Three results organise the analysis. First, across-design dispersion is well described by the empirical relation sigma_hat approx 0.182 V^(-0.271), where V equals moves times magnitude squared. Second, adding regions sharing a common price path reduces outcome noise but does not create independent price trajectories; conversely, averaging across units with independent design-specific errors reduces dispersion at the standard square root rate. Third, a Paule-Mandel variance component estimated across independently priced units substantially increases empirical coverage in homogeneous simulations, from 0.469 to 0.931. The broader implication is a shift toward designing data-generating processes that create independent identifying variation rather than relying solely on fixed passive panels.

AI.tldr: 本文在合成DGP框架下,区分了短定价面板中"设计内"(within-design)与"设计间"(between-design)两类估计误差,发现在基线模拟中后者解释了绝大部分误差方差(梯度提升设定下占97.6%),并证明任何仅基于单一已实现价格轨迹的常规推断方法(自助法、聚类稳健标准误等)均无法非参数地识别此成分;进而提出Paule-Mandel方差分量构造以提升覆盖率,并从理论上说明独立价格路径按√k速率聚合才能降低设计间离散度,核心政策含义为应转向创造独立识别变异的数据设计。
AI.motivation: 短期观测性定价面板常包含大量观测行,但独立的价格变动轨迹却很少。制造商可能在许多区域-周单元格中仅观察到少量共同列表价格的变化。传统的标准误和置信区间仅基于一次已实现的价格轨迹,无法刻画"如果价格轨迹本身是定价过程的一次抽样,估计量会如何偏移"这种设计间不确定性,从而系统性低估真实误差。作者在合成DGP中分离这两种不确定性,以量化其相对大小并检验常规面板内推断程序的充分性。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个合成DGP(120周、六区域、十次列表价格变动、变动幅度3.0%–7.5%,参数校准参考Nakamura-Steinsson的实证矩),严格区分"设计"(design,除需求冲击外的所有非随机成分)与"冲击"(shock,需求扰动u)。基线模拟抽取12个设计、每个设计40次冲击重复,共480个面板,在DML框架下使用交叉拟合残差-残差回归(5折时间块、中位数聚合),并比较两种学习器:梯度提升回归树(gbr,深度3、200棵树、学习率0.05)与岭回归筛(sieve,显式基+三次年度谐波对)。将估计误差分解为设计内方差σ²_w(固定设计下冲击重抽的离散度)与设计间中心化方差σ²_b(不同设计下条件均值误差b(D)的方差)。在288个网格点(变动次数、幅度、混淆度、传导率)上扫描以拟合经验规律σ̂_b≈0.182V^(-0.271),其中V=n_moves×magnitude²。比较八种面板内区间构造(移动块自助、层次自助、解析i.i.d.、周聚类稳健、周×区域多维聚类、Newey-West、wild cluster bootstrap-t等),并引入Paule-Mandel方差分量估计τ̂²,以构造跨独立设计单元的方差增广区间。最后在8单元、24单元组合的同质/异质场景下评估聚合效果与方差分量区间。
AI.result: 基线模拟:设计间方差占估计误差总方差的97.6%(gbr)与99.3%(sieve);gbr的σ_w=0.0756、σ_b=0.4815、偏差0.150,块自助标准误0.1595(大于σ_w但远小于σ_b)。八个面板内区间构造均未达到名义0.95覆盖率(gbr最高多维聚类0.730,sieve多维聚类0.660),且较高覆盖率伴随较宽区间,无构造同时满足W≤0.6的操作精度阈值。设计间离散度满足σ̂_b≈0.182V^(-0.271),R²=0.86,但作者明确将其作为仿真经验规律而非理论标度律。在同质场景(8个单元共享同一真实θ,各自独立生成价格路径)中,σ_b随聚合单元数k近似按√k缩减(实测缩减因子2.07、2.99对应k=4、8,预测2.00、2.83);Paule-Mandel方差增广区间(后验中心化构造)将经验覆盖率从自助百分位区间的0.469提升至0.931,但宽度从0.549增至1.480(2.70倍)。在异质场景中覆盖率0.943,但τ̂²混合了真实异质性与设计离散度。在24单元组合的6类×2品牌×2单元层级分析中,sieve在类别层级的最窄宽度为0.861,仍为操作阈值0.6的1.43倍;无任何组合同时满足覆盖率和精度阈值。
AI.conclusion: 短定价面板的标准推断实践存在系统性缺陷:面板内的自助法与聚类稳健标准误仅刻画设计内冲击不确定性,无法识别设计间中心化离散度(后者在稀疏定价机制下主导估计误差方差)。核心教训是"增加观测行"与"增加识别"在概念上不同——若新增区域共享同一价格路径,则只能改善结果端噪声而无法创造新的独立价格轨迹;只有具有近似独立设计特定误差的独立价格路径才能按√k速率降低设计间离散度。从推断修补转向数据设计:作者推荐通过受控的区域随机定价或利用准实验来源创造可信独立的识别变异。本文所有量化结论严格限于合成DGP(并已通过独立第二个生成器进行恢复检验),作者明确反对将97.6%、-0.271等数值外推为通用常数或标度律。

title: Asymmetric Capacity Allocation in Self-Refinement Pipelines
summary: Self-refinement, typically structured as generation, critique, and revision, is a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLM generation and serves as a core mechanism in many LLM agents. While the three stages involve different cognitive demands, most existing approaches conveniently treat the model size as an implementation detail rather than a subject of study, which may lead to a waste of resources. Little work has systematically examined how model size affects each stage or whether effective self-refinement requires equally capable models for generation, critique, and revision. We present the first stage-wise model size study of the self-refinement pipeline on 5 benchmarks from different domains using 6 model sizes of Qwen3 and 4 model sizes of Gemma 3. We conclude that larger generators and refiners generally improve the pipeline, whereas an undersized refiner can even harm performance. Second, performance is highly insensitive to the size of the critic, although including even a small critic consistently outperforms omitting critique altogether. Our findings demonstrate that model capacity should not be allocated uniformly across self-refinement pipelines. Instead, different stages exhibit distinct size scaling characteristics, providing practical guidance for designing more computationally efficient multi-stage language model systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对自优化流水线（生成-批评-修正）中三个阶段的模型容量分配进行了首次系统性研究。通过在5个基准上独立变化生成器、批评器和修正器的模型规模，发现生成器和修正器对性能影响显著，而批评器规模对性能影响较小；弱修正器甚至会损害初始生成质量。建议非均匀分配模型容量以提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的自优化流水线（self-refinement pipeline）通常将生成、批评、修正三个阶段的模型大小视为实现细节而统一处理，可能导致计算资源浪费。由于三个阶段具有不同的认知需求（与经典认知模型中生产、评估、修订的区分相一致），需要系统研究模型容量应如何在各阶段间分配。
AI.method: 提出阶段式模型大小分析协议：在5个领域基准（会议规划、摘要、逻辑推理、代码优化、故事生成）上，使用Qwen3（6个规模）和Gemma 3（4个规模）两个模型族，独立变化其中一个阶段的模型大小而固定其他两个阶段。还引入无批评基线（P(G,∅,R)）来分离批评本身的增益。使用范围（Δ）和标准差（σ）量化各阶段对模型大小的敏感性，并对批评质量进行人工评分。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 生成器与修正器对流水线性能高度敏感，扩展其规模带来显著提升；(2) 批评器规模对性能影响极小（标准差低于3.1个百分点）；(3) 弱修正器（12/30个配置）反而使性能低于初始生成，主要原因是修改了正确内容或跟随了错误批评；(4) 即便是最小的批评器（0.6B）也一致优于无批评基线，表明增益来源于批评本身而非额外推理开销。结论在Qwen3-32B/14B/8B及Gemma 3-27B配置下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 自优化流水线中三个阶段具有不同的规模缩放特性，不应均匀分配模型容量。应将大模型分配给生成器和修正器，批评器可使用轻量模型。这一发现为设计计算效率更高的多阶段LLM系统和智能体系统提供了实用指导。

title: Exploratory As-Analyzed No-Detection of Culturally-Marked Predicate-Triggered PII Amplification in a Synthetic-English RAG Probe: A Predicate-Resource-Confounded Audit
summary: We ask whether stereotype-loaded queries about culturally marked people leak more personal information from a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system than otherwise-equivalent neutral queries. We pre-register a four-culture audit (en-Anglo, es-LATAM, Arabic, Hindi) on a synthetic English PII corpus, comparing five query arms we call the Stereotype-Trigger Leakage Delta (STLD). Two caveats up front. Our locked confirmatory estimator was never run, so every test in the paper is exploratory or sensitivity, with all plan deviations listed in the appendix. And the name-leakage metric is contaminated by a prompt-echo artifact: the model often just re-emits the name we asked about, which inflates apparent leakage without any retrieval at all. On the cleaner channels (email, phone, ssn-like, address), we find no stereotype-driven amplification on any of the four cultures after multiple-comparison correction. Because our sample is only powered for mid-sized effects, and because the culturally marked probes mix stereotype content with cultural markers and heritage practices, we present this as no detection, not evidence of no effect, of culturally marked predicate leakage that is confounded with the underlying resource.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了文化刻板印象查询是否会从RAG系统中泄露更多个人身份信息（PII）。研究在合成英文PII语料上对四种文化（en-Anglo、es-LATAM、Arabic、Hindi）进行预注册的审计，比较五个查询臂（STLD）。由于确认性估计器未被执行，所有测试均为探索性。在清除姓名通道混淆后，未在任何文化上发现刻板印象驱动的PII泄露放大效应。es-LATAM细胞中观察到的-10pp效应被归因于谓词资源混杂（小池控制臂采样偏差），而非文化层面的影响。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中的隐私风险评估中，文化刻板印象是否构成PII泄露的额外攻击向量？现有研究表明检索文档会放大偏见输出，但尚未探索刻板印象是否会通过查询框架（而非输出意见）放大隐私泄露。这对于设计防御性输入端护栏具有实际意义。
AI.method: 预注册的五臂配对设计：(Q₀)裸查询、(Q_R)随机填充、(Q_N)中性、(Q_C)文化中性控制、(Q_S)刻板印象处理。STLD = L(Q_S) - L(Q_C)。技术栈：BGE-M3检索（k=5）+ Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct生成+正则护栏。统计方法：配对McNemar精确检验，4重Bonferroni校正（α=0.0125）。样本量：N=100/文化。进行了8项计划偏差（D1-D8），最关键的是锁定的事后Llama-Guard-3+摘要端到端估计器未被执行，转而使用预守卫正则/直接重述作为探索性替代。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 预注册的姓名包含指标因提示回声混淆而失效——17/20的"姓名泄露"响应只是重复了查询中已有的姓名；(2) 在更清晰的非姓名指标（电子邮件/电话/SSN/地址，n=80/文化）下，Bonferroni校正后所有四种文化均无显著效应；(3) 预注册姓名指标下es-LATAM显示-10pp（p=0.006）但方向与H₁相反，归因于控制臂L(Q_C)=80%的异常高位；(4) D8敏感性测试将控制池从3扩展到7个谓词，证实Q_C v1为小池采样偏差（p=0.013）；(5) 32B跨模型探测保留了es-LATAM信号符号但幅度压缩（-3pp, p=0.25）；(6) 在N=100下MDE约为±11-13pp，因此结论为"未检测到"而非"无效应"。
AI.conclusion: 在锁定的事前/事中守卫估计器下，四种文化上均不支持H₁: STLD>0的正向假设。es-LATAM细胞的-10pp效应是控制驱动的对比——Q_C的控制池不稳定是更合理的解释，而非Q_S的处理效应。由于es-LATAM谓词库混合了刻板印象内容、文化标记和传统实践，应将该发现理解为"谓词资源混杂的文化标记谓词泄露"而非纯粹的刻板印象内容效应。本文严格区分了"未检测到"与"无效应"，并诚实地报告了8项计划偏差和2项关键混淆（Q_C不稳定性和姓名提示回声），这为RAG隐私审计方法论提供了有价值的诊断教训。

title: TriPLU: Bypassing the Gate with Direct Trilinear Product FFNs in Tiny Language Models
summary: We study whether tiny decoder-only language models benefit from feed-forward layers that directly multiply learned feature projections. TriPLU, a Trilinear Product Linear Unit, replaces the usual gated FFN branch with a product-only degree-3 branch that multiplies three projected streams coordinatewise. In a character-level TinyStories 1M-byte prefix study, TriPLU reaches a mean best validation loss of 1.0637, compared with 1.1017 for closely matched SwiGLU, 1.0780 for a degree-4 product control, and 1.1026 for a degree-2 control. In train-only Byte-BPE experiments, TriPLU also lowers validation and heldout bits per byte on TinyStories and WikiText-2 raw under low-learning-rate settings, with PMI-slice evidence suggesting gains on seen middle- and high-PMI adjacent-token pairs. Constant-learning-rate diagnostics show that product-branch normalization can reduce the high-learning-rate best-checkpoint gap, although final BPB still degrades under hot schedules. The resulting claim is deliberately narrow: direct product FFNs can improve fixed-budget small-model loss in specific low-compute regimes, but the branch is optimization-sensitive and does not establish FLOP-normalized efficiency, scaling behavior, or broad LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TriPLU（Trilinear Product Linear Unit），一种用三个学习投影的逐元素乘积直接替代传统门控激活的 FFN 设计。在极小型 decoder-only 语言模型（2 层 ~28 万参数 TinyStories 前缀训练、8 层 ~700 万参数 Byte-BPE 实验）中，TriPLU 在多个低学习率设定下取得略低于匹配 SwiGLU 的验证损失和 BPB，并通过 PMI 分箱分析显示增益与已见相邻 token 共现模式相关；但该 FFN 分支对优化设置（学习率、归一化、缩放因子）高度敏感，作者明确指出结论仅适用于特定低算力场景，未建立 FLOP 归一化效率或可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现代 Transformer FFN 中乘性结构（如 SwiGLU 门控）已被证实有益，但这些是"门控式"乘法（一元激活作用于一条流，再乘以另一条流）。作者想探究更直接的乘积偏置——即不经过一元非线性、直接相乘若干学习投影——是否能给极小型语言模型带来额外收益，因为小模型可能缺乏足够的宽度/深度/数据来通过组合隐式学习乘性交互。
AI.method: 核心方法：把 FFN 的隐藏激活替换为对输入 x 的若干线性投影的逐元素乘积。TriPLU 使用 degree-3 分支 p₃(x)=W_u x ⊙ W_v x ⊙ W_w x，再乘以一个固定标量分支增益 α（公开数据重跑用 α=5.0），最后通过输出投影 W_o。文中还构造了 degree-2 对照（double_prod）、degree-4 对照（quad_prod）、以及带 SiLU 门的乘积变体（triple_swiglu、double_silu_triple）。实验设定包括：字符级 TinyStories 1M 字节前缀训练（2 层 2 头 96 维，~28 万参数，SwiGLU 宽度 322，TriPLU 分支宽 242，seeds 1-3，5k 步）以及 Byte-BPE 中性化实验（8 层 4 头 256 维，~710 万参数，50M 字节 TinyStories + 20M 字节 WikiText-2 原始转移，低 LR=1e-5，seeds 1-3）。评估指标：验证交叉熵/BPB、heldout BPB、按相邻 token PMI 分箱的损失切片，以及固定学习率扫描（1e-5 到 1e-3）。
AI.result: 1) 主结果（字符级 TinyStories 1M）：TriPLU 验证损失 1.0637（SD 0.0031），分别优于 SwiGLU 1.1017（-0.0380，约 3.4% 相对降幅）、quad_prod 1.0780、double_prod 1.1026；三种子全部胜出，差距 0.0322/0.0259/0.0558；TriPLU 是唯一在三种子上都达到 1.08 目标的变体。2) 字节级 L8 压力测试（100M 字节，LR=1e-5）：TriPLU BPB 1.3743 vs SwiGLU 1.3931。3) Byte-BPE heldout（50M+20M，低 LR）：TinyStories 验证 BPB 差距 +0.01446、heldout +0.00999；WikiText-2 验证 +0.01218、heldout +0.01224（均有利 TriPLU）。4) PMI 分箱：TriPLU 在中高 PMI 已见相邻对上损失更低，但未见对上反而更差（出现负差距）。5) 学习率扫描：未归一化 learned-α TriPLU 在 1e-5 最佳，但在 ≥1e-4 上劣于 SwiGLU；RMS 归一化+固定 α=0.1 在 1e-3 达到最佳 1.2265。6) 深度消融（1-8 层）：每层 TriPLU 均优于 SwiGLU，但差距非单调（5 层时仅 0.0042）。7) 门控乘积消融：triple_swiglu α=5 达到 1.0640，与 TriPLU 几乎持平。8) 算术诊断：quad_prod 最佳，但作者视为机制证据而非主张依据。吞吐量 TriPLU 略低于 SwiGLU（331.8k vs 343.9k token positions/s）。
AI.conclusion: 作者明确将结论限定在"特定低算力、token-budget 固定的极小模型"：直接乘积 FFN 在 TinyStories 字符级和 Byte-BPE 低学习率设置下相对匹配 SwiGLU 有小幅且一致的验证/holdout 损失改进，且改进集中于已观察到的中高 PMI 相邻 token 共现对上。TriPLU 并非在所有乘性变体下都胜出（degree-2 弱于 SwiGLU、degree-4 居中）、未证明算术外推能力、未建立 FLOP 归一化效率、未展示可扩展性。关键局限是分支对优化设置敏感（学习率、归一化、缩放因子 α 显著影响结果），热学习率下未归一化变体最终 BPB 仍退化；RMS 归一化是潜在的稳定化方向，但仍是 50M 字节的诊断性结果。论文作为小型架构与基准研究，将乘积单元网络、乘性交互视角、神经算术模块与 Transformer FFN 设计联系起来。

title: Multilingual Verifier Bias in RLVR: Benchmark, Rollout Diagnosis, and the Cross-Lingual Selection Bottleneck
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a standard recipe for training large language models on mathematical reasoning, where an answer verifier serves as a language-neutral reward function. We show that this assumption fails in multilingual settings: an exact-match verifier turns format and script variation into language-dependent false-negative reward noise. We introduce a reusable protocol for auditing multilingual RLVR rewards: a verifier-robustness suite, a rollout-diagnosis procedure, and language-conditioned reward-error metrics for Japanese, English, and Chinese answers. On MGSM rollouts with k=8, the exact-match proxy rejects trusted-correct answers at sharply different rates by language across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; for Qwen3-8B, the false-negative rate reaches 0.642 on JP against 0.122 on EN and 0.073 on CN. A plain-numeric probe localizes the mechanism to the final-answer interface: an interface model drives reward-error VLB to zero while the residual accuracy gap is unchanged. We then expose a cross-lingual selection bottleneck: on MGSM250 rollouts, a target-local aggregation rule using no trusted labels closes 55-78% of the average selection gap, and over 95% of repairs require genuine cross-lingual support. The bottleneck replicates on a 483-problem MATH-500 set. A controlled training audit shows that rule-GRPO raises trusted accuracy while the reward-error VLB stays high. The unifying message is operational: multilingual RLVR rewards should be audited by language and by answer interface before they are optimized.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了多语言RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）中精确匹配验证器存在语言条件性偏差：验证器将格式与脚本变化转化为语言依赖的假阴性奖励噪声。作者提出了一套可复用的多语言RLVR奖励审计协议，包括验证器鲁棒性套件、Rollout诊断程序和语言条件性奖励误差指标，并通过MGSM和MATH-500实验证明存在跨语言选择瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 在多语言数学推理场景中，RLVR假设精确匹配验证器是语言中性的奖励函数，但这一假设在多语言环境下失效：不同的格式和脚本变化（如全角数字、CJK量级单位、Markdown定界符、尖括号包裹等）使得同一数值答案在精确匹配下被拒绝，且拒绝率因语言而异，从而在策略梯度中引入语言依赖的系统性负信号，抑制弱语言下的正确推理。
AI.method: 提出基于元组(π, {x_l}, k, v, r*)的通用审计协议，包含：(1) 验证器鲁棒性套件——基于MGSM JP/EN/CN构建的受控脆弱性基线，测试三种规则验证器族（精确匹配、规范化数值、混合）；(2) Rollout诊断——在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的k=8实时采样上对比代理验证器与可信规范化奖励，定义每语言假阴性率(FNR)、假阳性率(FPR)、奖励误差率(Err)及验证器语言偏差VLB(m)=max_l m(l)-min_l m(l)；(3) 纯数值接口探针——在无泄漏的20题MGSM保留集上，通过纯数值提示控制最终答案接口，分解格式效应与能力效应；(4) 目标局部跨语言聚合——一种无标签的推理时选择程序，仅在目标语言出现的候选簇中选取，借助同问题的其他语言兄弟簇支持来恢复选择正确性；(5) 受控rule-GRPO训练审计。
AI.result: 在MGSM k=8 Rollout上，精确匹配奖励噪声完全由假阴性主导（FPR≈0），且呈强烈语言条件性：Qwen3-8B在JP的假阴性率达0.642（EN为0.122，CN为0.073），FNR的VLB达0.569；最差语言由模型分布而非基准决定。纯数值接口探针显示接口SFT模型可将精确匹配的VLB(Err)和VLB(FNR)均降至0.000，同时残差语言准确率差距保持不变，证明精确匹配成分为格式伪影。跨语言聚合在MGSM250新鲜集上关闭Qwen3-8B和Llama平均选择差距的55.3%和78.2%、JP差距的63.2%和88.4%；尸检确认>95%的修复需要真实的跨语言支持（借用计数为0）。在人工审计的483题MATH-500集上得到复现。受控训练审计显示rule-GRPO将可信准确率从0.647提升至0.735，但精确匹配VLB(Err)从0.417恶化至0.500，能力提升与偏差消除正交。
AI.conclusion: 多语言RLVR奖励应在优化前按语言和答案接口进行审计。语言条件性奖励差距可分解为三部分：可移除的格式伪影（接口层解决）、可恢复的选择失败（跨语言聚合解决）、以及残差的生成能力差距。精确匹配验证器可能在静默中将学习信号归零（组奖励方差为零），而优化代理奖励可在不减少语言偏差的情况下提升能力。整体贡献是将"多语言验证器是否公平"转化为具有固定输出格式的可复用测量协议。

title: TH-GNN: Heterogeneous Temporal Graph Neural Networks for LLM-Agent Shilling Attack Detection
summary: LLM agents can now generate realistic shilling profiles, fluent reviews, and coherent ratings at scale, systematically defeating recommender-system defenses. Text-only detectors that flag semantic drift in review embeddings are blind to graph structure and temporal coordination, while graph-only detectors that exploit neighborhood anomalies cannot reason over review semantics or the cross-modal inconsistencies produced by LLM-generated content. We propose TH-GNN, a heterogeneous temporal graph neural network with a two-layer Heterogeneous Graph Transformer backbone that applies per-type and per-relation attention augmented with learnable sinusoidal temporal encodings on every edge. Cross-modal attention fuses structural user embeddings with frozen RoBERTa representations of reviews and item descriptions, while a GRU operating over log inter-arrival times captures temporal burstiness. Evaluated across five attack families and four benchmark datasets, TH-GNN achieves a grand-mean F1 score of 0.870, outperforming the strongest text-only baseline on Agent4SR attacks by 10.9 percentage points and 11.5 percentage points at the lowest injection rate. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly modeling temporal, structural, and semantic signals for detecting sophisticated LLM-driven shilling attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TH-GNN，一种异构时序图神经网络，通过联合建模异构图结构、跨模态文本（RoBERTa）和时序突发性信号，同时检测基于LLM智能体的虚假用户注入攻击。在四个数据集和五种攻击族上取得显著优于文本/图单模态基线的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统虚假用户（shilling attack）检测方法存在三类正交盲区：纯文本检测器（如SemanticShield）忽略图结构与时序协调；纯图检测器（如Anti-FakeU）无法捕捉LLM生成评论的跨模态不一致；二者均未建模边时间戳。Agent4SR等LLM智能体生成的虚假档案兼具语义流畅、结构合理、时序协同的特征，使单模态检测器全面失效，亟需一种融合结构-文本-时序三轴信号的多模态时序检测框架。
AI.method: TH-GNN构建user-review-item三类型异构时序图，采用2层HGT（异构图Transformer）作为结构主干，并对每条边注入可学习正弦时间编码至注意力logit以捕捉时间间隔；跨模态注意力以图嵌入为Query、冻结RoBERTa CLS向量均值池化后的评论/物品文本为Key-Value融合语义与结构信息；额外采用单层GRU编码用户log-inter-arrival时序序列作为突发性流；最终拼接后经两层MLP输出fake概率，并以focal loss（γ=2.0, α=0.25）缓解极端类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在ML-1M、Amazon-Books、Amazon-Clothing、Yelp2018四个数据集 × {Random, Bandwagon, AUSH, GraphAttack, Agent4SR}五种攻击 × {0.5%, 1%, 5%}三种注入率上（20配置），TH-GNN取得grand-mean F1=0.870，每一行均优于所有基线；对Agent4SR LLM智能体攻击平均F1=0.825，较SemanticShield（0.716）高10.9 pp，较统计基线高15.0 pp；最低注入率（0.5%）时优势扩大至11.5 pp；FAR全程<4.5%（基线6.8%–12.5%）；下游LightGCN在TH-GNN过滤后NDCG@10/HR@10平均rank=1.00；消融实验显示时序流贡献最大（-5.1 pp），异构图次之（GCN替代-4.2 pp），文本流对小-3.3 pp（但对Agent4SR至关重要）。
AI.conclusion: TH-GNN验证了异构图+多模态文本+时序突发性三轴联合建模对LLM驱动的shilling攻击检测的有效性，及时序信号在低注入率场景下尤为关键。主要局限包括：依赖逐事件时间戳；对未来更强的LLM生成模型需周期性再训练。未来工作将探索针对时序信号的对抗性攻击、在线增量检测以及跨域迁移。

title: MIL-BERT: Classification of Arbitrarily Large Text with Performance and Explanatory Guarantees
summary: Many text classification decisions are viable based on constituent excerpts alone. Taking inspiration from the field of multiple instance learning, we present an algorithm for training a neural network to classify text by selecting such excerpts. We show that our approach is also scalable with demonstrated learning against samples with nearly 1M tokens. We evaluate our methods on 7 datasets with emphasis on long-textual collections that far exceed the encoding limit of our base model. We present state-of-the-art results with this algorithm on 3 datasets: identification of political bias in news outlets, trigger warnings in long stories, and demographic characteristics of authors in tweet collections. Furthermore, the model trained on weakly-labeled collections of text (bags) generalizes to accurately classify constituent, smaller instances. Besides a new state-of-the-art for these problems, this approach is one of the few neural methods to excel in these datasets.

AI.tldr: MIL-BERT 提出了一种基于多示例学习（MIL）框架的算法，通过选择文本中的关键摘录而非处理整篇文档来对任意长度的文本进行分类。该方法利用"双遍池化技巧"（double-pass pooling trick）实现 O(k) 内存复杂度和 O(n+k) 计算复杂度，在3个数据集上达到 SOTA，并通过选择摘录提供可解释性保证。
AI.motivation: 传统 Transformer 模型（如 BERT、RoBERTa）因位置嵌入固定长度以及注意力机制的二次方复杂度，在处理长文档时面临内存和计算瓶颈。现有方案（如截断或 Longformer）要么丢失信息，要么开销巨大。作者观察到许多文本分类任务具有"信号局部性"（signal locality）特征——分类决策可基于文档中少量关键摘录做出，因此借鉴多示例学习（MIL）思想，提出只需识别关键摘录即可完成分类的方法。
AI.method:
1. **MIL 形式化**：将长文档视为由多个 excerpt（摘录）组成的"包"（bag），只需识别最相关的少数 excerpt 即可做出分类决策。
2. **双遍池化技巧（Double-pass Pooling Trick）**：
   - 第一遍（无梯度）：使用 selector（基于仿射变换的线性层）通过 argmax 选择每个维度上最极端的 k 个 excerpt，仅存储所选 excerpt 的索引，节省内存。
   - 第二遍（带梯度）：对第一遍选中的 excerpt 运行模型，通过 Gumbel-softmax 实现可微的离散选择，并送入分类器。
   - 计算复杂度 O(n+k)，内存复杂度 O(k)。
3. **两种 Selector 设计**：
   - **Shared Feature Map**：选择器与分类器共享参数，每个类别对应一个 excerpt，输出维度等于类别数。
   - **Feature Tree**：每个维度类似决策树节点，通过 1+2^(k-1) 个选择决策实现高阶模式匹配，减少内存消耗。
4. **基础模型**：使用 RoBERTa-large 编码 excerpt，每个 excerpt 取 <s> 标记的最终层嵌入。
5. **超参设置**：窗口大小 256 tokens，步长 64 tokens（默认），Gumbel-softmax 温度 τ=1，软采样衰减率 1/2 持续 48 epoch。
AI.result:
**SOTA 结果（3 个数据集）**：
- **政治偏见检测（CLEF 2023 Task 3B）**：Bag-level Macro-F1 = 0.87，MAE = 0.22；在 3A 文章级实例分类 Macro-F1 = 0.39（弱于直接用文章标签训练的 0.27 MAE）。
- **触发警告检测（PAN 2023）**：Bag-level Macro-F1 = 0.37，Micro-F1 = 0.75；Passage-level 平均准确率 0.709。
- **PAN 2019 性别预测**：Macro-F1 = 0.783；职业预测：0.549（均超越此前 SOTA）；出生年份与知名度未超越 SOTA。

**长文档基准结果**（5 次随机种子均值）：
- Hyperpartisan: 92.31%
- 20News: 85.25%
- EURLEX-57K: 69.21%
- Book Text: 58.16%

**效率**：在 PAN 2019 数据集（近 1M tokens）上训练单实例约 100 秒；内存使用显著低于 Longformer 和 DeBERTa，支持远超其编码上限的文本长度。

**可解释性**：通过 selector 分数的 UMAP 可视化、Layer Integrated Gradients 逐词归因（如识别"fossil fuel industry"对左翼偏见判断的贡献）验证了方法的可解释性。

**20News 消融研究**：shared classifier + 20 excerpts + 256 tokens 窗口达到最佳准确率 0.853±0.007。
AI.conclusion: MIL-BERT 通过将长文本分类问题转化为多示例学习问题，利用双遍池化技巧在保持 O(k) 内存复杂度的同时处理任意长度的文本。该方法在具有"信号局部性"的任务上取得 SOTA 或具有竞争力的结果，同时天然提供可解释性（所选 excerpt 即为决策依据）。其局限性在于：对不具信号局部性的任务（如年龄、知名度预测）效果有限；分类数增多会增加内存负担；计算时间随文档长度线性增长。未来工作包括改进 selector/分类器架构（如自回归选择）、拓展到检索和匹配任务，以及探索更多 MIL 场景。

title: Fine-tuning LLMs for Tourist Trajectory Prediction using Field Experiment Data
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI for Urban Planning (AI4UP) at AAAI-26, Singapore, January 2026
summary: Evaluating mobility interventions at tourist destinations requires predicting visitor behavior under varying conditions. Traditional methods struggle because tourist decisions depend heavily on context like weather and fatigue, yet models cannot generalize to unobserved scenarios. Large Language Models offer a solution by encoding commonsense knowledge about human behavior from pretraining, enabling reasoning about context-dependent decisions, while natural language representation flexibly integrates heterogeneous information. Fine-tuning on local trajectories adapts this general understanding to destination-specific patterns. We validate this approach using 566 trajectories from Wakayama Castle Park, Japan. Our fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B achieves 49.1% next POI accuracy and maintains strong performance on undersampled scenarios like rainy days, demonstrating effective generalization. This establishes LLMs as high-fidelity behavior models for context-dependent tourist prediction, providing groundwork for counterfactual analysis of mobility interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对旅游目的地游客行为预测中传统模型难以泛化到未观测场景的问题，提出对大语言模型（Llama-3.1-8B）进行微调以预测下一兴趣点（POI）的方法。基于日本和歌山城公园566条实地实验轨迹进行验证，模型POI预测准确率达49.1%，并在雨天等稀疏场景中表现出良好泛化能力，为移动干预措施的反事实分析奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 旅游目的地常面临游客分布不均问题，部署电动接驳车、共享单车等移动干预措施需要预测其对游客行为的实际影响，但传统方法（马尔可夫模型、深度学习）存在数据需求大、无法融入天气等上下文信息、缺乏常识推理能力等局限，难以泛化到未观测场景。需要一种能结合常识推理与目的地特定模式、灵活整合异构上下文信息的行为预测方法。
AI.method: 将游客轨迹预测建模为条件序列生成问题，使用Llama-3.1-8B模型，采用QLoRA（rank=32, α=64）微调策略，且适配器同时作用于注意力层（Q/K/V/O）和嵌入层（embed_tokens）、输出层（lm_head）。轨迹以结构化文本表示，包含人格标签（年龄、性别）、环境条件（天气、时间）及按时间顺序排列的POI访问记录（时间戳、动作、区域、类别、POI）。训练采用交叉熵损失，学习率2×10⁻⁵，batch size 8，训练10个epoch，按游客级别80/20划分训练/测试集。
AI.result: 在和歌山城公园566条轨迹上，微调后的Llama-3.1-8B取得49.1%的POI预测准确率和55.4%的类别准确率，显著优于所有基线（一阶马尔可夫9.0%、五阶马尔可夫15.3%、HMM 11.0%、零样本GPT-4o 18.7%、微调GPT-4o 35.2%、Llama-3-Swallow 39.8%）。在序列生成层面，4-gram重叠率31.2%，BLEU 25.8%，归一化Levenshtein距离47.0%，生成轨迹平均长度7.2个POI（真实数据7.7），异常输出仅5.4%。在12个雨天测试样本上，准确率保持41.7%（马尔可夫仅8.3%），午餐时段餐饮类别准确率达62.3%。Llama-3-Swallow表现不及通用Llama-3.1，表明多语言预训练的规模与多样性比语言专用化更有利于物理移动模式推理。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了微调LLM用于区域旅游目的地游客轨迹预测的可行性。模型成功利用预训练常识推理泛化到稀疏场景（如雨天）并生成连贯的多步轨迹，POI与类别准确率间6个百分点的差距表明具体选择存在固有不确定性。该工作为反事实模拟奠定了预测基础，但尚未验证因果主张，未来需通过修改输入条件（如新增接驳服务可用性）并结合A/B测试或随机实地试验数据进行验证。局限包括：18%缺失人格属性由GPT-4o推断、无法预测全新POI或推理重大基础设施变化，未来可引入RAG或少样本自适应等技术。

title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures
summary: Watermarking diffusion language models (DLMs) requires mechanisms compatible with iterative parallel unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding.
