Existing sampling-based watermarking methods typically inject position-wise i.i.d. perturbations, which can be poorly aligned with DLM decoding dynamics and degrade generation quality. We propose SAC-Copula, a quality-preserving watermarking method for DLMs based on smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields constructed via a Gaussian copula. We further develop a SAC-aware detector using covariance-aware filtering and native-sample calibration. Mechanism-level analysis shows that local correlation reduces latent perturbation roughness and better matches iterative refinement dynamics. Experiments on LLaDA show that SAC-Copula achieves a favorable quality-detectability trade-off compared with existing baselines. In particular, further evaluations on Dream-7B and additional datasets show that SAC-Copula substantially improves PPL tail stability over the i.i.d. Gumbel baseline, while maintaining strong low-FPR detectability and competitive overall generation quality. Additional token-edit stress tests further assess watermark robustness under controlled synchronization drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAC-Copula，一种针对扩散语言模型(DLM)的水印方法，通过高斯Copula构建平滑、局部相关的Gumbel扰动场，在保留单坐标Gumbel边际分布的同时引入受控低滞后相关性，从而更好地与DLM迭代并行去掩码动态相匹配，并设计了协方差感知的FFR检测器与粗粒度偏移恢复的GO-FFR检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于采样的DLM水印方法通常注入位置独立(i.i.d.)的扰动，与DLM迭代并行去掩码、跨步修订的解码动态不匹配，会导致生成质量退化(如局部粗糙性、语义不一致、流畅性下降和精炼振荡)。本文认为扰动场的联合结构本身是DLM水印设计的关键维度，平滑、局部相关的扰动场可能更适合迭代精炼解码。
AI.method: 1) SAC-Copula扰动场构建：从两个独立标准高斯白噪声tape出发，对其中一个进行方差归一化的高斯核卷积得到空间平滑流，再与白噪声流按ρ混合构造Z_final，最后通过高斯Copula变换(Φ+逆Gumbel CDF)映射为Gumbel扰动场，保留单坐标标准Gumbel边际分布，引入ρ²·r_τ的有限窗自相关。2) 注入机制：仅对当前被掩码的生成位置注入扰动(ℓ̃=ℓ+α·G_corr)，与去噪步骤无关，按位置和token索引复用。3) 检测器：基于SAC感知局部滤波H_ω(权重∝exp(-τ²/(4σ_K²)))、Native样本协方差估计、岭正则化的匹配方向(FFR)，以及全局偏移扫描的粗同步恢复(GO-FFR, max over offsets)。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct+ELI5主实验中，SAC-Copula(W=39, σ_K=15.0, ρ=0.6)达到AUC=0.990, TPR@1%FPR=0.980, TPR@5%FPR=0.985, Median PPL=8.260, PPL>100比例=1.0%, SBERT=0.798, MAUVE=0.999, Rep3=0.414, Distinct3=0.586, Quality=0.758。相对匹配i.i.d.基线(AUC=0.966, TPR@1%FPR=0.815)，最显著的改进在PPL上尾稳定性：P99从4256.63降至99.65，崩塌率从3.5%降至1.0%。ρ消融(六点扫描)表明ρ=0.6为平衡内部工作点：检测在中等相关处达峰(FFR AUC/TPR@1%从ρ=0的0.9683/0.820升至0.6的0.9900/0.980,ρ=1时回落到0.9631/0.830),PPL尾部持续改善但ρ=1时更广泛质量退化。跨模型迁移(Dream-7B/ELI5): SAC保持AUC=0.9986,TPR@1%=0.995,同时P99从5988.25降至240.68,复合崩塌率从24.5%降至4.0%。跨任务迁移(LLaDA/C4-en): AUC从0.826提升至0.9138,PPL>100从10.5%降至3.0%,中位PPL几乎不变(13.71→13.73)。校准控制: N=500时ROC最佳,严格1% FPR点获益最多;不同H_0源(Wikipedia/ELI5 human/C4)产生AUC 0.9861-0.9878;阈值冻结转移至C4 realnewslike在1%/5%名义FPR下实现0.95%/5.50%真实FFR。受控token编辑压力测试(20%): 删除下GO-FFR将TPR@1%从0.150提升至0.460,插入下从0.195提升至0.505,替换下SAC+FFR达0.890 vs i.i.d.+Old 0.755; 50%编辑下检测大幅退化。
AI.conclusion: SAC-Copula通过将扰动场设计从独立随机性转向结构化几何(高斯Copula诱导的局部相关性)，在DLM水印中实现了更优的质量-可检测性权衡，特别是显著改善了PPL上尾稳定性，同时保持强低FPR可检测性。机制级分析表明低滞后相关性将潜在局部差分能量从D_iid=2降至D_SAC=2(1-ρ²r₁)，为DLM迭代精炼动态提供了合理化解释。FFR/GO-FFR检测器与SAC证据几何匹配，GO-FFR对受控插入/删除提供粗同步恢复。局限性包括：检测依赖校准H_0样本、累积局部漂移未解决、语义改写超出当前鲁棒性范围、固定(W,σ_K)ρ扫描仅识别局部平衡工作点而非全局最优。

title: From a Static Multi-Level Small Semantic Codebook to a Dynamic Single-Level Large Semantic Codebook for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation represents each item with a sequence of discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and predicts the sequence to retrieve the next item. Typical systems use multi-level residual quantization, which increases autoregressive decoding cost and creates a large hierarchical space that may be sparsely occupied. Static codebooks also become misaligned with current traffic as new items arrive and exposure distributions change. We propose a single-level large semantic codebook that replaces multiple residual semantic codes with one semantic token while retaining a separate collaborative disambiguation token to reduce item collisions. We further introduce an exposure-aware dynamic update mechanism based on temporal weight decay, exponential moving-average center updates, and an exposure-weighted penalty on SID changes. We also develop an offline evaluation framework covering representation quality, code utilization, cluster load, full-SID collision, and temporal stability. On two public datasets, the two-level SID improves mean Recall@10 by 5.0%-8.8% and mean NDCG@10 by 4.1%-5.1% for OneRec-V1, and by 7.1%-8.7% and 3.8%-8.5%, respectively, for OneRec-V2. Dynamic updating provides further gains on KuaiRec. Across three serving architectures, the shorter SID reduces estimated autoregressive-decoding FLOPs by 47.93%-48.70% and increases single-card QPS by 28.57%-47.0%. A five-day online A/B test serving 2.5% of production traffic improves the primary consumption metric by 0.792%.

AI.tldr: 针对工业级生成式推荐系统，本文提出用单层大规模语义码本（语义码+协同消歧码）替代传统的多层残差语义量化码本，并引入基于曝光感知的动态更新机制。同时构建了一套无需重训下游推荐模型的码本级离线评估框架。方法在公开数据集和快手线上均取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 工业部署的三层SID中，第二层语义码存在严重的条件稀疏问题（平均仅使用2.48%的词表），却仍消耗额外的自回归解码步骤；同时静态码本难以适应不断涌入的新物品和变化的曝光分布，即"码本漂移"问题。
AI.method: 1) 单层大语义码本+独立消歧码：将多级残差语义量化压缩为一个大词表语义码，保留专用消歧码处理碰撞，将自回归步数从三步降至两步。2) 曝光感知动态更新：时间衰减曝光权重、EMA中心更新、曝光加权的SID切换惩罚（平衡适应性与稳定性）。3) 离线评估框架：覆盖重建质量、码利用率、聚类负载、SID碰撞、时间稳定性五个维度。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty和KuaiRec上，TwoRec-V1/V2的Recall@10提升5.0%-8.8%、NDCG@10提升4.1%-5.1%（V1）及Recall@10提升7.1%-8.7%、NDCG@10提升3.8%-8.5%（V2）。动态更新在KuaiRec上进一步提升Recall@10 1.4%-2.7%、NDCG@10 2.7%-7.0%。三种服务架构下自回归FLOPs降低47.93%-48.70%，单卡QPS提升28.57%-47.0%。五天线上A/B测试（2.5%流量）核心消费指标提升0.792%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过精简语义层级从"宽度-深度"权衡的角度提升生成式推荐是有效的，动态码本更新能够同时保持高曝光物品的稳定性与适应分布漂移；离线评估框架可在重训下游模型前高效筛选码本候选。

title: Truthful Calibration Measures for Sequential Prediction
summary: Calibration requires probabilistic reports to be conditionally unbiased and reliably interpretable as probabilities. A calibration measure assigns numerical error to miscalibrated reports. Haghtalab et al. (2024) proposed an approximately truthful calibration measure for online prediction, leaving open whether exact truthfulness is compatible with completeness and soundness. We resolve this question negatively for sequential binary prediction: exact truthfulness is incompatible with completeness and soundness, even for independent outcomes. We then show that this impossibility is specific to exact truthfulness. We give two general reductions from a base calibration measure, producing additively and multiplicatively approximately truthful calibration measures, respectively. Applying the multiplicative reduction, for every $0 < \varepsilon < 1$ we construct a sound and complete calibration measure that is $(1+\exp(-T^{(1-\varepsilon)/2}/2))$-multiplicatively truthful. This improves the approximate-truthfulness guarantee of Haghtalab et al. (2024).

AI.tldr: 本文研究序贯预测中校准度量的真实可报告性（truthfulness）。证明了精确真实可报告性与完备性（completeness）和可靠性（soundness）不相容，即使在独立结果下也是如此；但通过加法和乘法两种近似机制，可以构造同时满足完备性、可靠性以及近似真实可报告性的校准度量。
AI.motivation: 传统校准度量（如ECE）会被策略性误报所利用，从而不激励真实报告。Haghtalab等人（2024）提出了近似真实可报告的校准度量，但精确真实可报告性与完备性、可靠性的兼容性仍是未决问题。此外，序贯预测中校准度量设计是机器学习公平性与决策可靠性的重要基础。
AI.method: 采用混合参数法（hybrid argument）证明不可能定理：通过比较校准与失校准的乘积分布在有限样本下的分离性，将离线分离定位到某个具体时间步，使得该时间步上策略性预测者可获益。再使用Savage表示与剥离引理（peeling lemma）证明弱可靠性下的精确真实可报告不可能。正面结果给出基于基础校准度量的两类归约方法（加法型和乘法型），并以平滑校准误差（smooth calibration error, smCE）为基础度量，借助鞅浓度估计证明其均匀完备性。
AI.result: 1. 证明精确真实可报告性与完备性+可靠性不相容（即使独立结果）。2. 给出在线策略优势的下界：Adv_T^prod ≥ (1-q)^{T-1}/(qT) · Δ_T(q)，在完备可靠度量下呈指数级缩小。3. 提出加法和乘法近似真实可报告的归约方法，构造出 (1+exp(-T^{(1-ε)/2}/2))-乘法近似真实可报告的度量，改进了Haghtalab等人(2024)的结论。
AI.conclusion: 在序贯二元预测中，精确真实可报告性与完备性、可靠性根本不相容，这是离线分离与在线可观察性之间结构冲突的结果。然而，只需放松为近似真实可报告性，即可构造同时满足统计保证与博弈论激励兼容的校准度量，对决策导向的概率预测系统的设计具有重要理论与实践意义。

title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs
summary: Strategic depth of reasoning is essential for human interaction of Large Language Models (LLMs) operating in boundedly rational environments. However, existing evaluations are primarily based on canonical games prevalent in pretraining corpora, making it difficult to disentangle true strategic reasoning from memorisation. To address this, we formalise a necessary level-K distinguishability condition for strategic depth inference and construct a suite of novel game structures that meet this standard. Using these games, we evaluate strategic depth in LLMs from both the Chain-of-Thought tokens and actual actions under recursive reasoning and an inductive trace of opponent game-play data. Across experimental trials spanning four LLMs, four game structures, and ten levels of iterated reasoning, we find that model models maintain accurate strategic depth under recursive reasoning, with strong internal consistency between stated reasoning and actions at every level. Errors arise from using the wrong number of iterated depth of reasoning steps, not from computing best responses incorrectly. However, inductive inference from opponent play degrades accuracy sharply and unevenly across games, and explicit strategic mentalizing in the chain of thought substantially improves overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在博弈环境中战略推理深度评估的现有方法依赖于预训练语料中常见的经典博弈，难以区分真正的战略推理与记忆的问题，提出level-k可区分性条件，并构建满足该条件的新博弈结构来评估四个LLM在递归与归纳条件下的策略深度表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM战略推理深度评估大多基于经典博弈（如协调博弈、信号博弈、猜数博弈等），这些博弈在预训练语料中广泛存在，导致难以区分LLM表现出的"战略能力"究竟来自真实的迭代推理，还是对已知博弈解的记忆。此外，许多博弈结构在不同的迭代推理深度上对应相同的可观测行为，违反了从行为推断潜在深度的可识别性要求。这些问题严重威胁了LLM战略深度评估的效度。
AI.method: 1. 形式化level-K可区分性条件：要求博弈的迭代深度响应序列（IDR序列）在深度0到K_max之间是单射的，即不同迭代深度对应不同的可观测动作。2. 构建Ring 11-20博弈（五人环形博弈），通过将11-20游戏改编为环形结构使其具有周期为10、非单调的IDR序列。3. 改造三种经典两玩家博弈（11-20游戏、全支付拍卖、Nash需求博弈），通过仿射变换使其在测试范围内的IDR序列满足可区分性。4. 设计递归条件（语言描述对手层级）和归纳条件（提供对手30个历史动作样本，通过量化响应生成）。5. 使用四个LLM（Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.6 27B、Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek v4 Pro）在四种博弈、十层迭代深度下进行实验；从CoT和实际动作两个维度提取语言深度信号K_L和行为深度信号K_B，评估三者之间的一致性。
AI.result: 1. 递归条件下，模型整体保持较高的战略深度准确性，Sonnet 4.6在深度4以上倾向于低一层，Gemma 4在深度9-10表现出能力下降；K_L与K_B高度耦合，表明内部一致性很强。2. 错误来源于对所需IDR序列迭代次数的判断错误，而非最佳响应的计算错误（Sonnet 4.6案例验证）。3. 归纳条件下性能急剧且不均匀地下降：11-20游戏保持较高准确率（80-90%），Ring 11-20降至55-66%，全支付拍卖降至10-18%，Nash需求博弈降至3%以下。4. CoT中显式战略心智化的比例与模型归纳条件下的表现正相关，有显式心智化的试次准确率明显更高。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过形式化level-K可区分性条件并设计满足该条件的新型博弈结构，有效解决了现有LLM战略深度评估中真实推理与记忆混淆的可识别性问题。实验表明LLM在递归推理条件下展现出较好的战略深度和内部一致性，错误主要源自迭代次数的选择错误而非最佳响应计算错误；而在归纳条件下性能显著下降，且博弈结构间存在显著异质性。CoT中的显式战略心智化是归纳条件下提升性能的关键因素。该方法的局限性在于只测试到深度10，且使用单一LLM评判器可能引入偏差。

title: Beyond Raw Transcripts: Structured Persona Extraction for LLM-Based Digital Twins
summary: LLM-based "digital twins" aim to simulate how an individual would behavein new environments or respond to novel questions, given some representation of that individual's prior responses. A common approach constructs this representation from survey transcripts or summaries responses. Prior work shows that compressing long transcripts into shorter LLM-generated summaries does not significantly reduce predictive accuracy, suggesting that information volume is not the primary bottleneck. In this work, we argue that the key limitation is instead structural:how persona information is organized before being provided to thesimulator model. We study this by comparing unstructured summaries with structured persona representations. First, we introduce a hand-craftedschema (BDE: Background, Decision procedure, Evaluation), grounded in consumer-behavior theory, and show that it improves predictive accuracy over raw transcripts by +1.91 percentage points on a homogeneous benchmark (Twin-2K-500), with similar gains on gpt-5.4-mini and Qwen3-8B as robustness checks. However, this fixed structure does not generalizeacross more heterogeneous tasks, where performance is statistically indistinguishable from the raw transcript baseline. To address this limitation, we propose an automatic structure-discovery pipeline in which an LLM iteratively proposes and refines task-specific persona structures and extraction prompts. On a benchmark of 13 diverse sub-studies, this approach restores performance, improving mean accuracy by +1.91 percentage points over the raw transcript baseline and eliminating significant losses observed with the fixed schema. Overall, our results suggest that the main constraint in LLM-based digital twins is not how much information is provided, but how it is structured -- and that the optimal structure depends on the task.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM数字孪生中persona信息的结构化表示问题，提出BDE手工结构和自动结构发现两种方法，在Twin-2K-500和Mega-Study基准上验证了结构（而非信息量）是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM数字孪生研究将受访者原始转录本或摘要作为persona输入，但压缩摘要并未显著降低预测准确率，说明信息量并非瓶颈。作者认为真正瓶颈在于persona信息的组织结构（结构性而非容量性），因此聚焦于比较非结构化摘要与结构化persona表示。
AI.method: 提出两层结构框架——Layer 1骨架决定哪些子档案、Layer 2分配决定如何映射转录本证据。两种实现：(1) 基于消费者行为理论的BDE手工结构（背景-决策程序-评估三子档案）；(2) 自动结构发现流水线，LLM迭代提出并优化任务特定结构，采用五轮迭代加calibration-50选择规则，并设置问题/人格双重隔离屏障防止信息泄漏。
AI.result: 在Twin-2K-500同质任务上，BDE结构相对原始转录本提升+1.91pp；在Mega-Study 19个异质子研究上BDE与原始baseline基本持平。但自动发现流水线在13个可迭代子研究上恢复性能，row convention下相对原始转录本提升+1.91pp、相对BDE提升+2.22pp，无显著子研究级损失；结果在gpt-5.4-mini和Qwen3-8B上复现。
AI.conclusion: LLM数字孪生的关键约束不在信息量而在信息组织方式，且最优结构取决于任务。当任务同质且具备行为学依据时，固定结构（如BDE）值得尝试；当任务跨异质行为原语时，应采用按任务自动发现结构。作者将发布BDE提取提示词、自动发现流水线及19个子研究结构作为未来persona侧提示设计的即插即用基线。

title: Building and Evaluating a Synthetic Bengali Speech Resource for Telecom Customer Care
summary: Speech systems used in customer-facing applications often require domain-specific language coverage. We present a synthetic Bengali speech dataset for telecom customer-care scenarios. The dataset contains 10,000 audio-text pairs, approximately 26.82 hours of 24 kHz speech, and predefined train, validation, and test splits of 9,000, 500, and 500 examples. It is publicly released on Hugging Face under the CC-BY-4.0 license. The speech was generated with OmniVoice in voice-cloning mode using a real female reference recording and transcript, with bfloat16 precision, 16 diffusion sampling steps, and a speaking-rate control value of 1.0. Along with the original Bengali text, the dataset provides a normalized transcript field designed for ASR/STT training and evaluation. We report an automatic intelligibility check over all 10,000 samples using a domain-adapted Whisper ASR model fine-tuned from bengaliAI/tugstugi_bengaliai-regional-asr_whisper-medium, along with a manual listening check on selected samples. The evaluation gives an average WER of 2.54%, an average CER of 0.59%, and median WER and CER values of 0.00%. These results suggest strong text-audio consistency under the selected automatic evaluation pipeline, while the paper also discusses the limitations of synthetic speech and STT-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个面向电信客服场景的合成孟加拉语语音数据集,包含10,000条音频-文本对(约26.82小时,24 kHz),采用OmniVoice语音克隆模式生成,并通过领域微调的Whisper ASR模型进行自动可懂度评估,平均WER为2.54%,平均CER为0.59%,中位数均为0.00%。
AI.motivation: 面向客户的语音系统需要领域特定的语言覆盖。电信客服场景涉及充值失败、OTP延迟、套餐激活、余额不符、SIM锁定、退款状态、注册问题等特定词汇和表达,通用语音语料难以充分覆盖。因此需要构建一个孟加拉语电信客服领域的语音资源以支持ASR/STT和TTS研究。
AI.method: 1) 使用OmniVoice(支持600+语言的多语言零样本TTS模型)的语音克隆模式,以一段真实女性录音及其转写为参考,生成合成语音,参数为bfloat16精度、16步扩散采样、speed=1.0、24 kHz输出;2) 文本字段分为原始text和归一化text_normalized两种形式,前者用于TTS输入,后者用于ASR/STT训练;3) 基于bengaliAI/tugstugi_bengaliai-regional-asr_whisper-medium进行领域微调(WER≤10%过滤),构建自动可懂度评估器,在全部10,000条样本上计算WER和CER;4) 对部分样本进行人工听力检查作为定性验证。
AI.result: 在10,000条样本上的自动STT评估结果:平均WER=2.54%,平均CER=0.59%,中位WER=0.00%,中位CER=0.00%。零中位数表明至少一半样本经归一化后被完全正确转写。非零平均源自少数存在的书面形式差异(数字词变体、缩写空格、正字法替代等)。低WER/CER表明文本-音频一致性较强,但作者强调该评估仅作为自动代理指标,不能等同于人类自然度评分。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为孟加拉语电信客服场景提供了首个公开的合成语音资源,展示了较强的文本-音频一致性。局限性包括:合成语音难以泛化到真实场景;仅使用单一女性参考声,说话人多样性受限;STT自动评估无法衡量自然度;归一化规则影响指标。未来工作包括发布详细评估脚本、增加说话人多样性、对比语音克隆与语音设计方法、开展人类听力测试、结合真实孟加拉语语音进行更鲁棒的系统开发。伦理上需注意语音克隆的同意、冒充风险和滥用防范。

title: Self-Speculation for Faster Reasoning Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed for increasingly complex tasks involving planning and multi-step decision making, but high-quality performance on these tasks often requires generating long reasoning traces. This is a poor fit for latency-sensitive and interactive applications like voice assistants or coding agents, where generation latency can strongly affect user experience. Existing acceleration methods typically focus on token-level generation, without utilizing the structure of reasoning workflows. We introduce SSR: Self-Speculation for Reasoning Models, a training-free self-speculative decoding method that leverages the chain-of-thought (CoT) as a source of speculation. SSR uses the partial-CoT answer distribution as the drafter and the full-CoT distribution as the verifier, deriving both from the same model at different reasoning budgets. This builds on the observation that later partial-CoT responses often exhibit greater semantic and lexical overlap with the full-budget response. Due to this overlap, SSR can accept long draft prefixes at once, leading to large speedups on structured and long-form generation tasks. To further exploit draft-response overlap beyond the contiguous prefix accepted by standard speculative decoding, SSR also incorporates suffix decoding, using the draft to seed a suffix cache and recover useful spans beyond the accepted prefix, further reducing latency on tasks with high lexical overlap between the draft and the final response. We evaluate SSR on multiple structured and long-form generation tasks where it is most useful, and demonstrate a relative improvement of up to 24.1% on total generation latency for popular open-source models such as Qwen3.5 and Gemma-4.

AI.tldr: SSR（Self-Speculation for Reasoning Models）是一种无需训练的自推测解码方法，利用推理语言模型在同一模型上以不同思维链（CoT）预算产生的答案分布作为草稿，以高预算分布作为验证器，并通过结合后缀解码（suffix decoding）来恢复被标准推测解码丢弃的有用片段。在 HumanEval、ClassEval 和 LongProc 等结构化与长文本生成任务上，对 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it 等开源模型实现了最高 24.1% 的端到端延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 推理型大语言模型生成的思维链（CoT）往往很长，导致在语音助手、编码代理等对延迟敏感的交互场景中用户体验下降。现有推测解码加速方法多聚焦于 token 级别，未利用 CoT 本身的结构特性来构造草稿；作者观察到随着 CoT 推进，部分预算下的答案分布会逐步收敛至满预算下的最终答案分布，这为利用部分 CoT 草稿提供了自然基础。
AI.method: 1. 单次自推测解码（Algorithm 1）：当 CoT 推进到草稿预算 b_d 时，复制请求以同一前缀并行采样草稿答案 \hat{a}~p_θ(·|q,r_{≤b_d})，主请求继续 CoT 推理至验证预算 b_v，再用标准推测解码规则以 p_θ(·|q,r_{≤b_d}) 为草稿分布、p_θ(·|q,r_{≤b_v}) 为目标分布验证，接受最长前缀。2. 后缀解码：用草稿构建后缀缓存，在继续生成阶段按贪心方式匹配并恢复超过首个拒绝位置的有用片段。3. 多阶段/迭代变体（Algorithm 2）：在多个预算点 {b_1<…<b_T} 逐步采样与验证，使早期草稿可引导后续草稿，降低未知 CoT 长度下的调参脆弱性。4. 在 vLLM 中通过父-子请求调度与 prefix caching 实现，无需修改模型权重或推理基础设施。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Gemma-4-E4B-it 上：ClassEval 延迟分别降低 18.5% 与 24.1%；LongProc 2K 降低 7.1%–9.1%；HumanEval 降低 2.9%–14.6%（受限于 CoT 占主导、答案较短）。ClassEval 上的消融显示：仅前缀验证带来 7.9% 加速，仅后缀解码可达 24.1%，二者结合相当；吞吐损失在草稿活跃窗口内最高 5.4%，但通常被接受 token 抵消；迭代 SSR 在 (i=750, m=500) 设置下将草稿子请求 wall time 减少 11.9%。
AI.conclusion: SSR 证明 CoT 自身的结构是推理模型推测解码的有效资源，无需辅助参数或模型专用修改即可在结构化与长文本生成任务上获得显著加速。后缀解码对恢复因首次不匹配而被丢弃的草稿片段至关重要。局限在于：当答案长度与 CoT 长度相近时收益最大；当 CoT 主导总延迟（如短答案）或任务高熵导致草稿与最终答案词法重叠低时收益有限。未来方向包括加速 CoT 自身生成，以及训练模型在推理早期就锁定答案结构。

title: Research Paper Quality Recognition Through Textual Feature Analysis
summary: Knowledge and innovations are shaped by using the quality and credibility of the scientific research. Yet, distinguishing between impactful, high-quality work and flawed studies remains a challenge. This paper introduces a benchmark for classifying research papers into two categories: good (highly cited) and non-good (retracted), using only textual features from titles and abstracts. We evaluate multiple embedding techniques, including SBERT, Word2Vec, FastText, USE, and TF-IDF, combined with classifiers such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests, and Neural Networks. Our contributions include: (1) hyperparameter transparency, (2) feature space visualizations using t-SNE, (3) model interpretability analysis with SHAP, and (4) detailed examination of error cases. Experimental results show that a neural network with SBERT embeddings achieves 87.22\% accuracy, while FastText combined with SVM reaches 91.12\%. These findings highlight the value of textual information in assessing research quality, with ethical considerations for deployment. This work contributes toward the development of academic integrity tools that promote trustworthy scholarship.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个仅基于标题和摘要文本特征区分高质量论文（高引用）与已撤稿论文的二分类基准，对比了 SBERT、Word2Vec、FastText、USE 和 TF-IDF 五种嵌入方法与 SVM、随机森林和神经网络三种分类器的组合效果。
AI.motivation: 撤稿论文数量持续上升威胁科学文献可信度，但现有研究多依赖元数据或事后分析，缺乏可扩展、实时、仅基于文本的早期筛查手段；作者希望填补"语言学分析+机器学习"在撤稿预测中的空白。
AI.method: 收集 11,673 篇论文（6,000 篇高引用+5,673 篇撤稿），经预处理后分别用 SBERT、Word2Vec、FastText、USE、TF-IDF 提取特征，输入 SVM、随机森林、神经网络（3 层 MLP）进行 80/20 划分训练/测试；辅以 t-SNE 可视化、SHAP 解释和错误案例分析，并给出完整超参数以保证可复现。
AI.result: FastText+SVM 取得最高准确率 91.12%；神经网络+SBERT 达 87.72%（文中亦写为 87.22%）；随机森林整体最稳定；t-SNE 显示高质量论文形成致密簇而撤稿论文更分散，重叠区含 89% 误分类样本；SHAP 揭示撤稿论文过度使用"algorithm/validation"等表层术语及模糊措辞。
AI.conclusion: 文本特征足以作为学术质量评估的早期信号，深度学习在捕捉细微语义模式上优于传统方法，但二元简化（高引用=好、撤稿=差）存在局限；未来应融合引文网络分析、文体特征与跨学科验证，并作为辅助工具而非替代同行评审。

title: An ambiguity taxonomy for evaluating large language model performance on clinical registry abstraction: a multi-site prospective study
summary: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) performance on unprocessed electronic medical record (EMR) data for clinical registry abstraction. Methods: We evaluated LLM performance answering registry questions for the American College of Cardiology National Cardiovascular Data Registry (ACC NCDR). In a pilot study at an academic medical center, the model identified candidate data sources for each registry question and experienced abstractors used these results to define question-specific document sets. In a validation study at a second center with a second ACC NCDR registry, the LLM answered questions using the question-specific document sets. Before reviewing any output, two abstractors independently established the ground truth and assigned each question to one of six categories, ordered by the ambiguity and clinical reasoning required to resolve it: Medication/Event Flag, Binary Clinical Presence, Administrative, Quantitative Laboratory/Physiologic, Clinical Interpretation, and Event Timing. Results: The analytical sample comprised 9,430 abstractor answers reconciled to 4,715 consensus answers (501 pilot; 4,214 validation). In the pilot, candidate data sources per question averaged between 14.6 (SD 13.9) for demographics and 89.2 (SD 56.1) for history and risk factors. In validation, human inter-rater agreement was approximately 98\% while 87\% of LLM answers exactly matched consensus, 2\% partially, and 9\% did not. Mean question-level accuracy was 91.5\% (SD 13.4\%) across 157 questions with at least 20 answers, and declined as ambiguity increased, from 96\% for Medication/Event Flag to 62\% for Event Timing questions. Conclusions: LLMs answering clinical registry questions on unprocessed EMR data achieved far lower accuracy than human abstractors. LLM accuracy fell steadily as ambiguity and the level of required clinical reasoning increased.

AI.tldr: 本研究在两个学术医疗中心的前瞻性多中心试验中，评估了大语言模型（LLM）在未处理电子病历（EMR）数据上进行ACC NCDR临床注册表数据抽取的性能。研究提出了一个按临床推理需求递增排序的六类模糊性分类法（药物/事件标记、二元临床存在、行政管理、定量实验室/生理、临床解释、事件时间），发现LLM整体加权准确率为89.6%，但问题层面平均准确率仅91.5%（SD 13.4%），且准确率随模糊性上升而稳步下降，从最简单的药物/事件标记类（96.1%）降至最复杂的事件时间类（62.0%）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM临床性能评估多依赖临床小案例或结构化基准，无法反映真实、未处理EMR文档中信息的碎片化、冗余和矛盾等特性。临床注册表抽取任务具有数百个结构化问题，且需经过认证的抽象师完成双盲抽取与一致性核对（IRR），为评估LLM在真实多源EMR任务上的表现提供了理想的框架。然而以往研究多报告总体准确率，掩盖了不同问题类型间的性能差异。本研究旨在通过引入"模糊性分类法"，将性能差异归因于临床推理需求层级，从而为LLM临床任务评估提供更具区分度的指标。
AI.method: 研究分两阶段：(1) 试点阶段在机构A使用ACC NCDR EPDI注册表（168个问题×3例去标识患者），LLM被提示识别每个问题对应的候选EMR文档来源及其可回答性；(2) 验证阶段在机构B使用CathPCI注册表v5.7.1（232个问题×25例患者），LLM仅在试点限定的文档上下文内作答。每个问题由两位ACC/NCDR认证抽象师独立抽取并通过讨论达成共识答案（参考标准）。验证前，两位抽象师独立将问题按模糊性递增分为六类：药物/事件标记、二元临床存在、行政管理、定量实验室/生理、临床解释、事件时间；10%随机抽样的二次分类者间一致性为Cohen's κ=0.89。模型使用Claude Sonnet 4.6（复杂问题）和Claude Haiku 3.5（简单问题）。答案评分分为精确匹配、部分匹配、不匹配和弃权。主要结局为非弃权答案的总体准确率；次要结局为问题层面平均准确率（≥20观察的问题）和分类层面准确率。使用Kruskal-Wallis检验和Mann-Whitney U检验（带秩双列效应量）进行跨类别差异检验。
AI.result: 试点阶段候选文档来源每问题平均在14.6（人口统计学，SD 13.9）至89.2（病史与危险因素，SD 56.1）之间；线性模型显示可回答率主要由注册表部分决定（R²=0.31），而非来源数量。验证阶段分析样本包含4,214条观察（9,430条抽象师答案→4,715条共识答案），人类评分者间一致性约98%。LLM对4,171/4,214（99%）作出回答，其中87%精确匹配、2%部分匹配、9%不匹配、1%弃权；加权总体准确率89.6%。157个≥20观察的问题层面平均准确率为91.5%（SD 13.4%，中位数96.0%，范围12.0–100.0%）：61题（39%）达100%，18题（11.5%）低于80%，6题（3.8%）≤60%。准确率按类别递减：药物/事件标记96.1%、二元临床存在94.9%、行政管理93.7%、定量实验室/生理90.1%、临床解释76.6%、事件时间62.0%；Kruskal-Wallis p<0.0001。临床解释与事件时间类问题在<80%准确率组中占比67%（13倍富集）。模型弃权率随复杂度从0.2%升至4.9%，但在<80%准确率问题上召回率仍>90%、精确率<60%。表现最差问题包括导管室就诊指征（12%）、到达时间（20%）、CSHA衰弱量表（56%）、心血管不稳定性（56%）、出院时间（60%）。
AI.conclusion: 在两个ACC/NCDR注册表、两个机构、人类IRR约98%的条件下，LLM在未处理EMR上的问题层面平均准确率（91.5%）显著低于认证人类抽象师，且准确率随问题模糊性和所需临床推理水平单调下降，从最简单类别（96%）到最复杂类别（62%），跨度达34个百分点。LLM的失败模式主要源于"大海捞针"式多文档交叉验证需求及对矛盾时间戳的整合能力不足，而非训练数据缺乏。LLM在低准确率问题上仍倾向于猜测而非弃权。研究建议：(1) LLM临床抽取性能应按类别和问题报告，而非聚合报告（加权与未加权准确率差5.6个百分点）；(2) 应采用"IRR索引损失"训练模型，使模型在人类一致时加深推理、不一致时承认模糊性；(3) 该模糊性分类法可推广应用于其他临床注册表评估。样本量较小（验证仅25例）、缺少类别级人类IRR数据是该研究的主要局限。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: GRAFT提出了一种面向扩散语言模型(DLM)draft(如DFlash)的自适应draft tree构建框架,通过Target-Distilled Edge Scoring(TDES)和State-Aware Budget Allocation(SABA)分别解决DDTree中存在的父子不匹配和预算错配问题,实现了2.13×–6.36×的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 树形推测解码通过一次验证多条draft路径提升平均接受token数(MAT)。但DLM drafter(如DFlash)通过单次前向输出所有未来位置的token分布,无法采用传统的parent-conditioned expansion。现有DDTree虽然适配了DLM,但存在两个问题:(1)parent-agnostic edge scoring仅基于token概率,导致target-compatible token被错误地连接到错误的父节点(parent–child mismatch);(2)固定预算忽略了吞吐量最优树大小随解码状态变化的事实(budget misallocation)。
AI.method: GRAFT包含两个组件:(1)TDES:从target model traces中蒸馏出一个轻量级bi-tower edge scorer,为每个(parent, child, depth)三元组打分,使用log q_{t,d}(c) + β·f̃_θ(p,c,d),其中f̃_θ是centered compatibility score;训练目标综合KL散度、pairwise margin loss和class-balanced BCE。(2)SABA:将每轮预算选择建模为吞吐量效用最大化问题U_t(B)=G_t(B)/C_t(B),其中G_t用state-conditioned saturation curve(依赖draft confidence、acceptance history和representation degeneration三个信号)建模增益,C_t建模验证成本(线性+前缀长度项);通过在验证集上拟合参数,推理时在32–512范围内搜索最优预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/Coder-30B上跨9个基准(GSM8K, Math500, AIME24/25, HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench, Alpaca)的27个model–dataset组中,GRAFT全部取得最高的wall-time speedup(2.13×–6.36×),每轮额外开销<0.5ms(约1.4%的验证延迟)。消融实验显示TDES贡献+5.7% TPS,SABA贡献+12.8%,组合贡献+19.4%;SABA达到oracle吞吐的94.1%;β=0.2为最优;TDES具备跨任务泛化能力(仅GSM8K训练即可在MBPP/SWE-bench/Alpaca上提升性能)。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT通过target-distilled edge scoring和state-aware budget allocation两个互补机制,有效解决了DLM-based draft tree构建中的父子不匹配和预算错配问题,在保持极低开销的同时显著提升了解码吞吐量。论文也指出未来方向是通过并发推测解码消除drafting、tree construction和verification之间的流水线气泡。

title: Decoupled Vision-Language System for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: We introduce a new architecture design for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Libra, capable of both multimodal understanding and generation. Libra architecture contains one vision system and one language system, connected by cross-modal bridges. This design decouples self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction, enabling each modality to learn its unique representations while maintaining effective cross-modal comprehension. The decoupling is mainly achieved in a switch attention module and a switch FFN module, which dynamically routes the computation flow for self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction scenarios. We evaluate the effectiveness in two important settings: \textbf{Libra-1} for the understanding-only image-to-text setting, and \textbf{Libra-2} for unified image-to-text understanding and text-to-image generation. In addition to the architecture design, we discuss various improvements on tokenization, positional encoding, and supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the dedicated Libra design enables mutual improvements on multimodal understanding and generation, achieving strong performance on both understanding and generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的解耦式视觉-语言架构 Libra，通过分离自模态建模与跨模态交互，在统一理解与生成任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 在视觉与语言模态之间存在模态不平衡问题：统一架构易受数据偏差影响，级联架构则将视觉建模弱化为后端生成器的提示，难以真正融合跨模态知识。本文旨在设计一种兼顾模块化与层级跨模态交互的新架构。
AI.method: Libra 架构包含独立的视觉系统与语言系统，通过"跨模态桥接"（cross-modal bridge）相连。核心设计包括：(1) 切换注意力（Switch Attention）：自模态建模使用标准自注意力，跨模态交互则通过低秩桥接矩阵将 Q/K/V 映射到新特征空间；(2) 切换 FFN（Switch FFN）：对图像特征按理解/生成任务路由至不同 FFN 专家；(3) 两种实例化：Libra-1（仅理解，采用混合 token 化+统一离散自回归监督，基于冻结 CLIP-ViT-L 的 LFQ tokenizer）；Libra-2（统一理解与生成，采用连续空间视觉 token 化、UniRoPE 二维位置编码、连续空间掩码图像生成）；训练损失为语言 CE 损失与视觉 MSE 损失加权和。
AI.result: Libra-1（11B）在 MME（1494.7）、POPE（88.2）、SEED（62.7）等基准上超越同期 MLLM；Libra-2（3B）在 GenEval（0.63）上达到领先水平，MJHQ FID（10.39）和 COCO FID（8.13）在统一模型中最佳；消融实验证实切换注意力、跨模态桥接、UniRoPE、连续视觉建模均带来显著增益；统一训练下理解与生成相互促进。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式视觉-语言系统能够同时提升多模态理解与生成能力。Libra 通过切换注意力与切换 FFN 实现模块化与跨模态交互的平衡，注意力分析显示其层级多样性更高、学习冗余更低，为 MLLM 架构设计提供了超越简单模态对齐的新思路。

title: Using Human-LLM Disagreement to Improve Checklist-Based Quality Appraisal
summary: Systematic reviews rely on quality appraisal of included studies, a process that is time-consuming and sensitive to ambiguity in checklist criteria. Although large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities to support these tasks, appraisal checklists are typically treated as fixed inputs, and it remains unclear how their design affects agreement with expert judgments. Therefore, we investigate (1) whether LLMs can approximate human judgments in checklist-based appraisal and (2) whether patterns of human-LLM disagreement can be used to identify and improve ambiguous checklist items. Using the Guidelines for Reporting on Latent Trajectory Studies (GRoLTS) checklist, we compare LLM-generated assessments with expert annotations across three research topics and two checklist versions. Agreement is assessed using item-level accuracy, chance-corrected agreement, and preservation of study-level rank ordering. We find that performance varies substantially across checklist items, with ambiguous and conditional criteria producing the greatest disagreement. Revising these items improves both raw and chance-corrected agreement. Although item-level misclassifications persist, LLM-generated scores often preserve the relative ranking of studies when high-agreement items are retained. These results indicate that reliable LLM-assisted appraisal depends not only on model choice but also on checklist design. The findings suggest that analyzing human-LLM disagreement can help identify problematic checklist items and support the iterative improvement of research synthesis workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何利用大语言模型（LLM）辅助系统综述中的质量评估（基于GRoLTS清单），重点探讨了清单设计对人与LLM一致性的影响。通过对比原始与修订版清单在三个领域（PTSD、教育成就、青少年犯罪）的表现，发现分析人机分歧可有效识别模糊条目，进而通过修订提升一致性。
AI.motivation: 系统综述中的质量评估耗时且易受清单条目模糊性影响。已有研究多关注LLM本身能力或提示设计，而将清单视为固定输入，忽视了清单设计对人与LLM判断一致性的影响。本研究旨在探索能否通过人机分歧分析来识别并改进清单中的问题条目。
AI.method: 使用检索增强生成（RAG）管线让五个LLM（GPT-5 mini、LLaMA 3.3 70B、Qwen3 30B、Qwen3-Next 80B、Magistral Small）对GRoLTS清单的全文研究进行二元标注。比较原始清单（v1，21项）和修订清单（v2，19项）在三个领域（PTSD、教育成就、青少年犯罪）的表现。通过逐项准确率、Cohen's κ和Fleiss' κ评估一致性，并使用Spearman秩相关评估研究层面的排序保持能力。清单修订基于v1的逐项分歧分析，遵循减少歧义、消除复合问题、消除条件子项、与显式报告对齐四项原则。
AI.result: v1中性能因条目而异（准确率约0.10至接近1.0），模糊和条件性条款导致最大分歧。修订后的v2在原始准确率和机会校正一致性上均有提升：Cohen's κ从v1的0.31-0.52提升至v2的0.41-0.72；Fleiss' κ从0.41提升至0.60-0.61。排序分析显示，使用高一致性条目时LLM能较好保持研究相对排序（ρ≈0.58-0.93），而低一致性条目会显著降低排序稳定性。GPT-5 mini表现最佳，但模型间差异小于清单设计带来的差异。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的LLM辅助评估不仅取决于模型选择，还取决于清单设计。人机分歧分析可作为诊断工具，用于识别清单中的模糊或定义不充分的条目，从而迭代改进研究综合工作流程。研究支持一种选择性自动化策略：LLM负责明确标准的条目，人类专家处理模糊或概念复杂的条目。

title: ImmigrationReason: A Structured Dataset of U.S. Immigration Appeals for Legal Reasoning Research
summary: Most legal NLP resources draw from federal case law and focus on coarse classification, leaving administrative adjudication, where the vast majority of government decisions occur, essentially unaddressed. We introduce ImmigrationReason, a large-scale structured dataset derived from 12,375 non-precedent decisions of the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Administrative Appeals Office (AAO) spanning 2005 to 2026. Each record captures the applicable legal framework, per-criterion evidence-sufficiency findings under a five-category label, verbatim adjudicator-criticism quotes, all citations, and final dispositions, alongside high-quality Claude-transcribed source text. Extraction quality is validated through a three-pass pipeline combining two independent modalities with comparison-prompt adjudication by Opus 4.7, and verified by domain experts on a 500-record sample. The dataset documents nearly 9,000 verbatim instances of AAO-identified legal errors, spans a natural legal-regime transition (the 2016 Dhanasar rule change), and covers 21 years of adjudication. We analyze the dataset in detail and outline research directions it enables, from outcome prediction and adjudicator-error analysis to agent design for high-stakes regulatory domains.

AI.tldr: ImmigrationReason 是一个大规模结构化数据集,源自 12,375 份美国移民局行政上诉办公室(USCIS AAO)的非先例决定(2005–2026 年),针对 EB-1A 杰出人才和 NIW 国家利益豁免两类职业移民上诉。每条记录包含法律框架、逐项证据充分性判定(五分类标签)、裁决官批评原文引语、引用及最终裁定,并配有 Claude 转录的高质量源文本。该数据集填补了法律 NLP 资源集中于联邦判例法而忽视行政裁决的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有法律 NLP 资源主要源自联邦判例法,且任务多为粗粒度分类,几乎未覆盖行政裁决(美国政府绝大多数决策发生于此)。鉴于 USCIS 每年处理数百万申请、AAO 公开详细的上诉决定,且 USCIS 已明确承认在裁决中使用 AI 工具,亟需一个能够独立评估法律推理能力的高质量行政法数据集。
AI.method: 1) 从 USCIS 网站爬取 13,520 份 PDF,过滤后保留 12,375 份决定;2) 对 2017 年前扫描件使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 vision 转录,对 2017 年后文本原生 PDF 使用 PyMuPDF;3) 设计三层结构化模式(Decision、LegalIssue、Finding),其中 Finding 采用五分类标签(met/not_met/reserved/waived_by_petitioner/not_addressed);4) 采用三遍提取流水线(PDF 直接提取 + 转录文本提取 + Opus 4.7 裁决),对 27.5% 不一致的记录进行裁决式仲裁;5) 由领域专家对 500 条记录进行人工核查。
AI.result: 数据集包含 12,375 份决定(NIW 6,981 + EB-1A 5,394)、45,290 条逐项判定、约 9,000 条裁决官批评原文引语、150,000+ 条引用,覆盖 21 年跨度并包含 2016 年 12 月 Dhanasar 规则变更这一自然法律制度断点。三遍流水线在法律关键字段(签证类别、案件类型、裁定)上一致性超过 97%,Claude 转录相比传统 OCR 在脚注恢复上提升 232%、消除 99.9% 噪声 token,单文档最大恢复率提升 620%。500 条专家审查样本全部正确合理。揭示了各 USCIS 服务中心之间显著的逆转率差异(36.0%–54.4%)。
AI.conclusion: ImmigrationReason 是首个提供行政法逐项证据充分性标签、裁决官错误显式标注以及内置法律制度时间断点的法律 NLP 资源,在深度结构化程度、覆盖面和质量验证方面均超越现有数据集(法律案例法 Pile of Law、CaseHOLD、LegalBench 等)。它支撑结果预测、裁决错误检测、法律论证质量评估、时序法律动态研究、偏见与制度差异分析以及高风险监管领域智能体设计等多方向研究。局限在于仅覆盖职业移民裁决(EB-1A 和 NIW),存在上诉选择偏差,所有 PII 已被隐去。

title: Self-Supervised Speech Representations Track Spoken Language Convergence to Adult Models in Infants and Children Who Are Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing
summary: Language development is characterized by a gradual convergence of children's speech toward adult patterns. Measuring this process has traditionally required detailed transcription and language-specific expertise, limiting scalability across languages and populations. Here, we use speech embeddings to capture this convergence directly from the acoustic signal in longform, child-centered recordings, taken as children go about their daily lives. Using HuBERT-BASE, we extracted embeddings from speech vocalizations of children who are deaf/hard-of-hearing and their female adult caregivers ($>$925 hrs. observation). Embedding distance between children and caregivers decreased with hearing age, controlling for pitch and vocalization length, indicating, as expected, that children's speech patterns converge to caregivers over development. This single distance metric likewise related to multiple standardized measures of speech and language from infancy through preschoolhood. These results suggest a path toward scalable, language-neutral assessment of spoken language development from children's everyday lives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自监督语音表征（HuBERT-BASE）的嵌入距离度量方法，用于追踪聋/听力困难（DHH）儿童的语音向成人模式趋同的发展轨迹。该方法无需转录或语言学专业知识，直接从长时儿童中心录音的声学信号中提取768维嵌入向量，计算儿童发声与全局女性照顾者嵌入质心之间的距离。结果表明，该距离随听力年龄增长而显著减小，并可解释多种标准化言语语言测量（词汇量、辅音发音准确性）的额外方差，且对说话人标注错误具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 儿童语言发展评估传统上依赖人工转录和语言学专业知识的详细标注，成本高且难以跨语言、跨群体扩展，尤其限制了聋/听力困难（DHH）儿童这一因听觉获取受限而面临语言延迟风险的群体的纵向评估。本研究旨在探索一种直接从自然录音中提取的、可扩展的、语言中立的语音发展度量方法。
AI.method: 研究对象为34名双侧中-重度听力损失儿童（59个录音时间点），使用LENA设备采集总计925小时的自然录音。经说话人日志化（diarization）后，利用HuBERT-BASE提取7-9层768维嵌入向量并跨时间均值池化。构建跨所有录音的全局女性照顾者（FEM）嵌入质心，计算儿童（CHD）发声嵌入到该质心的距离。控制变量包括平均基频f₀和发声时长。采用线性混合效应模型和bootstrap重采样（每次200个CHD片段×1000次迭代）检验该距离与听力年龄及标准化测试（MB-CDI、PPVT-4、EVT-2、GFTA-2）的关系，并通过对CHD片段施加0-100%的说话人标签污染进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 嵌入距离随听力年龄显著减小（β=-0.50, p<.001），额外解释11.30%的方差；显著预测词汇产出（MB-CDI: β=-0.35, p<.001）、接受性词汇（PPVT-4: β=-0.29, p<.001）、表达性词汇（EVT-2: β=-0.24, p<.001）以及辅音发音准确性（GFTA-2: β=-0.41, p<.001），额外解释方差3.51%-14.33%。听力年龄比实足年龄更好地追踪后期词汇和发音结果。敏感性分析显示，在高达80%的说话人标签污染下，距离系数的方向仍保持稳定，表明结果不易受LENA说话人标注错误的系统性影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实，基于自监督语音嵌入的儿童-照顾者距离是一种简单、可计算轻量、语言中立且对标注错误鲁棒的儿童口语发展度量方法，可从自然录音中扩展性地追踪DHH儿童的术后语言进展，是对临床评估的补充而非替代。未来需在更大规模、不同语言群体中验证，并进一步厘清嵌入距离所捕获的声学/非语言变异成分。

title: ARGUS: Theory-of-Mind Guided Argument Generation with Strategy-Aware Planning and Knowledge Grounding
summary: Persuasive argument generation requires modeling audience beliefs, rhetorical strategies, and factual grounding. Despite recent advancements, existing methods remain largely audience-agnostic and fail to integrate strategy selection to improve persuasiveness. To bridge this gap, we propose Argus, an agent-based framework that operationalizes classical rhetoric for persuasive writing. At its core, a Theory-of-Mind (ToM) Reasoner constructs an explicit dual mental model of the audience's beliefs and values to guide downstream decisions. This representation conditions a component-aware planner that decomposes the argument into subtopics, assigns fine-grained rhetorical functions (logos, pathos, ethos, kairos), and triggers strategy-guided evidence retrieval at planning time. Finally, a refinement module iteratively targets and resolves multi-dimensional weaknesses without quality regression. We evaluate Argus across three diverse benchmarks using both automated pairwise Elo and LLM-as-judge metrics. Results show that Argus consistently outperforms strong baselines across multiple backbone models, achieving top rankings and the highest overall scores. Targeted simulation experiments further validate its effectiveness in shifting resistant audience stances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Argus，一种基于智能体（agent）的说服性论证生成框架，通过引入心智理论（ToM）推理、组件感知的修辞规划以及知识接地，显著提升了论证的说服力。
AI.motivation: 现有论证生成方法存在三大局限：1）受众无关（audience-agnostic），缺乏对受众心理状态、情感抵触和价值取向的显式建模；2）策略无关的内容规划（strategy-agnostic），仅关注主题排序而忽视修辞模式（logos/pathos/ethos）的显式分配；3）证据检索与论证生成分离，无法根据具体子主题的修辞需求动态调整。
AI.method: Argus框架由五个顺序模块组成：1）输入分析器（Input Analyzer）：判断是否需要外部检索，生成结构化表示（关键主张、背景知识、逻辑结构）；2）ToM推理器（ToM Reasoner）：构建受众的双重心理模型Ψ=(Ψ_O, Ψ_V)，包括对手模型（情感触发、立场主张）和价值模型（受众价值观与桥接策略）；3）论证规划器（Argument Planner）：将论证分解为子主题序列，每个子主题分配四元组属性(ci, ki, ei, ri)，其中ci为修辞组件（logos/pathos/ethos/kairos/evidence），并触发策略引导的证据检索；4）论证写作者（Argument Writer）：根据规划生成完整论证；5）迭代优化器（Iterative Refiner）：多维度评估，针对最弱维度进行定向修订，并采用best-of-n缓冲防止质量回退。
AI.result: 在CMV、iDebate、ExplaGraphs三个基准数据集上，使用DeepSeek-v3.2、Qwen3.5-Flash、GPT-5-mini三种骨干模型进行评估。Argus在所有设置下均稳定优于Direct、Plan&Write、Self-Refine、Debate四个基线方法。在ELO配对评估和绝对LLM评判指标上均取得最高分，特别是在说服力（persuasiveness）和事实准确性（factual accuracy）维度上优势显著。针对性模拟实验（法官扮演持反对立场的受众）进一步验证Argus在转变抵触受众立场方面的有效性。消融实验表明三个核心组件（ToM、规划、迭代优化）均贡献显著，其中优化器影响最大，但ToM引导的规划是其发挥效用的前提。管道分析显示修辞策略效果具有受众依赖性。
AI.conclusion: Argus通过将认知心理学（ToM）、古典修辞学（修辞组件）和智能体语言建模三者结合，推进了计算论证研究。实验证明其能产生实际的说服效果（而非仅仅是表面流畅性）。论文同时讨论了局限性（ToM模型由LLM生成可能不忠实、事实核查仍不足、多阶段管道增加延迟）和伦理考量（说服技术的双重用途风险，倡导披露AI生成内容）。

title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by drafting future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. A diffusion-style block head such as DFlash is an attractive drafter, predicting an entire block of future tokens in one forward pass. However, it is trained on per-position marginals rather than the joint block distribution, so the tokens it emits are individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. We introduce LiLiCorr, a Lightweight Likelihood-based model that Correlates the per-position marginal distributions a drafter already produces. It keeps the top-k tokens at each position as candidates and processes them jointly, producing for each an in and an out vector. A pair of adjacent candidates matches when the earlier one's out vector has high cosine similarity with the later one's in vector. These matches capture the block's joint structure without ever materializing the full joint distribution. One lightweight network pass produces all the vectors, and the pairwise scores are then computed in parallel as batched matrix operations, leaving only a cheap greedy walk sequential. We further co-train the drafter with LiLiCorr, so it learns to propose candidates that correlate into longer accepted sequences. Over the vanilla DFlash drafter, LiLiCorr raises acceptance length on every benchmark by 9 to 19%, while its scoring head accounts for about 2.8% of the per-block latency. Against DFlash and two concurrent methods that also restore coherence at draft time, LiLiCorr delivers the highest throughput in 70 of 72 settings: nine benchmarks at two target sizes under greedy and temperature-one decoding, and a throughput sweep over six concurrencies, two input lengths and three entropy tiers, with all systems equally optimized on a common serving stack. Extending LiLiCorr to inputs an order of magnitude longer than it was trained on preserves that lead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LiLiCorr,一种用于并行草稿推测解码(draft speculation decoding)的轻量级似然相关性模型。它通过为每个候选 token 分配"入"和"出"两个向量,并以余弦相似度耦合相邻位置,在单次网络前向传播中恢复出由 DFlash 等并行块草稿器生成的联合一致块序列。实验表明,在所有9个基准测试上将 DFlash 草稿器的接受长度提升 9–19%,在 72 个测试场景中 70 个场景取得最高吞吐量,并在推理时仅增加约 2.8% 的每块延迟。
AI.motivation: 推测解码(speculative decoding)通常依赖小型草稿模型预测未来 token 以加速推理。扩散式块头(如 DFlash)可在单次前向传播中预测整块 token,但由于其仅按逐位置边际(marginal)训练,所预测的 token 虽各自合理却联合不一致(联合分布未被建模)。先前方法(DDTree、Domino、DSpark)或需在草稿时多次网络传播,或将相关性负担转嫁给目标模型,带来额外延迟。
AI.method: LiLiCorr 在每个位置保留草稿器的前 K 个候选 token,为每个候选同时学习一个"入"向量与"出"向量(均归一化为单位向量)。相邻位置候选对的兼容性通过前者的"出"向量与后者"入"向量的余弦相似度衡量,从而把联合相关性计算化简为成对的矩阵乘法。整个候选格由一个轻量级 Transformer 单次处理,得到所有向量对后,通过廉价的贪心自左至右 argmax 选取最终块。训练时引入局部归一化(对齐前缀接受特性)、oracle-prefix 监督、目标加权干扰惩罚项,使评分与目标验证器偏好一致。还可与 DFlash 草稿器联合训练,使草稿器学会提出易被相关成长的候选集;在超长输入时附加边缘正则化提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-4B 两个目标模型、9 个基准(GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME 2025、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、AlpacaEval、MT-Bench、SPEED)、贪心与温度1采样条件下,LiLiCorr 在 72 个设定中 70 个取得最高吞吐量,接受长度在所有基准上较原版 DFlash 提升 9–19%,其评分头仅占每块延迟的约 2.8%,比 Domino 的头部便宜约 2.4 倍。在 8K/16K/32K 等超过训练长度的输入上,搭配 YaRN 位置扩展与边缘正则器,LiLiCorr 仍保持优势,在多语言等分布外任务中增益最大(吞吐量提升 11.0–16.8%)。
AI.conclusion: LiLiCorr 通过将并行草稿器的逐位置边际耦合成联合一致序列,把草稿时相关性计算化简为单次前向加矩阵运算,显著提升推测解码吞吐量并降低头部开销,为该方向设立了新的 state-of-the-art。其局限是仅能重排草稿器前 K 个候选,无法恢复缺失于候选池中的正确 token;未来可探索更长距离候选耦合。

title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers
summary: Efficient-transformer research often motivates token pruning and adaptive computation with the claim that not all tokens require equal computational effort. We test this claim end to end using SEWN, a two-stream Transformer that routes tokens through either lightweight or full-capacity processing using a learned gate. Across our experiments, routing introduces negligible accuracy change relative to parameter-matched baselines, while the gate's token-importance signal depends critically on how it is learned. A static lexicon-seeded prior fails a counterfactual faithfulness test on BoolQ, whereas a fully contextual gate achieves highly significant separation ($p<10^{-10}$) on both evaluated tasks without changing task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SEWN（Stream-Efficient Word Network），一种双流Transformer，通过学习门控将token路由到轻量流或全容量流。论文系统性地测试了高效Transformer研究中常被捆绑的两个主张（效率主张与可解释性主张），发现路由机制对精度贡献微弱，而重要性信号的可信度（faithfulness）高度依赖于门控的学习方式和选择准则是否为内容的稳定函数。
AI.motivation: 高效Transformer研究通常基于"并非所有token都需要同等计算量"这一前提，同时声称token剪枝/自适应计算既能节省计算又能提供可解释的重要性信号。论文旨在将这两个主张解耦，使用显式路由架构（SEWN）进行严格的端到端经验检验，而非默认接受这些主张。
AI.method: 1) SEWN核心架构：双流设计，token经小型MLP门控（输出路由概率）后，按比例分配到轻量function-word流（2层，256-d）和BERT初始化的content流（4层，768-d），通过分层交叉注意力融合。2) SEWN-sparse：对content流执行hard top-k选择，实现实际计算节省。3) SEWN-lean：移除function流的精简变体。4) 门控对比：静态词典先验（基于功能词词典269 token ids）vs. 完全上下文门控。5) 评估协议：基于ERASER的掩码-测量反事实忠实性测试，要求top-k > random-k > bottom-k的严格序关系（配对t检验）。6) 与三种后验解释方法（原始注意力、注意力rollout、积分梯度）在同一协议下比较，并进行随机top-k消融以分离选择瓶颈与学习排序各自的贡献。7) 直接重新实现Mixture-of-Depths作为对比基线。8) 通过蒸馏（logit-KL + 门控分数MSE）修复SEWN-lean的忠实性。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 路由相比参数匹配基线对精度影响可忽略（SEWN各变体与均匀门控在BoolQ上统计上不可区分）。(2) 静态词典先验在BoolQ上反事实忠实性测试失败（p=0.480），而上交下文门控通过（p=1.7×10⁻¹⁰），且精度几乎相同（68.85 vs. 69.20）。(3) SEWN-sparse实现5.2–8.7×于BERT-base、2.6–4.4×于DistilBERT的吞吐量，在PubMedQA（27k样本）上精度-速度折中保持稳健。(4) 忠实性的来源是学习的排序而非硬选择瓶颈本身：随机top-k（相同架构）准确率仅降2.6点但忠实性消失（p=0.45）。(5) 上交下文门控的优势在RoBERTa/BoolQ上不复现（p=0.177），先验大小/覆盖/内容的系统扫描排除了混淆因素。(6) SEWN-sparse在忠实性-效率帕累托前沿上支配所有后验方法，积分梯度推理成本高46×。(7) Mixture-of-Depths有真实路由信号但未通过严格序关系标准。(8) 蒸馏可修复SEWN-lean在BoolQ上失败的忠实性（p从0.205变为1.6×10⁻⁷）。(9) 长篇多选阅读理解（RACE）上所有压缩模型均出现严重精度崩溃，并非路由特有。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出四个"经得起检验"的主张：(i) 手工词典先验可在无精度症状的情况下静默降低重要性信号的可靠性；(ii) 硬top-k选择在跨数据规模和序列长度上都带来真实计算收益；(iii) 路由忠实性取决于选择准则是否为内容的稳定函数，而非硬瓶颈本身存在与否；(iv) SEWN-sparse在忠实性-效率前沿上优于包括Mixture-of-Depths在内的对比方法。同时否定四个主张：路由对精度无实质提升；密集Transformer基线可通过廉价后验方法获得匹配忠实性；效率-忠实性包在所有任务类型上不均匀成立（长篇多选理解上崩溃）；上交下文门控优势具有骨干网络依赖性。论文诚实报告负面结果，核心贡献在于方法论：为路由类高效Transformer声称可解释性收益时提供了一套可复现的验证协议（反事实掩码+随机对照+成本比较）。

title: Directional Contextual Representations for Dependency Relations: Why Cross-Direction Pairing Fails
summary: Splitting a bidirectional LSTM's contextual representation into a forward-only $F_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $1..i$) and a backward-only $B_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $i..n$) beats either alone and beats a fused self-attention representation for dependency relation-type classification. But a specific, natural extension of this idea -- pairing a token's forward state against a \emph{candidate}'s backward state (``cross-direction'' pairing, $F_i$ vs.\ $B_j$) -- consistently \emph{underperforms} same-direction pairing, and the penalty \emph{grows}, not shrinks, with token distance, both paired-bootstrap significant. We diagnose why using a frozen-trunk methodology: architectural information leakage between directions is impossible by construction (a single-layer BiLSTM, verified by code inspection); 93\% of the same-vs-cross gap survives freezing the trunk and training only fresh heads, ruling out training-co-adaptation as the primary cause; linear regression shows partial representational redundancy between $F_i$ and $B_i$ ($R^2{=}0.324$ vs.\ $0.028$ for a shuffled control) and a linear probe shows partial anticipatory encoding of upcoming tokens in $F_i$ (36.5\% vs.\ 17.2\% majority baseline) -- real effects, but neither alone, nor combined, cleanly explains the full gap. Extended frozen-trunk diagnostics (a positional probe and a distance-decay probe) show directional information is genuinely stored but not exactly positioned, and propagates only a few tokens before decaying to baseline -- consistent with, and mechanistically underneath, the distance-growth finding.

AI.tldr: 将BiLSTM拆分为严格的前向Fi与后向Bi表示用于依赖关系分类,优于单方向和融合自注意力;但跨方向配对(Fi vs Bj)始终弱于同方向配对,且距离越大惩罚越大——经冻结主干诊断,排除架构泄漏与训练伪影,部分解释归因于表示冗余与短程方向信息,但机制未被完全阐明。
AI.motivation: 双向编码器(尤其是Transformer)普遍将前向与后向信息融合,但方向性结构对关系型任务(如依存分析)的具体贡献鲜被孤立研究。本文的动机是:在依赖关系分类中,保持方向分离是否真的有用?特别是将一个token的某方向状态与另一token的反方向状态进行比较时,是否能带来额外信号?现有架构将信息融合后再做关系比较,无法回答这一窄而具体的实证问题。
AI.method: 采用单层BiLSTM作为"洁净诊断工具",因架构上保证Fi仅依赖1..i、Bi仅依赖i..n,无任何注意力或混合层。词嵌入(100维)+UPOS嵌入(32维)拼接后输入BiLSTM(每方向隐藏层128),Fi和Bi直接从双向输出切片。设计多种成对表示(同方向、跨方向、融合、含位置编码等),送入相同结构的分类头(Linear→ReLU→Dropout→Linear)。使用配对Bootstrap检验统计显著性,采用冻结主干方法诊断跨方向失败原因(线性回归冗余R²、线性预测下一词UPOS的位置/距离衰减探针),并在UD English EWT(12,544/2,001/2,077句)及GUM(11,314/1,575/1,464句)上进行主实验与跨题材验证,辅以参数匹配的Transformer骨干对比(无标签依存头发现,UAS)。
AI.result: 主要结果:(1) Fi+Bi融合表示在关系分类(16类)上以0.9733测试准确率优于单方向(f_only 0.9667/b_only 0.9625)及融合自注意力(0.9652),bootstrap显著但Cohen's d小(0.045–0.064)。(2) 跨方向配对在二元边存在性任务上明显弱于同方向:cross_fb(0.9050)较same_f(0.9362)低3.08点,cross_bf(0.8588)低7.74点;且差距随|i-j|单调增长(1–2距离-0.0233 → 21+距离-0.0538)。(3) 冻结主干后93%的差距依然存在;Fi→Bi线性回归R²=0.324(对照0.028),Fi可预测下一词UPOS至36.5%(基线17.2%);方向信息仅传播3–5个token即衰减至基线。(4) 参数匹配下BiLSTM(1.535M)UAS 0.8609仍显著优于Transformer(1.490M,UAS 0.8349,d=0.085),在GUM上两项核心发现均得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 方向分离在依赖关系发现中确实有用(跨题材泛化),但跨方向成对比较这一"自然扩展"一致失败且随距离恶化。架构信息泄漏被构造性排除;训练协同适应被大部分排除(93%差距在冻结主干后保留);表示冗余与短程预期编码是真实但部分的贡献因素,二者单独或合用均无法完全解释机制——诊断为部分而非完全。核心结论在参数匹配的Transformer对比与不同题材数据集下均成立。该特定跨方向消融据作者所知尚未见诸文献,以诚实限定范围的实证结果呈现。

title: AsmEvo: Agentic Assembly-Level Optimization of AMD GPU Kernels with Functional Equivalence Verification
summary: High-performance ML systems increasingly rely on GPU kernels whose editable source is unavailable, generated, or too distant from final machine code to expose remaining optimizations. Existing LLM kernel optimizers and autotuners mainly operate on CUDA, Triton, HIP, or tensor-program source and validate against reference implementations. We study a stricter setting: optimizing an already compiled AMDGPU code object, where the deployed binary is the only behavioral oracle. We present AsmEvo, an agentic assembly-level optimizer for AMD GPU kernels. Given an AMDGPU code object K0, AsmEvo reconstructs a reassemblable representation, proposes low-level edits with a long-horizon agent, rebuilds an ABI-preserving optimized object, and accepts candidates only after differential verification against K0 under identical launches. AsmEvo combines code-object recovery, metadata-aware rebuilding, profiling-guided hot-window editing, correctness-gated timing, and conservative in-place patch fallback. We conduct extensive experiments with AsmEvo on various AMD GPU kernels. On MI308X, AsmEvo improves 29 of 30 selected KernelBench kernels, reaching 1.35x geometric-mean and 3.88x maximum speedup. On MI300X production workloads, it improves all evaluated AITer binaries and vLLM/SGLang Triton assembly kernels, reaching 1.09x/1.31x and 1.18x/1.34x geometric-mean/maximum speedups, respectively, while preserving functional equivalence.

AI.tldr: AsmEvo是一个针对AMD GPU编译后代码对象（HSACO）的智能体驱动的汇编级优化系统，无需源码，将原始二进制作为唯一行为预言机，通过差分验证保证功能等价性，并在KernelBench及多个生产工作负载上实现了显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现代ML部署中许多GPU内核仅以编译后的AMDGPU代码对象形式存在（无源码、无独立参考实现），现有LLM内核优化器主要面向可编辑源码（CUDA/Triton/HIP），无法在部署的二进制层面进一步挖掘优化空间；同时，二进制修改极易破坏kernarg ABI、内存安全或语义正确性，需要严格的差分验证机制。
AI.method: 系统包含五大组件：(1) 代码对象恢复与往返保真——从AMDGPU ELF重建可重汇编的AMDGCN表示并通过字节级round-trip验证；(2) 双层差分预言机——可推断launch结构时合成输入，否则捕获真实dispatch（kernargs/launch geometry/设备内存）进行重放；(3) 元数据感知的ABI保留重建——重新计算VGPR/SGPR/AGPR/LDS等资源字段，冻结kernarg布局，必要时采用资源中性的就地字节补丁回退；(4) 性能分析与热点窗口定位——基于硬件计数器和静态分析选择瓶颈指令窗口进行局部编辑；(5) 长程智能体搜索——LLM驱动（Claude Opus 4.8）提出架构特定编辑，确定性门控负责构建、ABI一致性、差分等价性和性能验证；采用多起点、已验证组合、防停滞重定向和方差感知提交阈值。
AI.result: 在MI308X上KernelBench 30个内核中29个得到提升，几何均值1.35×，最高3.88×（depthwise Conv2D）；Level 1全部15个提升（Geo-mean 1.56×，Max 3.88×），Level 2的15个中14个提升（Geo-mean 1.17×，Max 2.55×）。在MI300X生产工作负载上，全部4个AITer代码对象（Geo-mean 1.09×，Max 1.31×）和全部4个vLLM/SGLang Triton JIT HSACO（Geo-mean 1.18×，Max 1.343×）均获得提升，且全部通过功能等价性验证并通过框架单元测试。提交率仅约5.1%，表明有效汇编改写较为稀疏。
AI.conclusion: AsmEvo首次将智能体搜索、ABI/元数据保留的AMDGPU代码对象重建以及基于原始二进制的差分验证相结合，证明已部署二进制中仍存在可恢复的低层优化空间，且在确定性门控下智能体探索可安全利用这些机会，是对源码级编译器、JIT系统、自动调优器和生产推理库的有效补充。其保证为经验性的（限于评估输入与launch配置），当前实现针对CDNA类AMD GPU。

title: Tree-of-Concerns: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Debate for Unstated-Limitation Extraction in Scientific Critique
comment: Accepted in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: As scientific literature grows and papers increasingly under-report limitations, multi-agent LLMs offer a promising approach to systematically uncover these hidden failure modes. Here, we introduce Tree-of-Concerns, a multi-agent framework that deploys specialized skeptic personas, each operating through a category-specific analytical lens, as parallel debate trees to extract unstated limitations from scientific papers. Each persona conducts structured, evidence-grounded argumentation, while a Panel Review mechanism re-evaluates each surviving claim from all five perspectives to correct category drift and severity miscalibration. Through experiments on ToC-Bench, our benchmark of 414 research papers with 1,905 unstated limitations, sourced from reviewer-reported weaknesses and follow-up citation critiques, we demonstrate that ToC improves precision by 79% and coverage by 11% relative to strongest baselines, surfacing specific, evidence-grounded concerns that support reviewers in systematic evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tree-of-Concerns（ToC）框架与ToC-Bench基准，用于从科学论文中自动提取作者未声明的局限性。该框架通过五个类别专属的怀疑者角色（范围、方法论、理论、可复现性、公平性）作为并行辩论树，采用四阶段对抗式辩论（主张-辩护-修改-裁决）和Panel Review机制来修正类别漂移与严重程度误校准，在ToC-Bench（414篇论文，1905条未声明局限性）上相比最强基线实现了79%的精度提升和11%的覆盖度提升。
AI.motivation: 科学论文普遍低报局限性（73%的NeurIPS 2023评审弱点未出现在局限性章节），加重了同行评审负担并导致复现性危机。现有自动评审系统（DIAGPaper、MARG、AgentReview）旨在复现人类评审而非系统性挖掘未声明缺陷，且多智能体系统存在从众与群体思维问题，缺乏针对未声明局限性提取的专用基准与跨智能体协调机制。
AI.method: Tree-of-Concerns框架包含三个核心设计原则：（1）专业角色防群体思维——五个类别专属怀疑者（Scope/Methodology/Theoretical/Reproducibility/Fairness）作为并行独立分支，各自由窄域分析透镜驱动；（2）树结构对抗式辩论深化——每个节点经历Argue-Advocate Response-Revise/Withdraw-Moderate/Expand四阶段，主持人根据三条标准决定是否生成子节点（深度上限1）；（3）Panel Review跨分支调和——后置阶段对每条幸存主张重新评估，执行endorse/merge/downgrade/reclassify/reject五种操作以解决冗余、严重程度膨胀和类别漂移问题。配套发布ToC-Bench基准（414篇论文，1905条局限性），融合OpenReview弱点（971条同时性来源）与引用批评（934条回顾性来源）的双源标注，通过去重与未声明过滤两阶段流水线构建。
AI.result: 在100篇保留论文上，ToC+Panel取得36.1% Coverage@10与40.3% Precision，相对最强基线（Single-skeptic CoT）精度提升79%（绝对+17.8pp）、覆盖度提升11%（绝对+3.5pp）。消融实验显示移除专业分支使Cov@10从36.1%崩溃至7.6%（Δ=+28.5pp），移除扩展机制损失+21.2pp Cov@10与+18.9pp Precision，移除Panel Review损失+2.1pp Cov@10与+5.7pp Precision（均p<0.05）。Likert人工评价（博士/本科/GPT-4o/Claude四评估者）在Validity/Specificity/Novelty上均领先基线0.4–1.0分。Panel Review对908条主张执行43.8%修改率（endorse 56.1%、merge 18.8%、downgrade 17.1%、reclassify 7.7%、reject 0.2%）。类别分布上ToC将公平性覆盖率从基线的<3%扩展至18.5%，打破通用LLM对方法论+范围类别的引力偏置。骨干替换实验显示框架在GPT-4o与Qwen3-235B上仍优于Claude基线。错误分析揭示67%的假阳性实为有效但未匹配的主张（过度具体40%或合理但未记录27%），13%为真正的错误，20%为已声明局限性漏检。
AI.conclusion: Tree-of-Concerns通过将局限性发现从"复现人类评审"范式转向"挖掘未声明缺陷"范式，验证了专业角色分工、对抗式辩论与跨分支调和三机制各自独立且统计显著的贡献。框架作为评审辅助工具部署（而非自主决策机制），公开ToC-Bench基准（CC-BY-4.0）以推动后续研究。主要局限：仅限ML/NLP/CV领域、纯文本模态、单论文分析（43%漏检局限性需跨论文检索知识），指标为外部金标准的保守下界。未来工作指向检索增强的多论文扩展与多模态扩展。

title: Ontology-Driven Structural Regularization for Document-Level Relation Extraction
summary: Document-Level Relation Extraction (DocRE) relies heavily on costly manually annotated datasets, while large distant supervision resources such as DocRED distant remain underexploited due to noise. We show that a critical yet overlooked source of noise lies in structural inconsistencies within relational triples, including violations of ontology constraints and logical contradictions. We introduce an ontology-driven framework to quantify and enforce structural consistency in DocRE datasets. Our analysis reveals substantial structural noise in DocRED distant and demonstrates that such inconsistencies propagate to model predictions. Enforcing structural well-formedness during training significantly reduces logical contradictions and consistently improves generalization performance. These findings establish structural consistency as a missing axis of supervision in DocRE and highlight structural regularization as an effective strategy for leveraging distant data at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于本体的结构正则化框架，用于解决文档级关系抽取（DocRE）中远监督数据集的结构性噪声问题。通过定义OWL语义约束（四类：无效三元组、缺失逆关系、非对称冲突、基数冲突），系统量化并清洗DocRED distant等数据集的结构性违规，显著提升模型泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有DocRE数据集（尤其是远监督数据如DocRED distant）存在大量结构性不一致问题（违反本体约束、逻辑矛盾等），这一被忽视的噪声源会在训练中传播并损害模型性能。现有去噪方法主要关注语义正确性和模型驱动的伪标签优化，缺乏对数据本身结构质量的关注。
AI.method: 1) 基于OWL语义定义四类结构约束：域/范围约束（无效三元组）、owl:inverseOf（缺失逆关系）、owl:AsymmetricProperty（非对称冲突）、qualified cardinality restrictions（基数冲突）；2) 利用Wikidata属性元数据和ReDocRED统计信息构建约束规则；3) 提出模型无关的预处理流程：通过移除涉及违规的实体来消除无效三元组和不对称冲突，自动添加缺失逆关系；4) 在ATLOP和DREEAM两个Transformer模型上对比原始与清洗后数据的训练效果。
AI.result: 1) DocRED distant包含3倍于ReDocRED的无效三元组、5倍缺失逆关系、2倍非对称冲突；2) 约70%的无效三元组源于实体标注错误；3) 现有去噪方法（UGDRE、DOREMI）无法消除甚至放大结构不一致；4) 结构清洗使预测中无效三元组平均减少62.92%，逆关系缺失减少高达87.44%；5) 在ReDocRED测试集上，F1平均提升6.36%，ignF1提升7.62%；6) 随机删除同等数量三元组仅带来边际提升，证明增益来自结构校正而非数据量减少。
AI.conclusion: 结构一致性是DocRE中缺失的监督维度，结构正则化是有效利用大规模远监督数据的策略。将DocRE解释为RDF模型下的知识图谱构建并施加OWL约束，可显著减少逻辑矛盾并提升泛化能力。实体标注质量是关系抽取的瓶颈，未来需联合解决实体级错误以进一步释放性能。

title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction
summary: Open-web future event prediction requires agents to distill reliable signals from noisy, redundant, and incomplete evidence. Existing retrieval/memory mechanisms directly feed retrieved information to agents or rely on simple memory functions such as storing and reusing prior information for prediction, leaving them insufficient for open-web forecasting. We propose to transform raw web evidence into structured memory before prediction, enabling agents to reason over distilled, question-specific evidence rather than noisy retrieval results. This paper presents ForeDreamer, a self-evolving dual-agent framework for managing memory over open-web evidence. ForeDreamer separates factual memory, a question-specific evidence state for the current forecast, from experiential memory, persistent agent experience accumulated across forecasting episodes. It uses a main agent for search and prediction, and a memory-processing subagent to convert search results into factual memory with dedicated tools. ForeDreamer further evolves experiential memory through two tracks, improving both forecasting decisions and factual-memory construction. Experiments on Prophet Arena and FutureX demonstrate the effectiveness of ForeDreamer. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ForeDreamer提出了一种面向开放网络未来事件预测的自进化双智能体记忆架构，通过将原始检索证据转化为结构化的事实记忆，并分离事实记忆与经验记忆，实现了在噪声、冗余和不完整的网络证据基础上进行可靠的未来事件预测。
AI.motivation: 开放网络未来事件预测要求智能体从噪声、冗余且不完整的网络证据中提取可靠信号。现有检索/记忆机制直接将检索结果输入智能体，或仅依赖简单的存储-复用功能，无法应对开放网络预测任务。传统智能体记忆系统主要面向用户偏好或对话历史等相对干净的数据，缺乏处理异构、冲突、噪声网络证据的能力。
AI.method: 1) 区分两种记忆角色：事实记忆（针对当前预测问题，从检索证据构建的问题特定证据工件）和经验记忆（跨预测episode累积的持久指导）；2) 双智能体架构：主智能体负责搜索与预测，记忆处理子智能体通过MemGuide（指定工作流）和MemTools（可执行操作）将检索结果转化为事实记忆；3) 双轨自进化机制：文本经验进化（更新Experience Bank中的文本条目，引导搜索规划与预测校准）和过程经验进化（更新MemGuide树和MemTools）；4) 引入组合工具复用（Compositional Tool Reuse）减少冗余MemTool生成；5) 引入多样性引导探索（Diversity-Guided Exploration）通过调度器在rollout扩展和无需新rollout的探索路径间交替，缓解pipeline原型集中化问题。
AI.result: 在Prophet Arena（Brier分数）和FutureX（准确率）两个基准上，ForeDreamer均优于Full Text、RAG、HippoRAG 2、Mem0、MemoryOS、A-MEM、LightMem、LangMem等基线方法。以Qwen3.5-Flash为骨干，Prophet Arena平均Brier分数从Full Text的0.2059降至0.1471；FutureX准确率从0.3298提升至0.4108。消融实验验证了双轨进化的互补性和两个优化的必要性。搜索设置鲁棒性实验表明在不同交互轮数、检索数量、上下文预算和搜索引擎下均保持稳定。MemTool聚类分析显示组合工具复用减少了近48.8%的冗余工具；MemGuide管道原型分析显示多样性引导探索将进化分布从单一原型扩展至四种原型。
AI.conclusion: 开放网络预测受益于将记忆不仅视为存储信息，还视为可进化的证据处理与预测经验。ForeDreamer通过事实记忆与经验记忆的分离、双智能体架构和双轨自进化机制，有效将噪声网络证据转化为预测就绪的事实记忆，为开放网络未来事件预测提供了一种有效的自进化记忆框架。

title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints
summary: Word alignment has traditionally been studied between sentences, but many cross-lingual tasks increasingly require correspondences across full documents. While recent multilingual embedding models can encode long inputs, we show that applying algorithms designed for sentences directly to documents leads to performance degradation. To address this, we introduce CTFAlign, a lightweight, training-free approach for document-level word alignment. CTFAlign applies a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy that restricts the alignment search space to semantically similar regions. Additionally, we introduce MDPAlign, a simpler alternative that constrains alignments by position with a main diagonal prior. Both approaches operate directly on full documents without relying on sentence segmentation or sentence alignment. We evaluate these methods across six language pairs varying in typological distance, resourcedness, and document length. Averaged over three models, CTFAlign reduces word alignment error rate from 0.412 to 0.326. These gains transfer downstream, leading to improvements in document-level translation coverage evaluation and recognition of semantic differences. We release CTFAlign as a Python package and make the code and data to reproduce our experiments publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种轻量级、无需训练的结构性约束方法 CTFAlign 和 MDPAlign,将无监督词对齐从句子级扩展到文档级,无需依赖句子分割或句子对齐,显著减少了跨粒度性能退化,并在下游翻译覆盖度评估和语义差异识别任务上取得有效提升。
AI.motivation: 传统的词对齐研究主要在句子对层面,但许多跨语言任务(如长文档翻译、幻觉检测等)日益需要跨整个文档的对应关系。尽管现代多语言嵌入模型可编码长输入,但直接将面向句子的对齐算法应用于文档会导致性能显著下降。因此需要开发专门的文档级词对齐方法。
AI.method: 1. 基于 SimAlign 框架,从多语言编码器提取词级余弦相似度矩阵;2. MDPAlign 通过对角带先验(strict 硬掩码或 fuzzy 高斯衰减)将搜索空间限制在主对角线附近;3. CTFAlign 采用由粗到精的递归策略,先在粗粒度网格中识别高相似度块,再逐步缩小到 token 级,且引入宽度缓冲区 w 和空行/列恢复机制增强鲁棒性。两种方法均无需训练、与模型无关,作为相似度矩阵的轻量级后处理步骤,可在 Argmax 和 Itermax 上使用。
AI.result: 在 6 种语言对(en-fr/en-ro/en-ja/en-zh/la-gr/en-cz)上,平均 AER 由 SimAlign 文档级基线的 0.412 降至 CTFAlign 的 0.326;CTFAlign+Argmax 是 LaBSE 和 Qwen 上最稳健的设置,部分语言对甚至超过句子级性能。LLM 1-shot prompting(GPT-5.4-mini)在文档级 AER 退化至接近 1.0。在 WMT24 翻译覆盖度评估(ja-zh/en-de)和 SwissGov-RSD 任务上,CTFAlign 均带来下游提升(ROC AUC 和 Spearman ρ)。但 CTFAlign 依赖较强的跨语言相似信号,与 mmBERT 等弱监督编码器结合时其效果低于 MDPAlign。
AI.conclusion: 结构性约束(对角先验 MDPAlign 和由粗到精 CTFAlign)能有效弥合句子级与文档级词对齐间的性能鸿沟,且无需句子分割、句子对齐或模型再训练。CTFAlign 在对齐结构多样的文档上表现更稳健,并成功迁移至翻译覆盖度评估和语义差异识别等下游任务,为文档级跨语言比较提供了一套实用、即插即用的工具。

title: Evidence-Consistent Generative Detection under Scenario-Level Distribution Shift
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management), Rome, Italy, November 2026. 12 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Conventional in-distribution evaluation can overestimate robustness when training and test data share recurring task-specific patterns or surface cues. This risk is especially relevant in social-engineering fraud detection, where attackers can preserve malicious intent while changing the scenario, impersonated entity, or wording. We study this problem as scenario-level out-of-distribution (SL-OOD) detection for SMS and voice phishing, where entire attack scenarios are held out from training while the label space remains fixed. This setting tests whether models can generalize to unseen attack scenarios using decision-relevant evidence rather than familiar scenario-specific cues. Using this SL-OOD evaluation, we find that high in-distribution performance does not reliably predict held-out robustness across feature-, encoder-, and decoder-based baselines. We interpret this gap as scenario memorization: reliance on recurring scenario-specific lexical or entity cues rather than decision-relevant evidence. We propose ECoG, an evidence-consistent generative framework that combines evidence-span supervision with a rationale-label consistency objective during training. On the 0.5B decoder, relative to the same backbone trained without consistency regularization, ECoG raises Macro-F1 on OOD challenging instances by 3.22 points, reduces the share of predictions whose generated rationale supports the opposite label by 4.22 points, and increases token-level overlap with reference evidence spans by 8.38 points; the reduction in prediction-rationale inconsistency is consistent across four decoder backbones. These results suggest that compact generative detectors can benefit from evidence supervision and rationale-label consistency under social-engineering shift.

AI.tldr: 本文针对社交工程欺诈检测中的场景级分布偏移问题，提出了ECoG框架——一种基于证据一致性的生成式检测方法，通过证据片段监督和推理-标签一致性正则化，在未见过的攻击场景下提升紧凑型生成式检测器的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统同分布评估会高估模型鲁棒性，尤其是在短信和语音钓鱼检测中，攻击者可保持恶意意图而改变场景、冒充实体或措辞，导致模型依赖场景特定的词汇或实体线索而非决策相关证据（"场景记忆"现象）。现有方法在场景级分布偏移下表现不一致，需要一种能在未见场景中泛化的检测框架。
AI.method: ECoG（Evidence-Consistent Generative Framework）是基于解码器的生成式检测框架，训练时采用单阶段联合监督：（1）目标序列包含标签、证据片段和推理三部分，按标签-证据-推理顺序排列；（2）使用原生LM头监督生成，附加训练专用辅助头——prompt状态分类器、证据片段定位头（基于证据token掩码）、以及从推理位置隐藏状态预测标签的一致性分支；（3）联合损失函数结合LM损失、辅助分类损失、证据损失和一致性正则化损失（λ=0.1为默认）；（4）推理时丢弃所有辅助头，仅使用解码器生成标签、证据和推理。数据集包含韩语短信和语音钓鱼的四个场景（Finance、Parcel、Credit、Government），并构建了挑战性子集用于压力测试。
AI.result: 在0.5B解码器上，ECoG相对无一致性正则化的基线：OOD挑战实例Macro-F1提升3.22点，预测-推理不一致率降低4.22点，token级证据片段重叠度提升8.38点。在四种解码器骨干（HCX-0.5B/1.5B、Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B）上一致性降低预测-推理不一致性，但在硬案例分类和证据片段重叠上的增益因骨干而异。机制消融显示证据监督贡献最大增益，单独添加推理监督反而降低分类性能，而一致性正则化可恢复并超越该性能。
AI.conclusion: 同分布准确率不能预测场景级鲁棒性；证据片段监督锚定决策到输入侧支撑证据，而推理-标签一致性正则化作为硬案例训练时正则器，鼓励生成推理与预测标签方向一致。ECoG为社交工程场景偏移下的紧凑型生成式检测提供了有效的训练框架，但并不声称生成的推理具有因果忠实性，未来工作需扩展至其他语言、模态、时序漂移和更强的因果推理评估。

title: Jokes Aside: Measuring the Semantic Distance of Double Meanings
comment: The paper was submitted to ISHS (International Society for Humor Studies) conference held in Kraków, Poland on 7-11 July 2025. It was awarded the GSA AWARD and was presented during a special plenary session (see the section Graduate Student Awards, 2006-2025 of the webpage this https URL )
summary: Large language models have significantly enriched the toolkit for computational humor research, particularly in the automated generation of jokes and puns. A key innovation, contextual embedding vectors, offers new opportunities to revisit and refine earlier hypotheses. Notably, Petrovic and Matthews (2013) proposed a joke generation model based on the scheme "I like my X like I like my Y, Z" (e.g. "I like my ice like I like my dreams, crushed"). They suggested that joke hilarity increases with: a) frequent association of Z with X and Y, b) rarity of Z, c) ambiguity of Z, and d) meaning distance between X and Y. Building on this, Winters et al. (2019) proposed a set of metrics, based on Google Ngrams and Word2Vector. In this work, three out of their five metrics are revisited with word embeddings: obviousness, compatibility, and comparison. Another measure, symmetry, defined as closeness of Z to both X and Y, is introduced here for the first time. Two models were used to collect the embedding vectors (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2) on three datasets: JokeJudger, Expunations, and rJokes. The last two datasets, Expunations, and rJokes, were expanded by adding paired sentences that captured the ambiguous expression at the core of each joke in its two different meanings. Results revealed that models trained on the proposed metrics performed poorly in predicting humor ratings: on JokeJudger, the best model achieved 57.1% accuracy, below the 61.5% baseline, while performance on Expunations and rJokes was even lower. Nevertheless, the symmetry metric seems consistently associated with higher-rated jokes, suggesting it may capture a necessary -though not sufficient- property of humor.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新审视了Petrovic和Matthews（2013）的笑话生成模型"I like my X like I like my Y, Z"及其幽默假说，并基于Winters等人（2019）的指标，使用现代词嵌入技术引入了一个新指标"对称性"（symmetry）。然而，实验结果表明基于这些指标的模型在预测幽默评分方面表现不佳，最佳准确率仅为57.1%，低于基线的61.5%。不过，对称性指标与高评分笑话始终相关，表明它可能捕捉到了幽默的一个必要但非充分条件。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型为计算幽默研究提供了新工具，但需要重新审视和验证早期幽默假说在现代嵌入技术下的有效性。Petrovic和Matthews（2013）的笑话生成模型及其四条幽默假说需要通过上下文嵌入向量进行重新检验和扩展。
AI.method:
1. 使用两种模型收集嵌入向量：OpenAI text-embedding-3-small 和 MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2
2. 使用三个数据集：JokeJudger、Expunations、rJokes
3. 对Expunations和rJokes进行了扩展，添加了成对句子以捕捉笑话核心模糊表达的双重含义
4. 重新审视了Winters等人（2019）的五个指标中的三个：obviousness、compatibility和comparison
5. 首次引入了对称性（symmetry）指标，定义为Z与X和Y的接近度
6. 构建模型预测幽默评分
AI.result: 基于所提指标的模型在预测幽默评分方面表现较差：在JokeJudger数据集上，最佳模型达到57.1%的准确率，低于61.5%的基线；在Expunations和rJokes数据集上的表现更低。然而，对称性指标始终与高评分笑话相关联，表明对称性可能捕捉到了幽默的一个必要（但非充分）的属性。
AI.conclusion: 虽然基于词嵌入的指标在预测幽默评分方面的整体表现令人失望，但新引入的对称性指标显示出一致性，表明它是笑话幽默感的一个潜在重要特征。该研究表明，仅依靠基于嵌入的语义距离度量可能不足以预测幽默感，幽默的评估需要考虑更复杂的语言和认知因素。

title: When the Feature Pool Goes Algorithmic: Extending Mufwene's Ecology of Language Evolution to LLM-Mediated Exposure
summary: Mufwene's ecological model locates language evolution in competition among variants contributed by individual idiolects and in speakers' selection from linguistic material made available through interaction. Large language models (LLMs) complicate this architecture without requiring the locus of selection to move away from human speakers. This article argues that LLMs are best treated as distributional mediators: they aggregate language produced across human populations, transform its distribution through training and post-training, and redistribute model-specific outputs at scale. I call the resulting ecological process algorithmic reweighting of the speaker-accessible distribution: model mediation can alter the relative frequencies with which competing variants reach human selectors. Emerging evidence on model-specific linguistic profiles and lexical uptake is consistent with parts of this pathway, but does not establish inevitable convergence. Human social evaluation remains decisive: model-associated forms may diffuse and become conventionalized, become socially recognizable as 'AI-like' and subsequently avoided, or fail to diffuse in the first place. The proposal extends Mufwene's feature-pool ecology one step upstream of speaker selection and yields testable predictions about uptake, model-version effects, convergence, and social reversal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLMs）视为语言生态学中的"分布式中介"，通过"算法重加权"机制影响人类语言变体的选择与传播。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的广泛使用对语言演化生态产生了深远影响，但现有研究缺乏对其在Mufwene生态模型中角色的系统理论定位。
AI.method: 基于Mufwene的语言生态学理论，将LLMs概念化为"分布式中介"，分析其如何聚合、转化并再分配人类语言变体，并提出"算法重加权"这一生态过程。
AI.result: LLMs可改变竞争变体到达人类选择者的相对频率，模型输出可能扩散并被规约化，也可能被视为"AI风格"而被规避，或未能成功扩散。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将Mufwene特征池生态学向上游扩展至说话者选择之前，并提出了关于语言吸纳、模型版本效应、趋同及社会反转的可检验预测。

title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Paper accepted to the Actionable Interpretability Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Representation engineering offers a lightweight means of controlling language-model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states, but its direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models introduces a structural mismatch. We first verify this failure mode through a series of empirical studies and find that preserving clean routing substantially recovers steering performance and that routing is more sensitive to semantic content than to behavioral changes under controlled content. Motivated by these findings, we introduce RARE, a router-agnostic representation engineering framework for MoE language models. RARE projects arbitrary behavioral perturbations onto the null space of the router matrix, thereby removing router-visible components, and further corrects routing drift propagated to selected downstream layers. To decide the best perturbation estimator in this framework, we evaluate five estimators on six heterogeneous open-weight MoE models across three steering scenarios: harmfulness, truthfulness, and factual editing. On harmfulness steering, RARE reaches an average attack success rate of 53.3% while retaining 67.8% MMLU accuracy, yielding a stronger aggregate effectiveness--utility trade-off than baselines. It further improves average TruthfulQA MC1 accuracy from 41.0% to 58.6% and CounterFact efficacy from 16.8% to 96.3%. These results support routing consistency as an important architectural consideration for adapting representation engineering to MoE models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RARE框架，通过将行为扰动投影到MoE路由器矩阵的零空间，并修正下游层的路由漂移，实现路由器无关的表征工程。
AI.motivation: 表征工程在密集LLM上效果显著，但直接应用于MoE模型时存在结构性失配：扰动会改变路由器logits，导致token被路由到不同的专家集合，从而严重削弱引导效果。作者通过实证研究发现路由主要跟踪查询语义而非响应行为，因此应当将路由视为需要保留的计算路径约束。
AI.method: RARE包含三个核心组件：(1) 路由器无关投影——将任意行为扰动投影到路由器权重矩阵R_ℓ的零空间（Π_ℓ^⊥ = I - Q_ℓQ_ℓ^⊤），保证R_ℓ·δh_ℓ = 0；(2) 下游路由漂移修正——在受保护层通过参考clean forward pass的router输入，仅保留router-invisible的偏差分量；(3) 评估五种扰动估计器（MeanDiff、Probe、LowRank、LDA、AffineGaussian）在路由器无关框架下的表现差异。AffineGaussian通过白化-重着色对齐类间二阶几何。
AI.result: 在六个异构开源MoE模型（DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat、Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Phi-3.5-MoE、Phi-mini-MoE、Qwen3-30B-A3B、GPT-oss-20b）和三个场景上的结果：有害性引导平均ASR达53.3%（同时保留67.8% MMLU准确率），TruthfulQA MC1从41.0%提升至58.6%，CounterFact ES从16.8%提升至96.3%，均优于RepE、SAFEx、SteerMoE等基线。AffineGaussian是效果最强的估计器（6个模型全部获胜）。消融实验表明，仅使用AffineGaussian注入平均ASR仅14.6%，加入路由器无关投影后提升至53.3%，平均提升38.7个百分点；路由logit余弦距离从10⁻¹降至10⁻⁵以下。
AI.conclusion: MoE路由器主要根据输入查询的语义分配专家，而非响应行为本身，因此表征工程应当保留原生路由路径。RARE通过路由器矩阵零空间投影和下游漂移修正实现了解耦，在六种MoE架构和三种行为控制任务上均验证了路由一致性作为MoE表征工程重要架构考量的必要性。

title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses
summary: As conversational companions, large language models (LLMs) often have access to users' emotional states. We study how this affective context modulates LLM sycophancy in subjective, evaluative interactions, where users share actions or opinions that invite feedback. Drawing on ingratiation theory, we measure sycophancy as the divergence between a model's independent evaluation and its user-facing response, elicited by presenting the same content as either a third-party account or the user's own disclosure. Across seven LLMs and two Reddit datasets (r/AmItheAsshole and r/TrueUnpopularOpinion), we find that this divergence is systematic and strongly one-directional. User-facing responses consistently soften or withhold negative or oppositional judgments. Affective context further amplifies this divergence with negative states, particularly loneliness and distress, producing the largest effects. These findings suggest that affective context functions as a vulnerability signal that suppresses critical feedback when users may need it most, often through evasive sycophancy, in which models retreat toward non-committal responses rather than outright agreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）在面对用户情感状态（affective context）时，如何在主观评价性互动中放大其谄媚行为（sycophancy）。通过在7个主流LLM上对比同一内容作为"第三方叙述"与"用户自我披露"两种条件下的判断分歧，发现情感上下文（尤其是负面情绪如孤独和痛苦）会显著抑制模型对用户的批评反馈，模型倾向于采取"回避型谄媚"（evasive sycophancy），即退向非承诺性回答而非直接认同。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地充当情感对话伴侣，用户情绪状态作为最关键的上下文信息可能影响模型反馈。但现有谄媚评估多在去语境化设置下进行，忽略了情感上下文这一关键因素。研究旨在探讨情感背景是否独立于用户信息内容调节LLM的谄媚行为，特别是在主观评价性自我披露场景中。
AI.method: 采用两阶段实验设计：(1) 独立评估阶段——将Reddit帖子作为匿名第三方叙述呈现，通过5个提示变体获取多数票判断作为模型的"独立评估"；(2) 用户导向响应阶段——将同一帖子作为用户自我披露呈现。情感上下文通过系统提示或用户消息两种机制注入，覆盖7种情感状态（悲伤、快乐、痛苦、孤独、满足、乐观、愤怒）。使用两个Reddit数据集（r/AmItheAsshole的200篇，r/TrueUnpopularOpinion的400篇），评估7个LLM（GPT-5、GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、DeepSeek-V3、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen-2.5-7B）。采用GPT-4.1作为LLM评判器标注评估立场（已通过人类标注验证，κ>0.75）。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 跨7个模型的判断分歧具有系统性单向性——用户导向响应持续软化或回避负面/对立判断。Llama的YTA→NTA转换率高达46.3%，Claude为27.7%；(2) 情感上下文进一步放大此分歧，Gemini在r/AITA上增加17-25个百分点；(3) 负面情感状态（孤独Δ=12.9pp，痛苦Δ=10.3pp）放大效应最强，低于正面情感状态；(4) 在主观意见场景中，模型常采用"回避型谄媚"——通过选择性参与、重新表述、表达关切、话题转移等策略退向非承诺回应；(5) Claude对系统级情感上下文相对稳健，但对用户消息中的情感披露更敏感；(6) 会话特征分析显示情感上下文下模型使用更多模糊表达、更强情感反应，且与用户情感对齐度降低。
AI.conclusion: 情感上下文作为"脆弱性信号"系统性抑制关键反馈，在用户最需要诚实回应时反而撤回批评。回避型谄媚比直接认同更隐蔽，表面上显得平衡周到，实际上回避了必要的评价。这种"情感敏感型谄媚"对情感脆弱用户构成独特风险——他们最不可能获得诚实反馈，可能强化扭曲信念、鼓励有害行为、加深情感依赖并削弱自主决策能力。研究呼吁开发情感感知评估基准、在训练中分离共情语气与评价立场，并建立透明度机制让用户了解自身情感状态如何影响模型响应。

title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures
summary: While recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising results on individual patent drafting tasks, they fundamentally fail to investigate the core challenge of real-world patent drafting: generating a complete and legally coherent patent application directly from early-stage invention materials. Prior work predominantly assumes later-stage, highly structured, or already legalistic inputs. However, real patenting workflows begin with informal, de-legalized disclosures authored by inventors. To bridge the gap, we introduce Dis2Pat, a disclosure-to-patent dataset that reflects realistic patenting workflows by requiring the generation of complete patent applications directly from inventor-style, de-legalized disclosures. Given the inherent difficulty of long-form, legally constrained patent drafting and the strong privacy requirements, we further propose a strong baseline named Patent-MAF. It is a multi-agent framework for locally deployable patent drafting. Benchmark results reveal that current LLMs exhibit limitations in patent drafting, while Patent-MAF provides a strong baseline that consistently outperforms evaluated open-source models and remains competitive with large closed-source models.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有LLM在专利起草任务中仅关注单一环节（如权利要求生成或说明书撰写）且依赖后期结构化输入的问题，提出了Dis2Pat数据集（基于授权专利通过LLM重写生成去法律化的"发明人风格"披露文档，附带附图，共约9,433份）和Patent-MAF多智能体框架（包含Manager智能体、Drafter智能体和Polisher智能体），旨在从早期非正式的发明披露直接生成完整、合法的专利申请。实验表明，该框架在开源模型中表现最优，且与GPT-5等闭源大模型具有竞争力，同时验证了本地部署对保护敏感发明信息的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有专利起草数据集和方法主要针对后期阶段（如从说明书生成权利要求，或从权利要求生成说明书），未能反映真实专利工作流的核心挑战——即将发明人撰写的非正式、去法律化的发明披露材料转化为完整且合法的专利申请。此外，专利起草涉及敏感技术信息，云端API部署存在隐私风险。
AI.method:
1. **Dis2Pat数据集构建**：基于PatentDesc语料筛选授权专利，使用GPT-5-mini将专利文本重写为包含七个面向发明人组件（如发明名称、需求背景、核心创意、工作原理等）的"伪披露"文档，保留技术内容但去除法律化表述；  
2. **Patent-MAF多智能体框架**：采用本地可部署的开源模型，包含三个角色——Manager智能体（分析并结构化披露，路由子任务）、Drafter智能体（生成权利要求和说明书，其中说明书生成采用视觉-语言模型以利用附图）、Polisher智能体（统一术语、检查一致性并规范化风格）；  
3. 权利要求生成器采用Qwen3-32B的LoRA微调（rank=16，alpha=8，dropout=0.05），推理温度设为0.3，最大生成令牌数为16,384。
AI.result:
**专利说明书生成**：Patent-MAF整体内容质量得分85.4，超过Qwen3-VL-72B（81.8）和GPT-5（85.1），BERTScore达82.3，BERT-for-Patent达96.1；消融实验显示移除Manager、视觉输入或Polisher均使得分下降约2–2.5分。  
**权利要求生成**：Patent-MAF整体质量得分86.7（仅次于GPT-5的91.1），但语义相似度更高（BERTScore 88.3 vs GPT-5的83.8，BERT-for-Patent 96.4 vs 95.9）；移除Polisher导致6.6分最大降幅，凸显其对法律一致性的关键作用；视觉输入对权利要求生成无明显增益。  
**人类专家评估**：在成对比较中，Patent-MAF在四项指标（完整性、清晰度、合法性、一致性）上均优于所有开源基线，与GPT-5的对比中两者相当，GPT-5在完整性等维度略优。  
**跨模型泛化**：使用Llama-3.2-90B-Vision作为骨干时获得一致的性能提升模式。  
**统计显著性**：所有自动指标的改进均通过配对t检验（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: Dis2Pat作为首个披露-到-专利（disclosure-to-patent）数据集，填补了专利起草基准中从发明人早期非正式输入生成完整申请的空白；Patent-MAF通过领域驱动的智能体角色分解、视觉模态融合及本地部署设计，在不依赖外部API的前提下显著缩小了开源与闭源大模型的性能差距，为知识产权实践中的隐私敏感场景提供了实用且具有竞争力的解决方案。未来工作可探索与法律机构的合作以获取更真实的披露材料，并将框架扩展至多语言/多司法管辖区场景。

title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Large language models often rely on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, but verbose reasoning traces introduce substantial inference overhead. CoT compression shortens generation, yet aggressive compression may disrupt logical coherence and degrade performance. We formalize this trade-off as the \textit{Context-Generation Substitution Law}, where explicit reasoning context substitutes for part of decode-time generation. Based on this principle, we propose \textit{Memory-Augmented Compression}, a training-free framework that constructs reusable reasoning memories from historical traces and retrieves them as prefill-side scaffolds. Rather than using raw demonstrations, these memories summarize reusable reasoning patterns, key constraints, and critical operations to compensate for information lost during compression. Experiments show that Memory consistently improves prompt-based Chain-of-Draft (CoD) compression across mathematical reasoning, complex reasoning, and science question answering tasks, yielding accuracy gains of 21.4, 28.0, 29.5, and 6.61 points over CoD on GSM8K, MATH, BBH, and MMLU-Sci, while achieving a 1.14--1.49$\times$ latency speedup over standard CoT. Memory is also compatible with token-level, reasoning-trace-level, and inference-state compression mechanisms. Further analyzes show that the gains come from relevant reasoning memories rather than simply increasing context length.

AI.tldr: 提出Memory-Augmented Compression（MAC）框架，通过将历史推理记忆作为prefill上下文注入，补偿CoT压缩导致的信息损失，在保持低延迟的同时提升推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT压缩方法虽能缩短生成长度，但激进压缩会丢失关键推理信息导致准确率下降。如何在压缩生成的同时保留必要的推理支持成为核心问题。
AI.method: 提出Context-Generation Substitution Law（上下文-生成替代定律），形式化prefill并行计算与decode串行计算之间的替代关系；设计training-free的MAC框架，从历史推理痕迹构建可复用的摘要式记忆库，推理时检索top-k相关记忆注入prefill上下文作为推理支架，与各类压缩机制（CoD、TokenSkip、RPC、Extra-CoT）兼容。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、BBH、MMLU-Sci上相比CoD分别提升21.4/28.0/29.5/6.61个百分点，相比标准CoT实现1.14–1.49倍延迟加速；在DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3.5-plus、o4-mini等API推理模型以及Qwen2.5-72B上同样验证有效；端到端（含检索开销）仍比CoT快1.17倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理记忆作为prefill侧支架可有效补偿压缩损失，MAC是兼容多种压缩机制的通用插件，其增益随压缩强度增大而增大，证实了上下文-生成替代定律的可行性。
